voice_list.text: I'm not a fan of cleaning, but I do owe this place a lot, so it's okay sometimes...
Ahh, I love it here. I almost wish I could live here.
I want to explore as many places as I can. I might find all sorts of treasures!
I wonder if the things my teachers taught me at the academy will help me in this world, too?
This is someone else's atelier, so I shouldn't make a mess. If I can manage that.
You alchemists never get tired of synthesizing, do you?
I wonder if there's anything weird hidden away in this atelier somewhere.
Haha. Who would have thought poking my nose in random places would lead me to another world.
Adventures are always better with company, right? The more the merrier.
I want to go out on an adventure and look for all sorts of rare things.
So this is the atelier where you do synthesis? Ever caused an explosion?
Phew, this place sure is relaxing. I'd better rest up so I'm ready for the next adventure.
You should take care of your health. Can't do anything if you're not feeling well.
I hope I can make use of the knowledge and experience I've gained during my adventures.
I think we should sell off anything we don't know how to use.
What happens if someone falls off the area outside the atelier?
Do you want me to try collecting some sheet music?
There's so much here I don't know anything about. Everything feels so new.
Alchemy is incredible. We can jump through space just by eating some candy.
Ugh... Investigating costs so much money. Guess it's raw spinach again tonight.
I think we could plant a vegetable garden in this atelier.
Maybe I should open a shop here, too.
I want to eat some yummy carrots. Think we could find some if we went exploring?
I feel like I can do anything when I'm with you all. It's kind of magical.
Money is important, sure, but there are plenty of more important things.
There are so many things I've never seen before. What should I check out next?
Synthesizing together is a good chance to put what I learned at the academy into practice.
Back in my world, there were creatures formed of mana. Is the mana here different?
These requests remind me of the part-time jobs I used to do back at the academy.
The academy's atelier was lively, but even more people come to this one.
There are alchemy books here... Maybe I should read a few.
It's quiet here. Well, at least compared to the atelier I know.
Come to think of it, I don't think I've ever met a serious alchemist until now.
The hem here is getting frayed... I should sew it up when I get a chance.
The minute I graduate, I end up in another world... Will my life ever be normal?
Maybe I should have some pie for a snack today.
This isn't my atelier, so I should try not to make anything explode.
I'd better take care of my staff while we're here. It's tough to do it once we're on the road.
I put some pie into our lunches, what next...? Oh! I think I forgot to wash the dishes!
How did I even get here? Wait! My teacher didn't have anything to do with this, did she?!
This is a strange place I've wound up in. But, I guess I can't really complain.
Hmm... Well, I guess this atelier isn't too bad.
I thought every alchemist was strange, but it seems there are exceptions.
Lazing around is a waste of time. If there's something to do, do it!
I'd better help gather funds. My being a noble means nothing here.
Alchemy books, huh? Oh, some of them have cooking recipes, too. Maybe I'll take a look.
There are so many cool ingredients here, but they're all for synthesis. What a waste!
I wonder how the spices in this world are. Oh, I've got a good idea to test out!
I wonder how alchemists can make food by just mixing stuff in their cauldrons.
With this many people here there's GOT to be at least one chef. That gets me fired up!
Okay, where are we off to today?
I'd better check our schedule.
Working reception at the castle was fine, but it's nice being free to go on adventures.
Rorona was always blowing up her cauldron, but this atelier seems peaceful.
With this many people here, I'm bound to meet one or two interesting people...
What should I synthesize today?
I'd say it's about time for snacks, wouldn't you?
I was a bit nervous around all these strangers, at first. But everyone is so kind. It's nice.
I hope my experience as an adventurer comes in handy in this world.
This isn't my atelier, so I should be careful not to blow up the cauldron.
I like the atmosphere in this atelier.
Maybe I'll take a step outside and get some fresh air.
I know I'm not a princess anymore, but sometimes I still think back to my kingdom and my people.
I gave up on my quest to get stronger, but I guess now I'm back on it?
I've shortened "Meruru's Memos" to "Mememos"! Now then, what's on the schedule today?
I like the atmosphere in this atelier. It's so lively.
It's so cozy that I often end up staying too long...
Everything starts with the basics. Slow and steady will get you where you're headed.
I need to study more about the materials of this world to make good medicine.
I hope Nio isn't making trouble for everyone. I worry about her.
There's a cliff right outside. I refuse to be the one to open the door.
It's difficult to relax when I don't have a mission to work on.
I may be able to complete my mission of making 100 friends here...
I always had these clothes delivered to me every month. But I suppose they can't be delivered here.
I've washed my face, combed my hair... Hmm, it seems these habits have become muscle memory.
Even here, it seems my role hasn't changed much.
People don't suddenly move up the due date for payments here, do they?
So many cute girls here to dress in cute clothes. I'd better work on outfits for everyone.
If I had this many personnel back home, or even just half of this number of people...
It's nice we don't have to risk our lives crossing a desert here.
Is there anything I can help you with?
I desire sweets.
No abnormalities detected in body scan. I am available for requests at any time.
Mild fatigue confirmed in central circuits. I require sweets.
I enjoy this atelier. The number of people coming and going is optimal for boredom prevention.
There are so many great books here. It was worth coming to the atelier just to read them.
What a peculiar atelier. I might need to unravel the secrets of this world to understand it.
The journey to find the truth is long and difficult. There's no end in sight, but I must press on.
Wanderers, huh? I'm not one to make friends, but cooperation seems like the best strategy here.
A world without dusk. I must observe the limits of this world's alchemy.
What should I make today?
I think it's about time for some snacks.
Getting together with everyone here makes me remember my time on the development team.
Something smells sweet... I just had some snacks, so I should probably hold off.
I haven't gotten used to the alchemy here yet, but I'm glad I get to synthesize with Logy.
What should I do today?
That shelf is a bit of a mess.
Using a cauldron for alchemy seems to rely heavily on the senses. I'll have to get used to it.
Being here with everyone reminds me of working on the development team.
I can't forget my sword training. I'll lose my edge if all I do is work.
What should we synthesize next?
The atelier might look eccentric on the outside, but it's mysteriously calming on the inside, isn't it?
I wonder where I should go today. I should ask everyone about their plans.
If we don't take care of our tools, they might fail us when we need them the most.
I'm learning something new here every day. I should review what I've learned at some point.
Looks like we've got visitors. Maybe I should make some tea.
It's tough to practice my singing here.
I love to sing, but I don't have the courage to be the only one doing it.
I need to practice my swordplay. Maybe I can ask someone to help.
It seems they give thanks to the stars here. Prayer is prayer, no matter what form it takes.
I'd like to drink some milk, I think.
Have I gotten shorter...?
It's kind of nice getting to replicate tools that are different from the ones in my world.
I'm glad they have milk in this world. It'd be hard to look for a substitute.
Market research is important. We need to know what's in fashion here.
I bet if we had more plants here, the atmosphere in the atelier would be even better.
I want to make sure everyone who comes here eats enough vegetables.
If I let my guard down I put on weight pretty fast. Well, I lose it pretty fast, too.
It's important to find new places where rare plants can grow.
Got my shovel, got my work gloves, got my tonics. Okay! I'm all ready to head out!
This atelier has an excellent sense of style.
I wonder what kind of new dishes I should make for the cafe.
I need to study the food in this world. It's delicious, and I can use it back at the cafe!
It's actually kind of fun helping alchemists out.
This place feels like it's out of a fairy tale. Wouldn't it be great to have a cafe like this?
Hmm, where should I go next?
Hey, is that the voice of some ore I'm hearing? I wonder where it's coming from?
Heh, if I set up a tent here, I could have an atelier inside an atelier!
Adveeentures, adveeentures, in a brand new wooorld.
An Ice Bomb is— "A blade of frozen judgment"? No, it's more like...
I guess you might say this is like a secret base, too.
I like studying alchemy, but I don't really like studying anything else.
Okay, time to make our next plan. I've got to have as many adventures as possible in this new world!
When I hear everyone talk about their own worlds, I feel like I want to visit them all.
I don't have anyone telling me to help out around the house here... But I kinda miss that.
This is a fun little atelier. It'd give our old secret base a run for its money.
Okay, maybe I'll go outside and do some training.
Part of training is taking care of my sword. Every battle starts with preparation.

Seems like Valeria's really been putting her all into it lately. I need to keep up to make sure I don't get left behind!
Alchemy is so beautiful every time I see it. It's mesmerizing!
Hmm, what should be on the menu today?
I'll work hard to make myself useful to Valeria and the others! Just watch, I'll peddle to earn as much as we need!
I just love peddling my wares. Nothing beats seeing the smile on a satisfied customer's face!
I'm pretty good at picking out the best fish! I handle them every day, so I've learned a thing or two!
Hmm, where should I go next?
Oh, I hear the minerals calling... I wonder where that sound is coming from?
I wonder if there's a recipe for a sweet treat that would really surprise everyone? Hmm...
Here you go! It's a Rock Cookie. Since it might break your teeth, let it dissolve in your mouth instead!
This basket is cute, but it doesn't hold much. I guess I'll just put some candy in it for now.
*Yawn* I'm getting sleepy. This atelier's just way too cozy.
Hellooo? Is anyone here to give me some head pats?
I really wanna see Queen Lara. I need some head pats from her too!
Let's move this to here, and then...done! Think Queen Lara will like this accessory?
Hmm, what should I do today? Maybe I'll just flip a coin to decide!
This atelier is so cluttered. It's completely lacking in aesthetics. Shall I tidy it up?
She can wear this outfit, and this one is perfect for her... So many stars and just not enough designs!
My! There are just not enough words to praise Queen Lara! I can't hold them back!
Mieke's outfit designs really are so special. I can't wait to make them together!
To be capable of delivering my best songs at any time, I must always keep my voice in perfect condition...
Ugh, sitting around doin' nothing is boring. Guess I'll clean this place up a bit.
Lots of folks comin' and goin' here, all with such unique outfits... It's fun to watch.
I come back and the Society's gone, Valeria's missing—seriously, I had no idea what was goin' on.
You just can't beat Flocke's cooking! Even I can't bring out flavor like she can!
Ah, I love this song so much. Gets my blood pumping every time I hear it!
What a truly fascinating place. It's brimming with wisdom beyond our understanding...
For some reason, this place puts my mind at ease.
Alchemists are only human. They carry both light and shadow. I must judge them with an impartial eye.
Richard's love of freedom knows no bounds. Perhaps I should have a firm talk with him one of these days...
The alchemist, Resna. The potential she holds is truly immeasurable.
Phew... Reading alone is so relaxing. Don't you agree, Azure?
Maybe I should...tidy up a bit...
I always thought my only friends were Scarlet, my other three dolls, and Criselda...
A lot has happened, but all of the Polar Night Alchemists are still my precious friends...
I'm still not great at talking to people, but I think I've gotten a little better? Maybe...
The books in this library are fascinating. I don't suppose you'd mind if I reorganized them to my liking?
This alchemy cauldron... I'd love the chance to carefully study its mechanisms in detail...
My ultimate desire is to attain all knowledge. I want to witness the pinnacle of alchemy with my own eyes.
This atelier is an extremely ideal environment. My research will progress smoothly here.
This world is filled with countless secrets. I wish to unravel them all.
Unless there's a battle, I just don't care... *Sigh*
Can I take a little nap? Just a little one...
Doesn't this outfit make me look strong? And it's surprisingly easy to move in, too!
Not like the outfit did anything wrong. I'll use anything I can to be stronger.
Looks impressive, doesn't it? Staying true to myself is what I'm most proud of.
This scenery that stretches beyond... it seems almost otherworldly.
I must keep watch to ensure His Highness isn't led astray...
I wonder if this kind of outfit suits me...?
The defense is rather low, which concerns me... but I must admit it looks quite nice.
Would anyone even appreciate seeing a knight like me in such an outfit...?
This place that Saskia created... I'd like to investigate it thoroughly.
It's lively, but somehow calming. What a peculiar place.
There are so many beautiful girls here, I can't help but let my eyes wander.
Resna and Valeria... hehe, I might see something interesting here.
There are still truths to be uncovered by these eyes, it seems.
I'm not very good at cleaning up... I can hardly call myself a role model, I regret to say.
It's frustrating... I wish Resna would talk more with everyone else.
Hehe. We've welcomed a new year. Let's all start fresh, everyone~
This is my special outfit for the New Year's celebration. It suits me quite well, don't you think?
Someone like me can pull off any outfit. See? Even the way I move!
The construction of this atelier is truly praiseworthy. I would love to have something like this in my castle.
My, my... This is the first time I've seen this book. May I borrow it for a while?
As a queen, I chose an outfit both functional and elegant.
I must grow accustomed to new attire and new ways of fighting.
A ruler must act for their people and wield their authority wisely.
Well then, shall I help myself to one of these sweets?
This atelier itself might be proof of advanced alchemy.
This outfit, a symbol of friendship with Lara, is surprisingly easy to move in.
It's an elegant outfit, but I feel somewhat out of place wearing it in the atelier.
Lira's servant was looking at me like I was some rare beast. Surely this outfit isn't that strange...
I want to show everyone my atelier too!
I'm feeling inspired to try some new recipes. I wonder if I could borrow the cauldron?
I want to try some new alchemy... I wonder if anyone would like to help me?
It's not because I'm a genius that I can do this. I can do this because I'm me!
Hmm, I just can't get the ribbon angle right today. Maybe here? Or perhaps here...
Since we have time, maybe I should do some cleaning. There's a duster right here...
Everyone who gathers here is so unique. I bet they all have interesting stories to tell.
I used to be quite frail, but thanks to Marie, I've become much healthier.
I'm not sure if I'm being helpful... but I'll do my best to be useful!
This atelier is beautiful. I always thought alchemists were messy people.
It's impossible to get bored here.
There are so many different alchemists here. There's much to learn.
Being surrounded by so many alchemists... It really gets me fired up!
The possibilities of alchemy, and its dangers... There's no end to what we must consider.
Ahh. A quiet atelier brings peace to the heart...
All sorts of people gather here. I wonder if I'll make any friends?
There are so many books I've never seen before. Which one should I read first?
I should probably check our tool inventory soon.
Maybe I'll invite Riza to go shopping next time. We can do some market research too...
Traveling to new places is so much fun - there's always something new to discover!
I'm getting used to the scenery of this atelier. It's starting to feel like my second home.
I love this place because so many people gather here!
It's easy to forget, but these peaceful, uneventful days are truly precious.
Hmm! Nothing much happening today, so maybe I'll go adventuring somewhere far away~
Adventuring to unknown places is so exciting!
I wonder if they have any rabbit plushies?
I'm bored. Maybe I'll lie down for a nap.
Big sis is kind and strong. I really look up to her.
Today is peaceful with nothing special happening. Grateful for these tranquil days. A dance of gratitude! Yay~
Wherever big sis goes, I'll follow - be it to the bath or even a volcano!
I want to master all the recipes I've been taught! Should start by gathering materials first?
Ah~ I want to see all sorts of places in the outside world! Getting on a ship and going on a journey... the dreams are endless...!
Alright, today I'm going to try that new recipe they taught me earlier!
Maybe I should ask Bepp to teach me some close combat techniques next time...
A street stall that Resna used to run...? Sounds like she was doing something similar to what I do~
Ahh... Something about this place just helps me relax...
When I sit still like this, I can't help but think about my daughter.
Taking time to rest your body during breaks is also part of a holy knight's duty.
Maybe I should do some tidying up while I have the chance. Cleaning is one of my specialties, after all.
Mmm~! A good stretch always feels so nice.
Huh...? What was this herb supposed to do again...?
This atelier holds so many precious memories.
Whatever awaits at the end of this journey, I chose this path myself. I won't have any regrets.
Just wearing new clothes can really lift your spirits~!
I can't wait to see what we'll find in the new frontier~!
It's so relaxing here... Maybe I should take a nap.
Acting like a proper adult is the hardest thing to do.
There's still so much I don't understand, but I guess I just have to take it one step at a time.
I want to learn more. About all the things I don't know about myself.
Now then... what should I do? I'm getting kind of hungry.
Maybe I should digest some of these books I've been collecting.
Taking it easy once in a while isn't so bad...
I'm bored... Maybe I'll read a book...
I'm getting a little hungry...
Perhaps I should study some alchemy while I have the chance.
Waiting around for this long is starting to make me feel restless...
Until physical labor is needed, maybe I'll do some training.
Is there anything troubling you? If there's something I can help with, just call for me.
I should meditate. One must always be ready to act at a moment's notice.
I never skip my training. This too is for the sake of justice.
I don't have much to do right now... Maybe I'll do some knitting...?
Ugh... Reini hasn't abandoned me... right...?
I need to find something I can do for Reini while I have the chance...!
Since I have some time, maybe I should groom my fur...?
Mmm... What a perfect day for a nap...
Wow, there are so many fashionable people here! Maybe I should ask them about their style preferences.
I wonder if there are any materials or books I could use to make clothes? I should look around!
I just thought of a design for a new outfit! Better write it down before I forget!
Being alone for so long makes my mind wander to all sorts of things...
Hmm... nothing much to do, maybe I should do some cleaning.

Pretty decent equipment here.
Quite different from my hometown.
I'm bored... Maybe I'll go look for some requests.
Rather than searching for better paying jobs, it'd be faster if they just came to me with them.
Sigh... Why are they being so nice? I've got nothing to offer in return...
Wonder if there's anything good around here worth finding.
There's some delicious tea here. Should I sneak away and enjoy it?
I have plenty of time. Maybe I should give my gun some maintenance?
Ahh... I'm feeling rather sleepy today. At times like these, a nap is just what I need.
Now then, shall I go looking for something cute?
Time spent alone and time spent with cherished companions... both are equally precious.
From seniors to juniors, there are so many wonderful people here. I better not fall behind!
There are so many different kinds of materials used in alchemy...
I wonder where Ryza went? I wanted to chat with her.
I can't think of any new promotional ideas... Maybe I should ask Plachta for advice.
I want to meet more people to network with for my future career.
Time to review today's lessons.
Coming up with new recipes is always so much fun!
This business theory could be useful. I should report it to Klaudia later.
Tomorrow's schedule is... Perfect, everything's in order!
In this age of science, taking on the challenge of running a business using alchemy isn't such a bad idea.
Let's see, I need to prepare that next... I've got so much to do today!
Maybe I should take a little break. After all, rest is part of research too!
I've got a feeling something's going to happen at the academy today. I just hope it's nothing too crazy!
The secret to a peaceful academy life is greeting everyone cheerfully, no matter who they are!
Oh no, I forgot to prepare for the next class! That's not good, but maybe I should skip it...?
I need to procure some equipment... It's necessary for the next experiment.
Everyone seems so busy lately. Is there anything I can help with?
I'm truly grateful to be an exchange student at such a wonderful academy.
Is there anything troubling you? I'm sure I can be of assistance.
I want to make this academy life one where we all get along and stay cheerful together.

There are so many books about alchemy here.
It wouldn't hurt to study them a bit.
Mental work always makes me crave something sweet.
I must make full use of the experience I've gained studying at various schools.
Meeting expectations while pursuing my ideals... I believe that's both right and natural.

"Kitty Team"...
What a cute name... "Kitty"...

If I do this here... and that there...
Ah, I see! That's how it works...!

Hmm, got some time to kill...
Maybe I should do some light exercise.

It's so peaceful~ Since I have time,
maybe I'll do some hammer maintenance.

Ugh! There's way too much to remember about being a knight!
My head hurts!
As a knight, I have to make sure I properly guard Resna's atelier!
I need to stay alert even while waiting. Ready to move at a moment's notice.
I don't have much to do today... Maybe I'll pass the time reading a book.
I should ask Resna to teach me alchemy next time. I want to see just how far my talents can take me.
You know... these peaceful days aren't so bad after all. At least I can catch up on my reading.
It would be irresponsible to let a genius like me just waste away doing nothing.
So access to this place is restricted. Makes for a good spot to hide from enemies.
I'd like to dispose of these sweets... but if others are enjoying them, I should hold back.
This outfit is hard to get used to, but I've made some adjustments to move more freely.
This appears to be something worn during festivals.
Festivals and such... they were never part of my life before. But perhaps... they're not so bad.
There's something calming about being in an atelier.
Perhaps I should organize the materials.
Faster, sharper. My spear won't lose to anyone.
...Ah! I should make sure Totori hasn't gotten mixed up with any troublemakers. I'll go look for her.
I'll make my name known in this world too. I need to leave my mark properly.
Maybe I'll take a little nap.
Let's see, I put my tools over there...
Oh, it's almost snack time for my little hamsters.
I'd love to teach people everything I know about alchemy.
I should write down what I've learned before I forget it.
Which pie should I make for today's snack?
This isn't my atelier, so I need to make sure I don't blow anything up...
Ehehe. I wonder if I can be a little more ladylike today... if that's even possible...
With my charming appeal all dressed up, the cafe is sure to prosper! ...Or so I'd like to think.
Whoa... phew. I'm wearing such pretty clothes. I need to make sure I don't get them dirty!
Phew... Reading a book by myself is so relaxing. Right, Aona?
I should...do some cleaning...
Criselda and Resna... They said we get along well... but I'm still not comfortable around them.
Swimming in the sea... It looks like the Luarca are looking forward to it too.
Even if it's just swimwear, Aona and the others are with me.
This atelier's quality is truly commendable. I would love to have one like this in my castle.
Oh my... This is the first time I've seen this book. May I borrow it for a while?
I specially grant you permission to admire my beautiful swimsuit figure.
The Queen dons a swimsuit. This too shall be another page in the heroic saga.
Strong sunlight is my enemy. I must reapply sunscreen right away...
This place that Saskia created... I'd like to examine it more closely.
It's bustling, but somehow calming. What a mysterious place.
Since I'm wearing a swimsuit, I suppose I should go play in the water. Hehe.
I want to take a good look at everyone's swimsuits. Especially Rorolina Frixell's.
It's nice to see Antje having such a good time. These peaceful moments aren't so bad.
I can't let my guard down even while waiting. I need to be ready to move at a moment's notice.
Nothing to do today... Maybe I'll read a book to pass the time.
Resna said this swimsuit looks cute on me. Heh... It's so obvious that she doesn't need to say it.
This swimsuit's ease of movement is quite appealing. The defense is a bit thin, but that's not a problem!
Back when I was with the Moonlight Society, swimming for fun was naturally out of the question.
This is the wisdom of alchemy...! My heart races with excitement every time I visit!
I wonder if the day will come when I can understand these difficult texts...?
I am one who has received training in the ninja arts since childhood and pledges unwavering loyalty to my master.
To save my master, I would go through fire and water. That is my single-minded devotion.
The "alchemy" that Lady Alvina uses... What a mysterious and wonderful art it is!
Alchemy and onmyoji arts. While they're completely different systems, I can sense something that connects them.
The beauty of these foreign young ladies is quite remarkable... Each has their own unique charm that's hard to rank.
Onmyoji is an ancient official position in Keiun. It's popular because you can do all sorts of interesting things.
I was originally the second son of a warrior family. That's why I can handle a sword to some degree.
"Towa" is my professional name. My real name would be a bit too dignified for an onmyoji.
To share such knowledge so generously... Alchemists are truly magnanimous souls!
This is quite a comfortable place. I'm rather fond of it.
What an interesting place. I'd like to have something similar on my estate.
My wish is for the peace of Keiun's people. May Kaburaya broaden his perspective as a lord and continue to progress.
I understand the value of old things. However, avoiding the new and waiting for decay is the height of folly.
The power to understand and manipulate all phenomena in the world... Alchemy is quite fascinating indeed.
All the foreigners here are so graceful and strong. I wish I could become stronger too...
Um... I'm not very good at speaking... But I do enjoy listening to everyone's stories.
If Kaburaya-sama aims for distant horizons, then I will accompany her anywhere.
Kaburaya-sama is such an upright person. I must make sure I don't get left behind...
Phew. This place really is calming.
Sometimes I think it'd be a lot more fun if I could use alchemy.
These wanderers are such interesting folks. I never get bored around them.
Aw, my usual restaurant is closed. How am I gonna fill this empty stomach of mine...
I don't have anything to do, so I'm pretty bored. Maybe I should tag along with someone who's heading out.
Hmm. Sometimes it's not so bad to forget about my mission and just take a nice, long rest.
Alchemy is always such a wonderful sight to behold! How about it? If you need any help, I'm more than ready to lend a hand!
I hope Nady isn't going hungry. Maybe I should whip up one of my home-cooked meals for her...
This space that Mother created... it has the same sense of security as our own home, doesn't it?
Oh! Today's meal is delicious too! I'm truly grateful! Thank you! Thank you!
Ahh, I still want to play some more!
Staying up late is... bad for your skin...
Well then, another day ahead... Hehe, I'm looking forward to it.
Sometimes it's nice to just relax in your room too.
Phew... Maybe I should go to bed for today...
Huh...? What kind of effects did this herb have again...?
This atelier is filled with so many different memories.
Does this swimsuit suit me? It's a l-little... daring... maybe?
Everyone at Venus looks so beautiful... Do I look a bit more grown-up too?
A festival where you exercise in swimsuits and compete in beauty... It would be fun if it became a new Lantarna tradition.
What should I have for dessert today...?
Hmm... Is it time for snacks yet...? Not yet... not yet...
Aaah... This feels so nice I could fall asleep.
Hehe, I haven't had nearly enough fun yet!
Hmm... Is it time for snacks yet...? Not yet... not yet...
I want to master all the recipes I was taught! First, I should start gathering materials, right?
Ahh, I want to see all sorts of outside worlds! Getting on a ship and going on a journey... My dreams are expanding...!
Hehe! How about it, Alvi's swimsuit look! Feel free to admire me from the front and from the back!
Strong and beautiful! Cute! Dazzling!! Do you like Alvi like this?
A dazzling sky, a vast ocean! A cute swimsuit! At this rate, I have no choice but to spread my wings, right?
Phew. This place really is calming.
Sometimes I think it'd be a lot more fun if I could use alchemy.
These wanderers are such interesting folks. I never get bored around them.
Aw, my usual restaurant is closed. How am I gonna fill this empty stomach of mine...
I don't have anything to do, so I'm pretty bored. Maybe I should tag along with someone who's heading out.
Carrying out the assigned requests is the role of the Moonlight Society. Those who fail to do so have no place in the Society.
People only bow before fear.
I don't jest. Do you want to have your tongue pulled out?
Royalty are nothing but a gathering of corrupt fools.
Those who disturb the Society's order will be eliminated by me.
...I've read almost all the books around here. Not that I can use alchemy, though.
I've found myself with a gap in my schedule... Now then, what should I do to fill the time?
These glasses are my important partner in handling intellectual matters. I must clean them properly.
It's good that everyone is enthusiastic, but... are you all getting proper sleep?
An organized and tidy space is more important than anything. Otherwise, my thoughts become scattered.
Coming here makes me feel like I could have some delicious tea and sweets.
Wanderers are so interesting! I'd love to hear more about their original worlds and other stories.
When you have interesting things happening, every day shines brightly. I wonder what'll happen today?
I'm actually quite the capable merchant, you know. Gathering information is my specialty!
Alvina always reacts so earnestly, so it's really fun to tease her~
Hmm. It's not so bad to forget about my duties once in a while and take a nice, relaxing break.
Alchemy is always so wonderful to watch! Hey, I'm pretty handy if you need help!
I wonder if Nana's gotten hungry. Perhaps I should whip up one of my special dishes for her...
This space that Mother created... It has the same sense of security as our home, doesn't it?
Oh! Today's meal was delicious, too! I must express my gratitude! Thank you! Thank you!
This place that Saskia created... I'd like to investigate it more thoroughly.
It's lively, yet somehow calming. What a mysterious place.
...Hehe. I quite like this outfit. Though I wouldn't mind if it were a bit more daring.
Antje's outfit is adorable too. Since we have the chance, I'd love to see the other girls try them on as well.
Dressing like this makes me feel like new doors are opening. Not a bad experience at all.
Phew... Reading a book by myself is so relaxing. Right, Aona?
I should...do some cleaning...
Ugh. There's so little fabric, it makes me anxious... Criselda said it was cute, though.
Luarca says we should enjoy ourselves while we're here... but I wonder if Resna would wear one with me?
W-Welcome... I wonder if this is okay.
This goes here... and that goes there... Oh, I get it! So that's how it works...!
Ugh, it's so boring just waiting around... Maybe I should get some light exercise in.
Look, look at this outfit! Resna said it looks cute on me!
Ever since I was a kid, I've always wanted to meet the Star Messengers.
If I play my trumpet in this outfit... Yeah! I bet I can bring smiles to everyone's faces!
Hmm...? What kind of effect did this medicinal herb have again...?
This atelier is filled with so many memories.
Since starting this adventure, we've encountered so many things. And here we are, welcoming another new year.
Does this ceremonial kimono suit me? Isn't it a bit too fancy for me?
With renewed spirits, I pray for everyone's happiness... May this be a long and prosperous year.

Even though they're both ateliers, they're completely different!
I guess my atelier back home was a bit special though.
Listening to everyone's stories about their worlds... They're so different, it's crazy!
Ahh, waking up to a hot meal ready and waiting... That's true happiness right there.
El's ears feel so nice to touch... Ahh, it's like touching pure happiness!
Eek! Big sis is calling for me! I just know she's got a lecture waiting for me!
So many different people visit here. Talking with them really helps broaden my horizons and perspective.
Not enough hands to organize the documents? I'll help out if you need me.
Why does Rias always have to be so careless about herself...
Cleaning's done, laundry's done, breakfast is ready. Guess it's about time to wake Rias up...
El can be like that sometimes, but he was my very first friend. I'm grateful for that.
The book collection here is truly magnificent. I wonder if I might reorganize it to my liking...
This alchemy cauldron... I'd love to take my time examining its structure thoroughly...
To think I'd have the opportunity to demonstrate the new possibilities of man-made Apexi in this manner...
This has become a practical application in a direction I never initially anticipated, but that makes it all the more enjoyable.
Though I've left my position as a researcher with the Polar Night Alchemists, in spirit I remain a seeker of knowledge... heh.

character.acquisition_text:
Anything is possible through alchemy.
Shall we find out what we can accomplish together?
character.description: An energetic, tomboyish alchemist who studied alchemy at the academy in a certain town. She now travels across the regions of Lantarna in search of the truth of alchemy. While she is bright and friendly, she can be lazy and a little careless at times. Her tendency to solve problems with bombs has also earned her a reputation as a bomb enthusiast.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Student characters' M. ATK and M. DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Academy Graduate

character.name: Marie
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Marlone from Salburg Academy. I hope my alchemy can be of some assistance.

character.acquisition_text:
Time for a fresh start!
Come on, let's dive in and have some fun!
character.description: An energetic and adventurous alchemist from another world, Marie is one of the wanderers who came to Lantarna. Together with Resna, she has been given the task of handing out good luck charms as part of the New Year's greetings. Adorned in a bright outfit, she sets off to join her friends.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Carefree characters' M. ATK and M. DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: First Job of the New Year

character.name: Marie
character.profile_voice_text: Given the occasion, I might need to fine-tune my bombs to match my new outfit.

character.acquisition_text: Allow me to show you the graceful fighting style of an alchemist! ...By the way, can I use bombs?
character.description: An easygoing and cheerful alchemist. She once studied alchemy at an academy in a certain town, but at that time ended up dropping out. Now a distinguished alchemist, she still tends to get carried away sometimes. She is dressed up ready for a certain tournament and fully expects to win. Will that confidence work in her favor this time?

leader_skill.description: Boosts Promise & Teamwork characters' P. ATK and M. ATK by 35%.
leader_skill.name: Victory Will Be Mine!

character.name: Marie
character.profile_voice_text: This outfit is really easy to move around in. Wearing this, I might even be able to tackle some cleaning... Maybe.

character.acquisition_text: Just leave this to me! I'll clear the way for everyone!
character.description: A cheerful and easygoing alchemist. Though she was once a school dropout known as the Bomberwoman, she has since become a skilled alchemist. This outfit was designed for the battle against the Polar Night Alchemists, making it easier to handle bombs. Thanks to her experience, her bomb synthesis and recipe adjustments are second to none.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Carefree characters' skill damage and stun damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Bomberwoman's Trump Card

character.name: Marie
character.profile_voice_text: When it comes to handling bombs, I'm your girl! Let me show you the fruits of my research!

character.acquisition_text:
Alchemy has infinite possibilities!
Won't you explore them with me?
character.description:
An energetic and spirited alchemist.
She studied alchemy at an academy in a certain town. Currently, she travels across the Lantarna continent in pursuit of alchemical truth.
While cheerful and kind, she can be lazy and hates doing troublesome things.
She has a tendency to try solving problems with explosives, which earned her the nickname "Bomberwoman."

leader_skill.description: Boosts Student characters' M.ATK and M.DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Academy Graduate

character.name: Marie
character.profile_voice_text:
I'm Marlone. I studied at the Academy.
I hope my alchemy can be of help.

character.acquisition_text:
I've been helped by so many people until now.
Now it's my turn to help others!
character.description:
A gentle noblewoman.
As Marie's childhood friend, they share an unparalleled bond. Their relationship remains unchanged in this world - they go gathering materials together, and she even helps clean Marie's room.
While she has a kind and mature personality, she occasionally lets slip a sharp tongue.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Caretaker characters' P.ATK and M.ATK by 40%.
leader_skill.name: Time for Cleaning

character.name: Schea
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Schea. I may not have any special abilities, but if there's anything I can help with, just let me know.

character.acquisition_text:
Sounds like fun.
Heheh. Mind if I come along?
character.description: A free-spirited adventurer who wanders the land looking for fun and interesting things to do. Though she can seem reckless and hard to pin down, she will see any task given to her through to the end. She dislikes cold places, probably because she was born in a warm climate.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Adventurer characters' skill damage and stun damage by 30%.
leader_skill.name: From a Distant Land

character.name: Mu
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Mu. I came from the same world as Marie. Nice to meet you.

character.acquisition_text:
Looking for a bodyguard?
You can count on me!
character.description: A spirited young adventurer who makes his living in the capital by fulfilling all kinds of requests. He is energetic and optimistic. Though he suffered many setbacks at first, he has grown through his experiences.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' skill damage by 30% when there is only one enemy.
leader_skill.name: Work Hard, Earn Big

character.name: Ruven
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Ruven, a run-of-the-mill adventurer. My fee may be cheap, but I work hard for that cole!

character.acquisition_text: I want to become a wonderful alchemist, just like that person. That's my dream.
character.description: A sweet-toothed alchemist. Having been cured of illness as a child through alchemy, she has since devoted herself to its study. While she is serious and precise, she can also get rather flustered at times. A lover of desserts, cheesecakes are a particular weakness of hers.

leader_skill.description: Grants Academy characters Initiative and boosts their M. ATK by 50%.
leader_skill.name: I'm Number One! Yay!

character.name: Elie
character.profile_voice_text: My name is Elfir. I adore sweets. Especially cheesecake!

character.acquisition_text: Is everyone ready? Well then, let's start the lesson!
character.description: An optimistic, tomboyish alchemist who was once involved in the establishment of a school for alchemy in a certain area, but is currently on a journey to rebuild her skills from the ground up. While she is quick to get fired up about things, that personality trait is also her downfall. She loves any and all sweet treats.

leader_skill.description: Grants Bookworm characters a high chance to inflict Paralysis on target for 1 turn after attacking, and boosts their skill damage dealt to paralyzed attack targets by 50%.
leader_skill.name: A Scholar's Discipline

character.name: Lilie
character.profile_voice_text: I still have so much to learn about the alchemy of this world, so teach me whatever you can!

character.acquisition_text:
It must be fate that we've met here!
Take me with you, too!
character.description:
A carefree alchemist.
She travels the world researching ways to create a special item called the Dragon's Hourglass, but has a hard time finding the funds to do so.
She's decisive and doesn't let adversity drag her down. However, her tendency to act without thinking can also land her in trouble.

leader_skill.description: At the start of battle, has a 100% chance to grant all Spirited characters Evasion for 1 attack.
leader_skill.name: Storm Prodigy

character.name: Judie
character.profile_voice_text: I failed at synthesis once and got blasted 200 years into the future.

character.acquisition_text: I won't give up! Whatever setbacks come my way, I'll flip them right around!
character.description: A clumsy alchemist who has been traveling with Keithgriff to gather information about the Dragon Hourglass. Her outfit is designed for frontal assault, supporting her as she charges into battle, relying on her innate ability to make quick decisions.

leader_skill.description: Boosts the critical damage of characters with Fire affinity by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Burnt to a Crisp!

character.name: Judie
character.profile_voice_text: I've got a few tricks up my sleeve for battle. Watch out for them!

character.acquisition_text:
One carrot, two carrots...
Oh, hello! You found me!
character.description: An alchemist from Karotte Village who loves carrots, her hometown's specialty. She grows carrots herself and is always trying to get people to eat more of them. She is very opinionated when it comes to carrots, insisting that one cannot live without them.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Chef characters' P. ATK and M. ATK by 25%.
leader_skill.name: I Love Carrots!

character.name: Viorate
character.profile_voice_text: I just love carrots. I make sure to eat them with every meal!

character.acquisition_text:
If I can be of use...
No, I'm sure I can pull my weight.
character.description:
A student of the alchemy Academy.
Through his time at the Academy, he has reevaluated himself and is now on a journey to find what he wants to do.
Quiet and perhaps a bit too kind-hearted, he sometimes gets caught up in the problems of others. He used to be shy around people but was able to open up with the help of his schoolmates.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' M. ATK by 10%.
leader_skill.name: Artificial Mana

character.name: Vayne
character.profile_voice_text: I'm still not sure what I want to accomplish as an alchemist. But I know I want to help people out.

character.acquisition_text:
Sheesh, things aren't lookin' up for me again.
Sorry, but I'm going to need to tag along.
character.description:
A reserved and direct alchemist.
He used to serve a young lady of a prominent family, but now that he is free, he is on a journey for self-discovery.
Despite seeming unfriendly, he is surprisingly good at taking care of others. He is a capable fighter thanks to the sword skills his grandfather drilled into him at an early age.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' P. ATK by 10%.
leader_skill.name: Combat Arts Department

character.name: Raze
character.profile_voice_text: In my world, I made my living as the servant of a mansion. So, what can I get up to here?

character.acquisition_text:
I might be able to make a new assortment of pies for you!
Please take me along with you!
character.description:
A bright and energetic alchemist.
She has an extraordinary passion for making pies, and is constantly working on her skills so that she can delight people with her pies.
She's a bit clumsy and can be air-headed, but she has a positive outlook and works hard.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' battle item damage by 20% for each Arland character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Go with a Bang!

character.name: Rorona
character.profile_voice_text: Heehee, I love making pies every day. Working at this cafe was the right choice!

character.acquisition_text: Ehehe, I tried changing up my style a bit! Let's get going!
character.description: A bright and energetic alchemist. Headed to an unusually snowy capital, she's bundled up in warmer clothes than usual. While she's a bit worried about whether it suits her, she's still excited about the change in style. She's particularly fond of the fluffy hat.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Seasonal characters' critical damage by 30%.
leader_skill.name: Nice Warm Outfit

character.name: Rorona
character.profile_voice_text:
I'm going for a mature and composed look with this...
Do you think it works?

character.acquisition_text: Welcome to Lantarna Academy! Let's all behave and enjoy school life together!
character.description: A second-year alchemy student at Lantarna Academy who serves as the class president. She's sincere, kind, and can't say no to a student in need. She tries to do it all and live up to her class president role, but her airheaded side peeks out from time to time.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Resleriana Academy characters' skill damage and stun damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Hardworking Class President

character.name: Rorona
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Rorona of Lantarna Academy. If there's anything you'd like to know, you can ask me any time.

character.acquisition_text: Ready for battle! Rorona the alchemist, prepared to give it my all!
character.description: A bright and energetic alchemist. She loves alchemy and is very particular when it comes to pies. She is wearing a functional and sturdy outfit as she works alongside Marie to synthesize bombs in preparation for the battle with the Polar Night Alchemists. Even while synthesizing bombs, her unique ideas never fail to surprise those around her.

leader_skill.description: Whimsical characters restore their own HP by 5% at the start of the turn. Also boosts their skill damage and stun damage by 20%.
leader_skill.name: Pie Meister's Specialty

character.name: Rorona
character.profile_voice_text: This outfit makes me feel like a really capable alchemist, and I think it's rather stylish, too!

character.acquisition_text:
Today's a special day! Won't you join me
to make it a wonderful one?
character.description: A cheerful and energetic alchemist. She usually bakes pies at the cafe Star's Cocoon on the Lantarna continent. Though she can be a bit clumsy and airheaded at times, she's positive and hardworking. While vacationing and sightseeing in Karlston, she dresses up in a cute dress and becomes like a princess from a storybook.

leader_skill.description: Ice affinity characters gain P.DEF and M.DEF +35%.
leader_skill.name: Princess Rorona's Prayer

character.name: Rorona
character.profile_voice_text:
I'm not really used to wearing clothes like this,
so I'm feeling a bit nervous...!

character.acquisition_text:
You're startin' to cheese me off.
Fine, I'll come along if you're that anxious.
character.description: A noblewoman who finds it hard to talk about her feelings. She often worries about her childhood friend, the alchemist Rorona, and tries to take care of her. Though short-tempered, her brusque demeanor belies a loving heart. She is self-conscious about her small size and hates discussing her height.

leader_skill.description: Grants Prim characters a high chance to inflict Poison on target for 1 turn after attacking, and boosts their skill damage dealt to poisoned attack targets by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Hey, How Tall Are You?

character.name: Cordelia
character.profile_voice_text: My name is Cordelia. Looks like I'll have to stay strong here too.

character.acquisition_text:
The best ingredients are the ones you seek out yourself.
Onward to good eats!
character.description:
A passionate chef.
He is in charge of the kitchen at a cafe in the royal capital. His favorite frying pan, which he uses for cooking, at times doubles as a weapon against monsters.
He often accompanied his childhood friend, the alchemist Rorona, on her gathering expeditions, helping her out whenever she messed things up. He has a mature disposition but hates to lose and can become heated in competitions.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Chef characters' skill damage and stun damage by 30%.
leader_skill.name: Handpicked Harvest

character.name: Iksel
character.profile_voice_text: I used to do a lot of cooking in my own world, too. So I think helping at the cafe could be a really worthwhile experience.

character.description: A hardworking former knight who once served the country of Arland. Although he no longer holds the title of knight, he continues to live by his knightly principles, taking on roles such as bodyguard and monster slayer. He's serious and dedicated, but his awkwardness and quiet nature often make people think he is more intimidating than he really is.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Arland characters' skill damage by 30%.
leader_skill.name: Teachings of Chivalry

character.name: Sterk
character.profile_voice_text: In my world, I lost my status as a knight. However, the things I must do remain unchanged.

character.acquisition_text:
Looking for a companion on your journey?
Just leave it to me!
character.description:
A receptionist who worked in the royal palace of a certain kingdom.
She has experience in covert operations and uses her skills to conduct various investigations.
She is talkative, cheerful, and good-natured but worries that she has no life outside her work.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Slash, Strike, and Stab affinity characters' skill damage and stun damage by 20%.
leader_skill.name: Trickster

character.name: Esty
character.profile_voice_text: My name is Esty. In my world, I worked as a palace receptionist. It's nice to meet you!

character.acquisition_text:
There's somewhere I need to go.
Please—you've GOT to take me along!
character.description:
An alchemist from a fishing village.
With the goal of traveling outside the continent, she currently works in the bay area of the royal capital. 
Although she is usually quite gentle, she may sometimes unintentionally demoralize others by speaking her mind without thinking.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Arland characters' P. DEF and M. DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Shadow of the Greatest

character.name: Totori
character.profile_voice_text: I used to be an adventurer back in my world. I'll try to make myself useful around here.

character.acquisition_text: I picked out something a bit different to wear than usual. Let's have a fun outing!
character.description: An alchemist from a fishing village. Hearing that it snowed in the capital, which hardly ever happens, she decided to dress up warmer than usual and head out with Rorona. She chose her outfit for a more composed, mature look, but the sight of the snow brings back her childish heart as she frolics in the snow.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Adventurer characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 15%.
leader_skill.name: Let's Get Dressed Up

character.name: Totori
character.profile_voice_text: How do you think I look in this? I hope I don't look childish...

character.acquisition_text: A sailor, adventurer, and alchemist all in one! Let's go together! To the ends of the world!
character.description: An alchemist who grew up by the sea. She has always dreamed of seeing what lies beyond the horizon, always longing to sail the seas. Now her wish has come true, and she even had her mentor, Rorona, help her prepare new clothes for the journey. She has experience piloting a ship in her original world, and her sailing skills have been approved by Lanze.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Family & Friends characters' burst skill damage by 100%.
leader_skill.name: Strength of a Voyager

character.name: Totori
character.profile_voice_text: Keep her steady! I'm the resident adventurer and alchemist of this ship!

character.acquisition_text:
If my experience can help everyone become stronger,
then I'll always be here to lend a hand!
character.description:
An alchemist from a fishing village.
She collaborated with Resna and her companions to venture beyond the Lantarna continent, fulfilling her long-held dream.
With her knowledge of seafaring, she serves as the captain's first mate.
She tends to speak her mind honestly, sometimes unintentionally discouraging others, but she's been making an effort to be more mindful lately.

leader_skill.description: Arland characters gain M.ATK and M.DEF +40%.
leader_skill.name: Arland's Renowned Adventurer

character.name: Totori
character.profile_voice_text:
I'm Totori. I'm an alchemist and an adventurer.
I'd be happy if I could help everyone out.

character.acquisition_text: Here at Lantarna Academy, I will prove my own worth!
character.description: A new student in the Alchemy department at Lantarna Academy. She is the daughter of a noble who, refusing to rely on her family's influence, passed the academy entrance exams on her own merits. A diligent student, she excels not only in alchemy but also all her other subjects. An exemplary student without fault, she is polite to both her seniors and her classmate Resna.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Arland characters' skill damage and stun damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: The Result of Diligent Practice

character.name: Mimi
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Mimi. I will achieve results I can be proud of as a student of this academy.

character.acquisition_text:
Don't worry.
I'll protect your back.
character.description:
An adventurer and Totori's friend.
At Totori's request, she accompanies her on her journey.
She has immense pride and takes great honor in her family name.
Though she carries herself like a proper lady, she becomes quite flustered whenever Totori is mentioned.

leader_skill.description: All allies gain 20% skill damage and stun damage for each Arland character.
leader_skill.name: Noble Daughter of Arland

character.name: Mimi
character.profile_voice_text:
I'm Mimi. In my world, I was quite well-known
as an adventurer, you know?

character.acquisition_text:
You don't need to call for me to come running!
Meruru the alchemist, at your service!
character.description: A princess turned alchemist. Though she was once next in line to the throne of a certain country, she now travels the land freely. Her dream is to accomplish something great with her alchemy. She is cheerful and proactive to a fault, and often ends up acting without thinking things through.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' battle item damage by 20% for each Spirited character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Positive Thinking Princess

character.name: Meruru
character.profile_voice_text: Everyone calls me Meruru. Nice to meet you.

character.acquisition_text: It's almost time for the party! Come on, let's go!
character.description: A princess turned alchemist. She turned her back on everything she knew, setting out on a grand adventure, to accomplish something even greater with alchemy. As a former royal, she is no stranger to fashionable clothing, but her energetic nature means that she'll rush headlong into her tasks without a care for how dirty her dress gets.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Prim characters' M. ATK and M. DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Charming Royalty

character.name: Meruru
character.profile_voice_text: I may not be a princess anymore, but I haven't forgotten my manners!

character.acquisition_text:
Your pain, your suffering...
I'll heal it all away!
character.description:
A soft-hearted, compassionate alchemist.
She makes medicines for residents suffering from injuries and illnesses, and takes care of Valeria, who is often covered in wounds.
She is friendly and has a gentle nature, but can be a bit of an airhead. She is very curious and is quick to act when something interests her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' stun damage by 10%.
leader_skill.name: Garden of Memories

character.name: Ayesha
character.profile_voice_text: I used to work as an apothecary, so leave the medicine to me.

character.acquisition_text:
So long as there are people in need of medicine,
I'm happy to serve as your apothecary!
character.description: A warmhearted alchemist with a calming presence. Thanks to an incident that gave her the chance to display her knowledge of medicine, she now works as an apothecary in the royal palace. This is the outfit she was given for her new role. Though her position and attire have changed, her kind and sisterly nature remains the same as always.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Bolt affinity characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 10%.
leader_skill.name: Royal Apothecary

character.name: Ayesha
character.profile_voice_text:
This was my first time ever inside a castle.
I hope my outfit doesn't look 
too out of place...

character.acquisition_text: Are you injured? Let me heal you up!
character.description: A gentle alchemist with a soothing touch. In preparation for the upcoming battle against the Polar Night Alchemists, she has joined the medical team that prepares restorative medicines. This outfit was a gift from Roman to help her perform her duties more comfortably. Despite her calm and relaxed demeanor, she has the courage to dive into dangerous places to gather ingredients for her medicine.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Whimsical characters' skill damage and stun damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Secret Elixir of Strength

character.name: Ayesha
character.profile_voice_text: Wearing this outfit helps me feel focused. I'll make sure to fulfill my duties and not let anyone down!

character.acquisition_text:
You seek my power? Very well!
Entrust your needs to the Great Witch, Wilbell!
character.description: A young witch. She journeys far and wide for her training, aiming to one day become a powerful magician just like her revered great-great grandmother. Full of vigor and zeal, she can sometimes be a little childish, and other times she takes on an air of grandeur.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Spirited characters' skill damage and stun damage by 30%.
leader_skill.name: Great Witch Wilbell

character.name: Wilbell
character.profile_voice_text: Oh! Make sure not to tell anyone I can use magic!

character.acquisition_text: An infiltration mission? Leave it to me! I'll light up the way to success with my magic!
character.description: A young witch who aspires to become a full-fledged Great Witch. She often takes on a haughty attitude, but she has a kind heart and a lovable, cheerful personality. Although she tries to hide her identity as a witch, she actually dresses like one to avoid suspicion. She is particularly fond of this outfit, which allows her to blend perfectly into the darkness—ideal for a witch.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all Justice & Exploration characters' critical damage by 35%, and they restore own HP by 5% when hit by an attack.
leader_skill.name: Danger? No Problem

character.name: Wilbell
character.profile_voice_text: I already live my life hiding my true identity as a witch. Infiltration will be a breeze for me!

character.acquisition_text:
Just leave it to me!
I'll uncover an incredible treasure, just you watch!
character.description: A skilled excavation expert. An old acquaintance of Ayesha and her sister Nio, she acts as a sort of guardian to them, often accompanying them on their adventures. She is caring and dependable. While skilled in manual labor, she also has a homier side, excelling at cooking and sewing.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' P. ATK by 7% for each Nurturer character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Big Family's Big Sister

character.name: Regina
character.profile_voice_text: Regina the Prospector is here for all your treasure-hunting needs! Hehe.

character.acquisition_text:
If you're looking for a bodyguard, look no further.
I won't let the enemy lay a finger on you.
character.description: A simple and honest swordswoman. She is an accomplished warrior and has been trained in the art of combat since childhood. She puts her training to good use by working as a bodyguard. While her sword skills are impressive, she lacks common sense and basic survival skills, often causing concern for those around her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Slash affinity characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 10%.
leader_skill.name: Trust in My Sword

character.name: Linca
character.profile_voice_text: I'm pretty confident in my sword skills. And I'm even stronger after a good meal.

character.acquisition_text: A new mission? Excellent, leave it to me! Huh? You want me to wear this outfit?
character.description: An experienced swordswoman. She has exceptional fighting skills and is often asked by Marion and others to serve as their bodyguard. She's serious and straightforward, and would rather wear nothing than dress up. At first she was reluctant to wear this armor, but after experiencing its functionality, she's come to appreciate it to a certain degree.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' Burn resistance by 100% and boosts their skill damage by 50% when their attack target is burning.
leader_skill.name: Crimson Swordswoman

character.name: Linca
character.profile_voice_text: According to Marion, this armor combines style with functionality.

character.acquisition_text:
I want to be useful to everyone...
Just like my big sis!
character.description: An apprentice apothecary. She is the younger sister of the alchemist Ayesha. She often spends her time helping her sister or heading out to investigate ruins. Unlike her light-hearted sister, Nio has a much more serious personality. This often leads her to work too hard and worry those around her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' skill damage and stun damage by 7% for each Diligent character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Dependable

character.name: Nio
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Nio, Ayesha Altugle's little sister! We're both happy to be here.

character.acquisition_text:
Another new job?
Fine... Just leave it to me!
character.description:
A talented investigator and a dedicated worker.
She is interested in the phenomenon of "wanderers" appearing in this world, and is currently investigating it. She often complains about her work, but she is a diligent worker who always completes her tasks.
Her strong will helps her overcome any and all adversity.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Colseit characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 15%.
leader_skill.name: Official's Spirit

character.name: Marion
character.profile_voice_text: My name is Marion Quinn. I spend most of my time on investigative missions.

character.acquisition_text: I can't just leave everything to the development team. I need to step up and help!
character.description: A diligent worker who investigates wanderers. Saskia has also entrusted her with management of the atelier. Due to her strong administrative skills and constant perseverance, more and more work is always sent her way. Since her arms are always covered with ink from all the documents she works on, this outfit with arm covers has proven to be very practical for her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Diligent characters' P. DEF and M. DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Slow and Steady

character.name: Marion
character.profile_voice_text: I was the head of the development team in my world. Taking on too much work is a bad habit of mine.

character.acquisition_text:
Do let me know if I can be of any assistance.
I'm a top-of-the-line automata, after all.
character.description: A high-performance automaton created in ancient times. She once worked as an assistant to a certain alchemist, but now travels on her own. She may not display much emotion, but she loves sweets and can show a strong attachment to them.

leader_skill.description: Grants Sweets characters a high chance to inflict Paralysis on target for 1 turn after attacking, and boosts their skill damage dealt to paralyzed attack targets by 50%.
leader_skill.name: You'll Get Cavities!

character.name: Odelia
character.profile_voice_text: I am Odelia, a high-performance automaton created in the distant past.

character.acquisition_text:
Come along, or don't—it makes no difference to me.
I've got my own business that needs handling.
character.description:
An alchemist in pursuit of truth.
He is interested in the history of alchemy on the continent of Lantarna and is conducting research in various regions. He is a skilled alchemist, but his techniques are a little rough.
He prefers people who seek answers on their own and has no time for those who look for easy solutions.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Quiet characters' skill damage by 35% when attack target is stunned.
leader_skill.name: Truth is Something You Seek and Seize

character.name: Keithgriff
character.profile_voice_text: This world is so intriguing. Maybe I can find what I've been searching for here.

character.acquisition_text:
If you think my abilities can be of any help,
please take me along with you!
character.description:
A bright and earnest alchemist.
She used to work as a government official, conducting research projects in undeveloped areas. Currently, she travels around the continent with her former colleagues.
She is polite and diligent in everything she does. Her dream is to make people happy using alchemy.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Colseit characters' P. ATK and M. ATK by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Development Team's Super Energetic Girl

character.name: Escha
character.profile_voice_text: I used to work for the government back home. I think my experience will come in handy!

character.acquisition_text:
Welcome home, Master!
H-How was that? Am I doing it right?
character.description: A cheerful and earnest alchemist. In the Kingdom of Lantarna, there's an annual event called the Linde Festival, where people gift chocolates to their loved ones. Escha has been selected to liven up the event, chosen for her experience in making treats. Dressed in an outfit perfect for the occasion, she begins her efforts to spice up the Linde Festival. She's also planning to give her own chocolates to someone very special!

leader_skill.description: Boosts Chef characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 15%.
leader_skill.name: Say "Aah"!

character.name: Escha
character.profile_voice_text: This outfit is really cute, but do you think it looks okay on me?

character.acquisition_text: A job request? Of course! Just leave it to me!
character.description: A hardworking and earnest alchemist. In her original world, she was a government official working under Marion. Even now, Marion often asks her for help. She is not very good at paperwork, but she finds that she gets more of it done than usual when she wears this outfit that Marion prepared for her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Colseit characters' skill damage and stun damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Ready to Help!

character.name: Escha
character.profile_voice_text: Wearing this outfit makes me feel ready for anything. I'll do my best to meet expectations!

character.acquisition_text:
Our meeting here must be destiny.
Let me help you in achieving your dreams.
character.description:
A kind and caring alchemist.
He is a user of the "Alchemic Sword", which is a combination of swordsmanship and alchemy. He travels the world, interested in all unexplored regions.
He may come across as aloof, but a passionate dream burns inside his heart.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' skill damage by 10%.
leader_skill.name: Central-Trained Leadership

character.name: Logy
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Logy. I worked for the government in development back in my world.

character.acquisition_text: I want to support those who journey directly toward their dreams.
character.description:
A kindhearted and caring alchemist.
He is interested in the unexplored territories of this world and is investigating the Apexi that plague them. In the process, he ends up assisting the Royal Knights, donning an outfit similar to their own.
Impressed by Juna's chivalry, he has resolved to fight for the people.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Knight characters' M. ATK and M. DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Dusk Knight

character.name: Logy
character.profile_voice_text: I'm assisting this country's knights, so I changed my outfit. Just enough to not stand out too much, though.

character.acquisition_text:
Your dreams...
Let me help you make them all come true!
character.description:
An alchemist on a mission for her family.
The mana shortage on this continent seems to be similar to the situation in her hometown, which is experiencing a water shortage, and she is traveling to find clues that will save her hometown.
She is responsible, courageous, and hard-working, though she can sometimes be a bit stubborn.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all Promise & Teamwork characters' skill damage and stun damage by 30%.
leader_skill.name: Strong Will

character.name: Shallistera
character.profile_voice_text: I have to do whatever it takes to save my hometown.

character.acquisition_text:
Y-You think this suits me?
Ehehe, thanks. Come on, let's go!
character.description: An alchemist on an important mission from her village. She's best friends with Shallotte, another alchemist, and together they've faced many challenges in their world. This outfit was chosen to complement Shallotte's. She's excited about the idea of going on adventures with her best friend in this new world.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Fire affinity characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 10%.
leader_skill.name: Like the Sun

character.name: Shallistera
character.profile_voice_text:
I don't usually wear cute outfits like this...
but do you think it looks okay on me?

character.acquisition_text:
Hmm? It's my turn?
Finally my time to shine!
character.description: An alchemist with grand ambitions. She met Shallistera in her hometown of Stellard, and they became best friends while spending time together. She's driven by the desire to accomplish something great in this world. While she's always cheerful and energetic, her impulsiveness sometimes leads her into trouble.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Energetic characters' skill damage by 50% when attack target is stunned.
leader_skill.name: Born Optimist

character.name: Shallotte
character.profile_voice_text:
Got a problem? Bring it to Alchemist Shallotte!
I'll sort it out in a jiffy!

character.description: Shallotte's mother. She's usually the quiet support behind her daughter, but every now and then she embarks on an adventure of her own. She's incredibly kind and always puts Shallotte first, showing unwavering faith in her daughter. Despite her calm and collected exterior, she's surprisingly courageous.

leader_skill.description: All allies restore own HP by 3% after using a skill.
leader_skill.name: Gift of Sweets

character.name: Nady
character.profile_voice_text:
I'm Nady Elminus. I hope you'll be kind
to me and my daughter Shallotte.

character.acquisition_text: Tell me what your wildest dreams are!
character.description: A somewhat childish alchemist. Determined to help others through alchemy, she journeys far and wide, assisting those she comes across. Her sunny disposition puts people around her at ease, but she is rather sloppy when it comes to her own personal space. If she can turn a blind eye to whatever cleaning needs to be done, she will.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Kirchen Bell characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 15%.
leader_skill.name: Top Gourmet

character.name: Sophie
character.profile_voice_text: Our alchemy works by listening to the voices of the materials and granting their wishes.

character.acquisition_text: Wanna learn alchemy, you say? My training is tough—can you keep up?
character.description: A second-year student in the Alchemy department at Lantarna Academy. She runs a place she inherited from her grandmother called the Sunshine Society, where she takes care of outcasts. Although they affectionately call her "Boss," she doesn't quite agree with the title. Her peculiar attire might make her look intimidating, but she's actually kindhearted and cares deeply for her friends.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' P. ATK and M. ATK by 8% for each Kirchen Bell character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Grandma's Alchemy Training

character.name: Sophie
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Sophie. Everyone calls me boss, but you don't need to be scared, 'kay?

character.acquisition_text: My alchemy is here to help everyone. I'll protect your dreams too!
character.description: A cheerful and lively alchemist. She is assisting Ayesha in preparing restorative medicines for the battle against the Polar Night Alchemists. This outfit was a gift from Roman to help her perform her duties more comfortably. She takes great joy in using alchemy to help others and finds immense fulfillment in her work.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Justice & Exploration characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 30%.
leader_skill.name: I'll Help Those in Pain!

character.name: Sophie
character.profile_voice_text: This outfit symbolizes the expectations placed on me. I have to do everything I can to live up to them!

character.acquisition_text: The road to becoming an alchemist isn't traveled in a day. So, you should come with me!
character.description: An alchemist with a doll's body. While she was human, certain circumstances required her to migrate her soul into another vessel. Sophie, a fellow alchemist, is both her pupil and her best friend. Her personality is generally a combination of sedate and serious, but she has a surprisingly excitable side.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Mentor characters' skill damage and stun damage by 30%.
leader_skill.name: Knowledge of Everything

character.name: Plachta
character.profile_voice_text: I've lost so much. The only reason I'm able to be here at all is thanks to Sophie.

character.acquisition_text:
Everything in life is a challenge.
So come on, let's go collect some sweets!
character.description: An alchemist who transferred her soul into a doll. The doll's body requires regular maintenance, which is usually done by Sophie. Updating her outfit and parts during this maintenance allows for various changes to Plachta's abilities. This outfit specializes in mischief, and when combined with the creativity fostered by alchemy, it is great at surprising those around her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Kirchen Bell characters' skill damage and stun damage by 30%.
leader_skill.name: Time for Mischief

character.name: Plachta
character.profile_voice_text:
In this outfit, I seem more suited
to practicing magic than alchemy.

character.acquisition_text:
New discoveries, new encounters—
What an incredibly fascinating world!
character.description:
A young, ambitious alchemist.
She devotes herself day and night to research in pursuit of mastering alchemy. Intrigued by this world's alchemy as well, she often buries herself in books at the atelier.
Though she's a cool-headed theorist, she has a prideful side and hates to lose. Her eyes light up like a child's when faced with new discoveries.

leader_skill.description: Characters with Ice as their favored element receive 25% less damage.
leader_skill.name: I'll Protect You with This Shield!

character.name: Plachta
character.profile_voice_text: There are so many things in this world I've never seen before. How absolutely fascinating!

character.acquisition_text:
I've meticulously crafted my theories—
Now, let me prove their validity to you.
character.description: An exchange student from ACSE Business School. A logical thinker with extensive knowledge of business management from ancient to modern times, specializing in data-driven strategy development. Despite being a student, she has received numerous advisory offers from companies and has gained idol-like popularity in certain business circles as a young genius.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' P.ATK and M.ATK by 10% for each Resleriana Academy character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Learn Together

character.name: Plachta
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Plachta, an exchange student here. Let's learn and grow together.

character.acquisition_text:
If you have any troubles, let me know.
I'll do what I can to help.
character.description:
A talented young woman who is skilled in both the literary and military arts.
She used to be a very reserved and self-disciplined person, but with the encouragement of her friend Sophie, she is now traveling the world to do all the things she wants to do.
She is a diligent, methodical person who can't see a dirty room without wanting to tidy it.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Stab affinity characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 10%.
leader_skill.name: Goddess's Shield

character.name: Monika
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Monika. I usually help out at a church and take care of the kids.

character.acquisition_text: Expect our store to keep getting better for you all. Come visit!
character.description: A young alchemist and merchant who excels at using alchemy to copy items, which helps her run her wholesale store.
