Corneria devotes her days to forging new connections with other merchants, hoping to further expand her market. She is close friends with another merchant named Flocke. Although she is laid-back and takes things at her own pace, she has good business sense and takes her work very seriously.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Merchant characters' P. DEF and M. DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Rare Products, Right Here!

character.name: Corneria
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Corneria. I sell plenty of goods and I can even replicate tools.

character.acquisition_text: When it comes to plants, you can rely on me! As for fighting... I'll do what I can.
character.description: A young man with the peculiar ability to hear the voices of plants. He travels across the land in an effort to speak with every plant he comes across. He keeps careful notes on everything the plants tell him. With an easy-going personality, he doesn't like to worry about the little details, but does get very excited when it comes to plants.

leader_skill.description: Laid-back characters restore own HP by 10% when hit by an attack.
leader_skill.name: Reliable Oskar

character.name: Oskar
character.profile_voice_text: I want to become friends with plants all over the world someday!

character.acquisition_text:
Heehee! Not to worry, just let
Tess take care of the rest!
character.description: A bright and cheerful woman who wears a distinctive bunny ears hair accessory. She currently works at a cafe in the capital and sees the other cafes in the town square as rivals. She spends much of her time running around trying to attract customers. She has a pure and optimistic heart, but can sometimes be careless and cause unintentional chaos.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Sweets characters' P. DEF and M. DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Cafe Poster Girl

character.name: Tess
character.profile_voice_text: Hello, my name is Tess Heitzmann. Just call me Tess. I work at the cafe.

character.acquisition_text:
New places and new faces...
That's what makes the journey worth it!
character.description:
An alchemist who loves to travel.
From a very young age, she has longed to see the world outside, and even now she is excited by the prospect of adventures in the unknown. She has a friendly and energetic personality.  She has a strong spirit that does not bend to adversity.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Air affinity characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 10%.
leader_skill.name: Traveler of Wind

character.name: Firis
character.profile_voice_text: There are so many things I want to do... So I decided I'll do them all!

character.acquisition_text: Now's our chance to strike back! Let's hit them with everything we've got, full force!
character.description: An alchemist who loves to travel. Just like Resna, she hopes to bring happiness to all through alchemy, and with that in mind she stands alongside her companions, defending everyone from the Apexi. She has a quirky habit of naming things in her own unique way and is currently thinking up a special nickname for her new armor.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' P. ATK and M. ATK by 8% for each Adventure character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Traveler Cloaked in Jet Black

character.name: Firis
character.profile_voice_text: The Apexi are incredibly powerful, but I have a feeling that together, we can win!

character.acquisition_text:
Now then, are you ready?
Let me invite you on a mysterious journey!
character.description:
An alchemist who loves to travel.
Her ribbon was prepared by her sister Liane so she could match with Ilmeria, who is both her rival and friend.
Apparently, wearing this ribbon makes her feel confident that she's a genius alchemist.

leader_skill.description: Characters with Air as their favored element deal 50% more skill damage when their attack target is stunned.
leader_skill.name: Let the Ribbon Dance in the Wind

character.name: Firis
character.profile_voice_text:
This ribbon is super cute and I love it!
It goes all fluffy when I move, fluffy fluffy♪

character.acquisition_text:
Time for this genius to make her entrance!
I'll show you just what my talent can do!
character.description: A young alchemist who proclaims herself a genius. She travels across the Lantarna continent helping people with her alchemy to make her abilities known. She shares a competitive yet close friendship with Firis, considering her both a rival and her best friend. Though she can be prideful and childish at times, she's a hard worker who approaches alchemy with genuine dedication.

leader_skill.description: Characters whose favored element is Air gain P. DEF and M. DEF +10% and deal 50% more skill damage to stunned targets.
leader_skill.name: How About Some First-Class Help?

character.name: Ilmeria
character.profile_voice_text:
I'm Ilmeria!
A genius alchemist acknowledged by everyone!

character.acquisition_text:
"Act first, worry later!"
Let's go in search of our dreams together.
character.description: The older of the Twin Alchemists. She travels together with her sister, Suelle, striving to become an alchemist that everyone can turn to. She tries to help her sister as an older sister should, but often ends up being dragged along by her instead. She's laid-back and takes things at her own pace. She likes to study and has a good understanding of the world around her, but her artistic sensibilities are questionable at best.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Earnest Listener characters' skill damage and stun damage by 30%.
leader_skill.name: Wise and Gentle Sister

character.name: Lydie
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Lydie. I'm not good at anything active... Oh! But you can leave the research to me!

character.acquisition_text: Everything will be alright because we're all together! We'll make sure everyone is safe!
character.description: The older of the twin alchemists. Alongside her sister Suelle, she's traveled far and wide. Aiming to be an alchemist that everyone can turn to, she has stepped up to confront the Apexi to show that she is ready to live up to those expectations. More cautious and methodical than her sister, she's ready to take on even the strongest of foes, drawing courage from her wealth of experience.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Laid-back characters' skill damage and stun damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Smiling Natural Idol

character.name: Lydie
character.profile_voice_text: Suelle and I will do everything we can to make sure that we can all take down the Apexi together!

character.acquisition_text:
"Don't give up before you try!"
Let's go in search of a new ambition together.
character.description: The younger of the Twin Alchemists. She travels together with her sister, Lydie, striving to become an alchemist that everyone can turn to. She cherishes a promise she made with her mother when she was young. She's mischievous and boisterous, but a genius with diverse abilities. She also can't stand insects or ghosts.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Strike affinity characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 10%.
leader_skill.name: Energetic Little Sister

character.name: Suelle
character.profile_voice_text: Got a problem? Just leave it to Suelle the genius! I can solve any problem!

character.acquisition_text: With this, we can't lose! We'll defeat any enemy that stands in our way!
character.description: The younger of the Twin Alchemists. She travels together with her sister, Lydie. During their travels, they learned of the Apexi threat and were the first to respond to the call to deal with it. Compared to her sister, she tends to be more reckless and acts on emotion. In the battle against the Apexi, she aims to contribute with her signature style and decisiveness.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Earnest Listener characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 30%.
leader_skill.name: Mischievous Little Devil Idol

character.name: Suelle
character.profile_voice_text: This time I am the goddess of victory! Not even an Apexi will be a match for me!

character.acquisition_text:
I'm so excited!
Onward, to a new adventure!
character.description:
An alchemist who loves adventure.
After she rescued Resna from a monster attack, they often go on adventures together. She has a free-spirited personality and usually acts before worrying. She has a strong sense of justice that does not bend easily.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Kurken Island characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 15%.
leader_skill.name: Our Secret Hideout

character.name: Ryza
character.profile_voice_text: It's so much fun working at the cafe! I get to hear all sorts of interesting things!

character.acquisition_text:
There are still so many things in the world I don't know about!
The excitement never ends!
character.description:
An alchemist who loves adventure.
Her outfit is inspired by the one always worn by her mentor, Empel, who taught her alchemy. As she continues to train, Ryza aspires to one day match and even surpass him in skill.
While wearing this outfit, she apparently has an irresistible craving for sweet things.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' skill damage by 15% when attack target is stunned.
leader_skill.name: This Time, I'll Teach You

character.name: Ryza
character.profile_voice_text:
The outfit's design is based on my mentor's outfit!
Does it suit me?

character.acquisition_text: Life is boring if it's the same every day. Let's go find something fun to do together!
character.description: A second-year student in the Alchemy department at Lantarna Academy. Her humble personality allows her to make friends with anyone. As a senior, she watches over the new students warmly, making sure there are no barriers between her and them. Coming from a farmer's family, she receives an excessive amount of vegetables from home, so she always tries to cook healthy dishes for everyone.

leader_skill.description: Grants Kurken Island characters Initiative and boosts their skill damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Vegetables Keep You Full of Energy!

character.name: Ryza
character.profile_voice_text: This excitement in my heart! I feel like something amazing is going to happen today!

character.acquisition_text: Across the seas to a world unknown—let's go see it together!
character.description: A free-spirited young alchemist who is full of curiosity. She has donned a dazzling swimsuit and jumped into a fresh new summer. The headband, reminiscent of her usual hat, is her favorite little detail. The sparkling sandy beach reflecting the sun makes her outfit look even more striking!

leader_skill.description: Boosts Kurken Island characters' skill damage by 75% when attack target is stunned.
leader_skill.name: Great Adventurer at the Beach

character.name: Ryza
character.profile_voice_text: All set for swimming! I'm going to gather all sorts of materials from the seafloor!

character.acquisition_text: I'll stand and fight with everyone to protect the places I love!
character.description: An adventurous alchemist who usually works at the Star's Cocoon Cafe in the capital, gathering information on the side. Her outfit is both light and durable, allowing for agile movement. Following her sense of justice, she supports Resna and the others in their fight against the Polar Night Alchemists.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Spirited characters' P. ATK and M. ATK by 10% and skill damage and stun damage by 30%.
leader_skill.name: I'll Break Through!

character.name: Ryza
character.profile_voice_text: I'm ready to fight. I'll do my best to meet everyone's expectations!

character.acquisition_text:
Looks like there's still a whole world out there I don't know about!
Let's go discover new sights together!
character.description: An adventure-loving alchemist. She used to work at the cafe, Star's Cocoon, in the capital of the Lantarna Kingdom, but has set off in search of new grand adventures. Her heart leaps at the thought of traveling with her beloved companions, including her close friend Klaudia and her junior alchemist Resna.

leader_skill.description: Characters whose favored element is Stab gain P. ATK +40%
leader_skill.name: Adventure Comes When You Least Expect It!

character.name: Ryza
character.profile_voice_text:
If you've got any problems,
leave them to Reisalin Stout!

character.acquisition_text: I would very much like to go on another adventure with everyone. Please, let me join you!
character.description: The young lady of a merchant household, she helps the peddlers and caravans around the capital go about their business. Her childhood friend, Ryza, works at the cafe. For as gentle-natured as she is, Klaudia is both stubborn and courageous. One of her hobbies is playing the flute, which she excels at.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Ice affinity characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 10%.
leader_skill.name: Frozen Dance

character.name: Klaudia
character.profile_voice_text: I'm only just getting started as a merchant, but I'll work hard to be of use to everyone.

character.acquisition_text: Sorry, it took some time to get ready. Huh? It looks good on me? Oh, you. Thanks.
character.description: The only daughter of a merchant. Business acumen runs in the family, and she uses hers to help out other merchants. She bought this outfit at a market she visited on business, where it was love at first sight. She's quite daring, despite her refined demeanor, and she won't hesitate to take a cold plunge to reach the post-sauna state of true relaxation.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Kurken Island characters' skill damage and stun damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Let's Enjoy the Hot Springs!

character.name: Klaudia
character.profile_voice_text: It's my first time wearing this outside... Something about it makes my heart race!

character.acquisition_text: Even the deep ocean isn't scary as long as we're together. Come on, let's go!
character.description: The only daughter of a merchant family. She has been traveling with a caravan introduced to her by her close friend Ryza, honing her skills daily. This time, she's stepped out of her comfort zone with a more mature swimsuit. Her heart is filled with excitement for another great summer with Ryza and the others.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Seasonal characters' M. ATK by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Beachside Allure

character.name: Klaudia
character.profile_voice_text: Maybe this outfit is a bit much? But I guess it'll be nothing compared to Ryza anyway.

character.acquisition_text:
It's amazing that there are worlds we've never seen before!
Would you like to go together?
character.description: A merchant's daughter and capable businesswoman. She provides support to traveling merchants across various regions. Though she finds fulfillment in her busy daily life, she feels lonely about rarely getting to spend time with her close friend Ryza. She strongly desires to embark on another grand adventure with Ryza and watches for any opportunity to do so.

leader_skill.description: All allies gain P. ATK and M. ATK +10% for each Kurken Island character in the party
leader_skill.name: Memories of That Summer Close to Heart

character.name: Klaudia
character.profile_voice_text:
I'm so excited about our journey to new lands!
Let's have a fun adventure together.

character.acquisition_text:
Nice to meet you! Are you a student at this academy?
Would you like to be friends?
character.description: An exchange student from ACSE Business School. As the daughter of a famous company president, she studies business management to eventually succeed her father's work. With her friendly personality, she excels at creating promotional strategies that connect with people's emotions. She forms an excellent partnership with her classmate Plachta, each complementing the other's weaknesses.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' M.ATK and M.DEF by 10% for each Resleriana Academy character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Will You Be My Friend?

character.name: Klaudia
character.profile_voice_text: As a businesswoman's daughter, I always keep myself well-informed. Don't hesitate to come to me if you need anything!

character.acquisition_text:
You want to become stronger? Very well,
I'll drill the spirit of a warrior into you!
character.description:
A traveling warrior with an enigmatic aura.
Utilizing her exceptional combat skills, she takes on jobs such as bodyguard missions.
She has traveled extensively with the alchemist Empel.
She has a surprisingly nurturing side to her, despite her calm, collected, and somewhat unsociable demeanor.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Mentor characters' M. ATK and M. DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Warrior's Oath

character.name: Lila
character.profile_voice_text:
I am Lila Decyrus of the Whitefang clan.
A warrior of the Oren race.

character.acquisition_text:
Even warriors need rest sometimes.
—Want to join me?
character.description:
A mysterious wandering warrior.
She has traveled alongside the alchemist Empel for a long time.
While blunt in personality, she has a caring side.
Her attire is connected to Keiun culture and is traditionally worn during festivals.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Air affinity characters' P.DEF and M.DEF by 35%.
leader_skill.name: Wrapped in Spirit Winds

character.name: Lila
character.profile_voice_text:
A warrior of the White Fang clan in festival attire...
Life can be interesting if you live it long enough.

character.acquisition_text:
I'm here to help if it's needed.
Let me show you what I can do!
character.description: An adventurer who fights with a massive sword. He spends most of his days training and fighting, and hopes to one day make a name for himself as a warrior. His stern exterior belies a warm, friendly heart, and he provides a level head to the often chaotic Ryza.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Dragon Slayer characters' P. DEF and M. DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Island's Best Warrior

character.name: Lent
character.profile_voice_text: I don't know much about alchemy, so my job is to get stronger and protect everyone!

character.acquisition_text:
I've never heard or seen of anything like this!
What an incredible place!
character.description: A book-loving boy. His interest in the history of Lantarna and its ruins leads him to spend most of his time in the capital's library, reading up on obscure knowledge. He is quiet and shy, often reluctant to interact with people. His intellectual curiosity and powers of concentration are a cut above the rest.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Glasses characters' skill damage and stun damage by 30%.
leader_skill.name: Bibliophile

character.name: Tao
character.profile_voice_text: My name is Tao. Tao Mongarten. Nice to meet you.

character.acquisition_text:
It's the duty of the older generation to give a push when needed.
Come on, all of you! Give it your best shot!
character.description:
A wandering alchemist.
He investigates ruins throughout the land, all with a specific goal in mind. He once met Ryza and her companions on an island while on an investigation and joined them in their endeavors for awhile. Although he appears young, he is mature in his speech and actions, giving him a mysterious air of authority.
He also has a notable sweet tooth.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Bookworm characters' P. ATK and P. DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Preacher of Knowledge

character.name: Empel
character.profile_voice_text:
The misuse of alchemy
for nefarious deeds...
If true, the intent behind this must be carefully evaluated.

character.acquisition_text:
Then, as a sign of our friendship--
Perhaps I should also dress up a bit?
character.description: A wandering alchemist who taught Ryza alchemy. Though he has deep ties with Lara of the Polar Night Alchemists, they have now formed a cooperative relationship. As proof of their friendship, she gifted him this outfit. Being an extreme sweet tooth, he can't forget the taste of the pastries Lara once treated him to, and hopes to taste them again.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' P. ATK and M. ATK by 10% for each Mentor character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Inherited Knowledge

character.name: Empel
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Empel. This outfit was given to me as a sign of friendship. I must say, it's quite pleasing.

character.acquisition_text:
Got it. I know everyone's looking forward
to this, so I'll see it through to the end!
character.description: A girl dressed in a Starbirth Festival outfit. She is known as Patty to her close friends. She's an acquaintance of Ryza and Tao. Wanting to give back to those who helped her, she decided to become a Starbirth Envoy along with Resna. Raised in a good family, she is earnest and polite. Having been taught by her father, who was a knight, she is skilled with the sword.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Seasonal characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 15%.
leader_skill.name: Starbirth Festival's Gift

character.name: Patricia
character.profile_voice_text:
My role is to make people smile.
I've made up my mind, so I'm going to see it through to the end!

character.acquisition_text: To the ends of the world or bust! Let's head out!
character.description:
A fledgling alchemist. She is very passionate about alchemy and has an unparalleled love and knowledge of the subject, which is evident in her tendency to get excited and talk very fast.
Her dream is to revive the neglected art of alchemy and use it to enrich people's lives.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' battle item damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Alchemy Enthusiast

character.name: Resna
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Resna. I'm working really hard to catch up to the other alchemists!

character.acquisition_text:
I'll overcome anything to make my dream
come true—no matter the obstacle!
character.description: A fledgling alchemist. Following the instructions of her teacher, Saskia, she usually wears a jacket and arm covers to protect her from harm while harvesting. But from time to time she takes them off so that she can travel unencumbered over the fields and mountains on her way to fulfill her dream—to reach the World's End.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' critical damage by 5% for each Promise & Teamwork character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Strong Will to Fulfill Dreams

character.name: Resna
character.profile_voice_text: I'm going to find the World's End and revive alchemy. That's my goal!

character.acquisition_text:
Guided by the sacred stars,
I bring abundant blessings to all!
character.description: An alchemist wearing a Starbirth Festival outfit. The Starbirth Festival celebrates the day the planet was born. During the festival, Starbirth Envoys wear special outfits and deliver gifts to the people. Resna is eager to fulfill her role as a Starbirth Envoy and show her appreciation to those who have made a difference in her life.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' critical damage by 15%.
leader_skill.name: Wish upon the Starry Sky

character.name: Resna
character.profile_voice_text:
This outfit is meant for delivering blessings to the people.
I'm going to be an alchemist who does just that!

character.acquisition_text: The student life I've always dreamed of! I'm going to be a full-fledged alchemist!
character.description: A new student in the Alchemy department at Lantarna Academy. She has repeatedly tried to synthesize things on her own but has never succeeded. However, she has a genuine passion for alchemy, and she boasts more knowledge of the field than any of the other students. Her dream is to become a great alchemist like her father.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Resleriana Academy characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 30%.
leader_skill.name: This Is My Time to Shine!

character.name: Resna
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Resna, from the Alchemy department at Lantarna Academy. Gosh, it still feels like a dream that I actually got into the academy.

character.acquisition_text: I'll shine even brighter than the sun!
character.description: A novice alchemist who dreams of reviving alchemy and works tirelessly every day. To enjoy the summer, she is wearing a swimsuit that she treasures, as it was chosen by her best friend, Izana. With a delicate, fairy-like appearance, she always makes sure to wear her straw hat to protect herself from the sun.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Seasonal characters' burst skill damage and burst skill stun damage by 75%.
leader_skill.name: A Little Bold in Summer

character.name: Resna
character.profile_voice_text: I've never been great with being out under the sun...but I'll get through it with this swimsuit!

character.acquisition_text: With this newfound power, I'll overcome any challenge that comes my way!
character.description: A young alchemist who has gained newfound strength. She loves alchemy and seeks to revive it by traveling to the World's End, a place said to be rich in mana. This elegant and radiant outfit awakens the hidden power within her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' battle item damage by 30% and boosts their skill damage when attacking a weakness by 30%.
leader_skill.name: Ignite the Flames of Ambition!

character.name: Resna
character.profile_voice_text: I feel like...like I've awakened a new power! I'm going to use it to help everyone!

character.acquisition_text: With this newfound power, I'll overcome any challenge that comes my way!
character.description: A young alchemist who has gained newfound strength. She loves alchemy and seeks to revive it by traveling to the World's End, a place said to be rich in mana. This elegant and radiant outfit awakens the hidden power within her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' battle item damage by 30% and boosts their skill damage when attacking a weakness by 30%.
leader_skill.name: Ignite the Flames of Ambition!

character.name: Resna
character.profile_voice_text: I feel like...like I've awakened a new power! I'm going to use it to help everyone!

character.acquisition_text: The path toward endless possibilities — I'll pave the way with my own hands!
character.description:
An alchemist seeking World's End.
She has become well-known in the Kingdom of Lantarna for using alchemy to resolve various requests and incidents. In pursuit of her dream to find World's End and revive alchemy, she ventures beyond Lantarna to explore the islands across the sea.
Her knowledge of and love for alchemy remains unchanged—if anything, it has only grown stronger.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all Slash affinity allies' stun damage and critical damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Clear the Path and Press On!

character.name: Resna
character.profile_voice_text: A new journey begins! I'll show you how different I've become from who I was before!

character.acquisition_text: Just like all the people of Venus, I will strive to become a beautiful and strong alchemist!
character.description:
An alchemist aiming to reach World's End.
Due to a series of unexpected circumstances, she ended up stranded in the Venus Isles and entered the Venus Fest—a festival where participants compete in strength and beauty.
She deeply loves alchemy and possesses vast knowledge on the subject. With her earnest personality, she is determined to give her all now that she has committed to participating in the Venus Festival.

leader_skill.description: For each Seasonal character in the party, boosts all allies' skill damage and stun damage by 20%.
leader_skill.name: New Horizons on the Eternal Summer Isles

character.name: Resna
character.profile_voice_text: I'm a bit intimidated by the Venus Festival, but... if I've been given this opportunity, I want to give it my all.

character.acquisition_text:
I'm so happy to celebrate the new year with everyone!
I want to carry this happiness into tomorrow.
character.description:
An alchemist heading toward World's End.
She's wearing New Year's attire gifted by her mother.
Invited by Kaburaya, she travels to Keiun alongside Alvina to celebrate their New Year festivities.
With her boundless curiosity for knowledge, she's excited to spend the year-end and New Year holidays in Keiun, a land with culture quite different from Lantarna.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Air affinity characters' P.ATK, M.ATK, P.DEF, and M.DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Set Sail with the Wind!

character.name: Resna
character.profile_voice_text: Wearing festive attire makes me feel like this will be a wonderful year.

character.acquisition_text:
Leave the fighting to me.
I'm confident in what I can do.
character.description:
A warrior with amnesia. Relying on her excellent fighting skills, she and Heidi tend to take on a variety of rough jobs. With no memory of her past, she spends her days trying to figure out who she really is.
She has a strong and outspoken personality, but is surprisingly weak when pressured by others.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' burst skill damage by 30%.
leader_skill.name: Hand in Hand

character.name: Valeria
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Valeria. I don't remember my past... But that doesn't stop me from enjoying myself.

character.acquisition_text:
I'm still not sure who I am...
but I'm starting to understand what I need to do!
character.description: A warrior who is as strong as she is beautiful. She loves nothing more than being right in the thick of battle. Her clothing takes most of the beating, but her roommate Flocke always patches it up for her. If Valeria takes her jacket off, though, she means business. While that increases her odds of being injured, she believes in wrapping fights up before that happens.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Family & Friends characters' skill damage and stun damage by 30%.
leader_skill.name: Living in the Underworld

character.name: Valeria
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Valeria. I don't like delicate work, but leave the monsters to me.

character.acquisition_text: I will win! No matter who stands against me!
character.description: A warrior shrouded in layers of mystery. Despite losing her memories, she lives each day to the fullest, blessed with many chance encounters, starting with meeting her partner, Heidi. In the current battle, she uses her formidable strength to protect her precious friends. While she looks stunning in her elegant attire, she doesn't much care for the appearance itself. She is simply satisfied with its performance.

leader_skill.description: Grants Lantarna characters Initiative and boosts their critical damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Black Rose Warrior

character.name: Valeria
character.profile_voice_text: I'll do everything in my power to keep this land—the place my family, Resna, and the others call home—safe from the Apexi.

character.acquisition_text: Come on, let's go swimming! I'll take care of any enemies lurking in the water!
character.description: A beautiful warrior with amnesia. She didn't see the need for a swimsuit, but still captivated everyone with how great it looked on her. Once she tried it on, she found it very light and easy to move in, which was perfect for her as she believes that striking first is the key to victory.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Lantarna characters' burst skill damage by 100%.
leader_skill.name: Unmatched in Mobility!

character.name: Valeria
character.profile_voice_text: I'm a great swimmer! Leave any battles in the water to me! I can adapt to almost any situation!

character.acquisition_text: Power is surging from deep inside me... Anyone in my way is getting sent flying!
character.description: A beautiful warrior who has gained new strength. Though she has no memories before meeting Heidi and the others, her fighting skills have advanced to near-master level. Her outfit, adorned with gold and mana-inspired designs, enhances her beauty while also awakening her hidden powers.

leader_skill.description: Grants Carefree characters Initiative and boosts their stun damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: No One Can Keep Up with Me!

character.name: Valeria
character.profile_voice_text: Wearing this outfit, I can feel a mysterious power welling up inside me. I need to make sure I can control it properly.

character.acquisition_text: Power is surging from deep inside me... Anyone in my way is getting sent flying!
character.description: A beautiful warrior who has gained new strength. Though she has no memories before meeting Heidi and the others, her fighting skills have advanced to near-master level. Her outfit, adorned with gold and mana-inspired designs, enhances her beauty while also awakening her hidden powers.

leader_skill.description: Grants Carefree characters Initiative and boosts their stun damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: No One Can Keep Up with Me!

character.name: Valeria
character.profile_voice_text: Wearing this outfit, I can feel a mysterious power welling up inside me. I need to make sure I can control it properly.

character.acquisition_text: I won't hesitate anymore. I'll fight for everyone who believes in me!
character.description: A beautiful warrior dressed in black. She wields her blade to uncover the truth about who she really is and to support Resna's dream. She suspects that the outfit is black only because of Criselda's personal taste.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Lantarna characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 30%.
leader_skill.name: I'll Master This Power

character.name: Valeria
character.profile_voice_text: No matter what I wear, I'm still me. I just have to fight to protect everyone.

character.acquisition_text:
Whatever awaits at the end of this journey...
I'll move forward without hesitation.
character.description:
A warrior with amnesia and an alchemist.
Though troubled by the question of who she is and her purpose, she fights for the friends and family who support her. Believing that the answers she seeks lie across the sea, she sets out on a journey across the Lantarna continent with Resna.
Even with her lost memories, she remains laid-back and food-loving as ever.

leader_skill.description: Grants Laid-back characters Initiative and boosts P.ATK by 35%.
leader_skill.name: Let's Finish This Quick and Get Some Food!

character.name: Valeria
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Valeria. There's a lot I've forgotten, but I plan to recover it all, bit by bit.

character.acquisition_text:
Come, kindred spirit! We shall charge
toward our dreams together!
character.description: A self-proclaimed handsome adventurer that Resna met in the royal capital. With a dream of restoring alchemy to its former glory, he warmly refers to Resna, who shares his vision, as his "kindred spirit." His buoyant spirit masks a competent adventurer who is adept at handling whatever comes his way.

leader_skill.description: All Justice & Exploration characters restore their own HP by 5% at the start of the turn. Also boosts their skill damage and stun damage by 20%.
leader_skill.name: Strategist Roman

character.name: Roman
character.profile_voice_text:
I'm Roman Kalman, just a humble adventurer.
Totally trustworthy, I assure you! Hahaha.

character.acquisition_text: I'll even go under the cover of darkness if it means achieving my goal. That's just the way I do it.
character.description: A playful and kind young man. He is a kindred spirit to Resna and aims to revive alchemy alongside her. He claims to be skilled at hiding his identity and volunteered to infiltrate the Moonlight Society. He often tells others, "This outfit also suits me, don't you think? A handsome man looks good in anything," but no one has agreed with him just yet.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Ice affinity characters' M. ATK by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Roman's Secret Plan

character.name: Roman
character.profile_voice_text: I'm known for my stealth. I'll prove it by succeeding in this mission.

character.acquisition_text: To protect the peace of my people—I swear to fight with all my strength!
character.description: A cheerful young prince with a laid-back demeanor. Like Resna, he seeks to revive alchemy. This outfit, created for the final battle against the Polar Night Alchemists, is modeled after a knight's armor, providing both high defense and functionality. Though he can be a bit of a joker, he's highly capable and a reliable ally in battle.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Justice & Exploration characters' burst skill damage by 100%.
leader_skill.name: For a Future We Cherish

character.name: Roman
character.profile_voice_text: I am Richard, the secondborn prince of the Kingdom of Lantarna. I will fight with honor, as my title demands.

character.acquisition_text:
I am Juna Waitz, a knight of the Kingdom of Lantarna.
Allow my pure white armor to be your shield.
character.description:
One of the Knights of the Midnight Sun, a subset of the Royal Knights entrusted with critical duties such as guarding the royal family and eliminating dangerous monsters.
Renowned in Lantarna as the Dragon Slayer, her adventures have become something of a legend.
She presents a stoic front, speaking little, but she is a compassionate soul dedicated to the cause of the people.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Knight characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 15%.
leader_skill.name: Knight of the Midnight Sun

character.name: Juna
character.profile_voice_text:
My name is Juna, a servant of the royal palace and a Knight of the Midnight Sun.
Should you require my aid, I am ever at your service.

character.acquisition_text: Though my armor may have changed, my conviction remains steadfast. My loyalty is to the Kingdom of Lantarna!
character.description: One of the elite Knights of the Midnight Sun, chosen from the best knights in the kingdom. She is known throughout Lantarna as a dragon-slaying hero. Despite her reputation, however, she has a soft spot for cute things and loves to cuddle small animals, though she hides this side of herself to maintain her idealized image as a knight.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Knight characters' skill damage by 75% when attacking a weakness.
leader_skill.name: Azure Knight

character.name: Juna
character.profile_voice_text: I am Juna of the Knights of the Midnight Sun. For this mission, I've opted for armor that prioritizes maneuverability.

character.acquisition_text:
Now then, it's time for the party.
...Perhaps being led by the hand isn't so bad once in a while.
character.description: An elite member of the Royal Knights known as the Knight of Midnight Sun. For a royal party, she has set aside her usual white armor and donned a crimson dress. The outfit is designed to allow for easy movement in case of unexpected situations. All who have seen her in this elegant dress have discovered a new charm to the Knight of Midnight Sun, Juna.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Knight characters' P. DEF and M. DEF by 35%.
leader_skill.name: Elegant Knight of the Starry Night

character.name: Juna
character.profile_voice_text:
I am Juna Waitz. Though it may seem unsuitable for a knight,
I shall graciously wear this dress.

character.acquisition_text:
Let us pledge to study and grow further
so we may serve as role models for our fellow students.
character.description:
A second-year student in Lantarna Academy's alchemy department.
An exemplary student who excels in both academics and martial arts, she has visited various schools as an exchange student.
A member of the Alchemy Club, she's friends with Sophie and her classmates. She aims to become the next Student Council President.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Diligent characters' P.DEF and M.DEF by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Rare Leadership

character.name: Juna
character.profile_voice_text:
I'll never spare any effort
to make our academy an even better place.

character.acquisition_text: I was asked to help, so you can bet I'll give it my all! Adventurer Heidi, ready for the biggest job of my life!
character.description: A skilled scout, she uses her natural charm and dexterity to support Valeria. She is a smooth talker, which sometimes makes her seem a bit flippant, but she truly sees Valeria and Flocke as family. Guided by her belief in the path they have chosen, she eagerly joins their quest to take down the Apexi.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Family & Friends characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 30%.
leader_skill.name: To Protect Our Home

character.name: Heidi
character.profile_voice_text: This outfit shows that I'm ready to rumble! Haha, just kidding. Just needed to psych myself up.

character.acquisition_text: For richer, for poorer, in sickness and in health—eh, I think we just need to live life to the fullest!
character.description: An enthusiastic and witty character, she joined the dragon-slaying mission in hopes of striking it rich by acquiring rare dragon scales. Resourceful and adept, she gathers information while also playing the role of the bride. However, she was initially embarrassed by the outfit and was constantly teased by Valeria and Lanze, so it took her a while to get used to it.

leader_skill.description: Lantarna characters restore their own HP by 5% at the start of the turn. Also boosts their skill damage and stun damage by 20%.
leader_skill.name: Passionate Bride

character.name: Heidi
character.profile_voice_text: I'm really not used to wearing clothes like this. I hope I don't look too strange.

character.acquisition_text: I won't run away anymore—I'll protect my friends, my family, my partner...everyone!
character.description: Valeria's upbeat partner. She ran away from one thing after another until she ended up in the capital, where she met Valeria and the others. Although she's not skilled in direct combat, she's quick on her feet and provides tactical support as Valeria's trusty partner. While her attempts to make a quick profit don't always work out, she tends to be blessed with good luck when it matters most.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Energetic characters' skill damage and stun damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: I'll Do Whatever I Can!

character.name: Heidi
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Heidi! I may not be the best at fighting, but with my partner by my side, we're unstoppable!

character.acquisition_text:
So this is Lantarna Academy...
I can't wait to see what kind of encounters await me!
character.description:
An exchange student from Schaffen Science Academy.
She sees alchemy as a rival field to science. Skilled with her hands, she has a talent for tinkering with machinery.
She's been friends with Flocke, who attends the same academy, for a long time and often took care of her when she was ill.

leader_skill.description: Boosts M.ATK by 50% for characters with Air affinity.
leader_skill.name: The Winds of Change Blow Toward Science!

character.name: Heidi
character.profile_voice_text:
Hey there! I'm Heidi, an exchange student!
Leave any mechanical work to me! Looking forward to working with you!

character.acquisition_text: ログボ用
character.description: ログボ用

leader_skill.description: Boosts Family & Friends characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 30%.
leader_skill.name: To Protect Our Home

character.name: Heidi
character.profile_voice_text: ログボ用

character.acquisition_text: I can fight too! So please—take me with you!
character.description: A hardworking peddler. She was dedicated to supporting the lives of Valeria and her companions, but after seeing her friends take up arms to defend the city from Apexi, she could no longer stand by and joined the fight. Though usually reserved, once she has made up her mind, she always sees her choice through with determination.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' P. ATK and M. ATK by 8% for each Merchant character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Peddler's Resolve to Fight

character.name: Flocke
character.profile_voice_text: To protect this town and its people... I have decided to fight!

character.acquisition_text: This time, I want to protect everyone—with my own two hands!
character.description: A spirited young peddler. She lives with Valeria and the others, supporting them whenever she can, especially when they get a bit careless. She has an exceptional eye for quality, most notably when it comes to seafood, which always leaves her customers very satisfied. Having experienced the joy of being helped when she needed it, she now strives to lend a hand to anyone else in need.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Stab affinity characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Angel's Blessing

character.name: Flocke
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Flocke Cerha, a peddler. I'm quite confident in my eye for good fish!

character.acquisition_text:
I'm Flocke, an exchange student!
Please let me study many things at this academy!
character.description:
An exchange student from the Schaffen Science Academy.
She is enthusiastic about learning and possesses broad knowledge across various scientific fields. She is eager about this exchange opportunity, believing there must be things to learn from alchemy as well.
Though physically weak and often absent from school in her younger days, she now lives a healthy life thanks to the support of Heidi and others.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Resleriana Academy characters' M.ATK and M.DEF by 40%.
leader_skill.name: A Place to Be Together

character.name: Flocke
character.profile_voice_text:
I'm Flocke, an exchange student!
I think I can be of help when it comes to science!

character.acquisition_text: All aboard! Time to put my newly trained fists to the test!
character.description: A once-renowned sailor from the northern seas of the kingdom. His ship was attacked by an Apexi, resulting in the loss of his wife and crew. Since then, he has been drowning his sorrows in alcohol. However, thanks to the companions he met in the capital, he was inspired to pursue his dream of reaching the World's End once again.

leader_skill.description: At the start of battle, reduces Adventurer characters' damage received by 30% for 2 attacks.
leader_skill.name: No More Farewells

character.name: Lanze
character.profile_voice_text: I'm a sailor who lost it all. But I won't lose heart again. I'll stay strong for my crew!

character.acquisition_text:
I will become the strongest knight!
I swear upon a shooting star!
character.description:
A bright and cheerful beastgirl, and Resna's best friend.
Ever since she was a child, she has admired knights.
She and Resna made a pact to fulfill their dreams together and often encourage each other along the way.
Influenced by her father, a blacksmith, she wields a giant hammer as her weapon.
She has a bit of an obsession with hammers.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Whimsical characters' M. ATK and M. DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Hammer Power!

character.name: Izana
character.profile_voice_text:
My dream is to be the strongest knight ever!
I'll protect everyone with this hammer!

character.acquisition_text: Just look at this beautiful outfit! I hope you'll stay by my side forevermore!
character.description: A cheerful and friendly beast girl. She is aiming to become the strongest knight, so she was eager to accept the dragon-slaying mission. Although she is brave, she also has a feminine side and couldn't stop admiring herself in the mirror after changing into this outfit. She has no plans to get married anytime soon, but seeing her in this outfit brought tears to her father's eyes, and she found it difficult to comfort him.

leader_skill.description: Grants Promise & Teamwork characters Initiative and boosts their critical damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Bride's Guidance

character.name: Izana
character.profile_voice_text: I'm usually running around with a hammer, so wearing something this pretty makes me nervous!

character.acquisition_text: To protect those I care about, I can't afford to stop!
character.description: A beast-girl who proclaims herself the knight of her best friend, Resna. This outfit, made for the battle against the Polar Night Alchemists, is lightweight and designed for easy movement, allowing her to swing her hammer faster than ever before. Using a hammer she made with her father's help, she continues to pursue her childhood dream of becoming the strongest knight.

leader_skill.description: Grants Lantarna characters Initiative and boosts their P. ATK by 30%.
leader_skill.name: Power to Those Who Trust in Their Friends!

character.name: Izana
character.profile_voice_text: My new hammer has a brilliant shine, the perfect weight, and it swings like a dream!

character.acquisition_text:
I've fulfilled my vow to the shooting stars!
Watch closely as I take on the form of a true knight!
character.description:
A beast-girl who serves in the Royal Knights and is Resna's childhood friend.
Pursuing her lifelong dream of becoming a knight, she now travels as Resna's guardian, accompanying the alchemist on her journey.
Though she has grown into a proper knight, her energetic nature remains unchanged.
As the daughter of a blacksmith, she fights wielding hammers in both hands.

leader_skill.description: Air affinity characters gain Skill Damage and Critical Damage +50%
leader_skill.name: Feel the Wind of My Hammer!

character.name: Izana
character.profile_voice_text:
I am Izana of the Lantarna Royal Knights!
...Ehehe, pleased to meet you!

character.acquisition_text:
My cute outfit is ready and I've got my horn...
...So now, let this year's Starbirth Festival begin!
character.description:
A beastkin girl who belongs to the Royal Knights.
She's Resna's childhood friend and accompanies her on her journey as a guardian.
Dressed as a Starbirth Festival messenger alongside Resna, she's working hard to liven up the celebration. Though her outfit is different, she hasn't forgotten her duty as a Royal Knight and as a knight protecting Resna.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Seasonal characters' skill damage by 100% when attacking a weakness.
leader_skill.name: Starry Night Melody

character.name: Izana
character.profile_voice_text: With this cute outfit and horn, let's celebrate the Starbirth Festival. I'll bring smiles to everyone!

character.acquisition_text: Reviving alchemy is my wish as well. Come now, let's work at it together.
character.description: Resna's alchemy mentor. She met Resna in a village where she stopped on her journey and taught her the basics of alchemy. She usually has a cheerful and straightforward personality, but when it comes to alchemy, she can show a stern side. She is also rather careless in her personal life, and Resna often has to take care of her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' critical damage by 5% for each Lantarna character in the party.
leader_skill.name: The Comet Is with Us

character.name: Saskia
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Saskia, an alchemist with a dream—just like Resna. Together, we aim to find the World's End!

character.acquisition_text:
Being able to celebrate the new year with everyone...
Hehe... It makes me so happy.
character.description: Resna's alchemy mentor. Since her disciple became independent, she has been traveling the world for her own purposes. She values the connections between people, and has a rather formal side to her, making it a rule to visit and give gifts to those who have helped her at the start of each year. Few know where she was born or how she has lived her life.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Ice affinity characters' M. ATK by 40%.
leader_skill.name: I'll Freeze You to the Core

character.name: Saskia
character.profile_voice_text:
I'm Saskia. I'm so happy we can celebrate the new year together.
Let's get along this year too~

character.acquisition_text:
Reviving alchemy is also my wish.
Now then, shall we go together?
character.description:
Resna's alchemy mentor.
During her travels, she stopped at Resna's village and began teaching her the basics of alchemy.
While she has a bright and straightforward personality, she can be quite strict when it comes to alchemy.
She's also quite messy in her personal life, often requiring Resna to take care of her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' critical damage by 5% for each Lantarna character in the party.
leader_skill.name: The Comet Star is With Us

character.name: Saskia
character.profile_voice_text:
I'm Saskia. Like Resna, I'm an alchemist with dreams.
Let's aim for World's End together.

character.acquisition_text: I'm said to have the power of a genius—and this time I'll let you use that power for once!
character.description: A young girl who served as an enforcer under the code name Crow in the Moonlight Society, an organization unrecognized by the kingdom. She has lived her life obeying nothing but the words of the organization's leader, Oliver, who is also her only family—her grandfather. She is very confident in her fighting skills, and her prowess in combat is undeniable. She has a strong sense of pride, hates to lose, and can be headstrong, often rushing into situations on her own.

leader_skill.description: Grants Promise & Teamwork characters a high chance to inflict Poison on the target for 1 turn after attacking, and boosts their skill damage to poisoned attack targets by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Never Let Your Prey Escape!

character.name: Johanna
character.profile_voice_text: This is where I belong now. You can trust this genius to keep everything here safe.

character.acquisition_text:
A genius doesn't choose their battlefield—
I'll follow you anywhere!
character.description:
A self-proclaimed genius and Resna's friend.
She previously served as an enforcer codenamed Crow for the Moonlight Society, an unofficial kingdom organization.
She joined forces with Resna to help her reach World's End.
She has strong confidence in her combat abilities, which is backed by her proven skills.
She has a proud personality and hates to lose.

leader_skill.description: Boosts burst skill damage by 75% for characters with Ice affinity.
leader_skill.name: Tremble Before Me!

character.name: Johanna
character.profile_voice_text: I'll show those outsiders beyond the continent what this genius can really do!

character.acquisition_text:
On a hot day like this, let's play in the water!
This genius will play with you!
character.description:
A self-proclaimed genius girl.
She previously worked as a monitor for the Moonlight Society under the codename "Thrush."
To win the "Lara Beach Grand Prix" and claim glory, she dons a swimsuit prepared together with Izana.
With her high pride and competitive nature that hates losing, she gives her all in any contest.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Slash affinity characters' skill damage and stun damage by 40%.
leader_skill.name: I'll Slice Right Through This Heat!

character.name: Johanna
character.profile_voice_text:
Hmph. As expected of the genius Johanna!
Any outfit looks good on me!

character.acquisition_text: Those who disrupt the order of the Society will be eliminated by me.
character.description:
A girl who hides her face behind a mask.
She serves as an enforcer for the Moonlight Society, an unrecognized organization in the kingdom, and lives according to the words of her grandfather Oliver, the Society's leader.
People call her Crow and fear her mysterious nature, as she appears from the shadows and vanishes back into them without a trace.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' skill damage and critical damage by 20% for each Dark Memories character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Guardian of the Shadow Order

character.name: Crow
character.profile_voice_text: I am Crow, enforcer of the Moonlight Society. You won't escape me.

character.acquisition_text: I owe you all a great debt. Feel free to make use of my skills.
character.description: An alchemist whose body has been partially transformed into that of a beast. He has no qualms about using his strength to force others into submission, so long as it helps fulfill his desires. Though he doesn't talk much, he changes when it comes to his younger brother, his only family. As an older brother, he's surprisingly caring and responsible, but when it comes to dealing with women, he's rather hopeless.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Quiet characters' P. ATK and P. DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Calm Judgment

character.name: Geron
character.profile_voice_text: I am Geron Diezel, an alchemist. I wield this sword for the sake of our future.

character.acquisition_text: This path seems as if it will prove most entertaining. Time for me to add a new chapter to my story.
character.description: An alchemist with the appearance of nobility. She uses alchemy in her ambition to establish the Kingdom of Lara, putting her at odds with Resna, who believes alchemy should be used to bring happiness to others. As a self-proclaimed leader, she is meticulous about maintaining an air of elegance in her appearance, which she believes is appropriate for a queen who leads others.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' battle item damage by 20% for each Prim character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Bow before My Grace!

character.name: Lara
character.profile_voice_text: I am Lara Trockel. A proud queen who will be the foundation upon which unfulfilled souls stand.

character.acquisition_text:
When you lose your way, follow my lead.
I shall guide you to our ideal country.
character.description:
An alchemist and ruler of the Lara Kingdom.
She travels to various regions in search of talented individuals to recruit as vassals of the Lara Kingdom. Though she can be somewhat forceful, she is adored by her subjects and vassals for her caring nature.
When she wears this outfit coordinated with Empel, she particularly enjoys how it makes him look like her secretary.

leader_skill.description: All allies gain P. ATK and M. ATK +10% and Skill Damage and Stun Damage +20% for each Noble character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Grace in All Things

character.name: Lara
character.profile_voice_text: I am Lara Trockel. As one who would be queen, let us proceed with elegance and splendor.

character.acquisition_text:
To the endless blue sea beyond—
Let the Kingdom of Lara's name be known!
character.description: An alchemist and queen of the Kingdom of Lara. She was formerly a member of the Polar Night Alchemists and worked for the sake of her own nation. Wearing a stunning swimsuit, she graces the Lara Beach Grand Prix that she herself sponsors. She strives to conduct herself with dignity befitting a queen, caring for others and earning the admiration of her vassals and citizens.

leader_skill.description: Reduces damage received by 25% for characters with Slash affinity.
leader_skill.name: Your Queen Supports You

character.name: Lara
character.profile_voice_text:
Ensuring the safety of the seas is also a queen's duty.
Now, let's head out on patrol!

character.acquisition_text: I swore that I would wield this sword to protect everyone!
character.description: A new alchemy student at Lantarna Academy. She enrolled at the academy via recommendation, but she rarely attends class and doesn't seem to have joined the alchemy club. She's taciturn and rarely mingles with her classmates, instead preferring to be a lone wolf.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Quiet characters' skill damage by 75% when attacking a weakness.
leader_skill.name: The Shadow Who Rescues and Protects

character.name: Eren
character.profile_voice_text: I enrolled here at Lantarna Academy for personal reasons. Will I...fit in here?

character.acquisition_text: If you're unsure, just charge ahead! Dream big! Dream HUGE!
character.description: A trusted vassal of the Kingdom of Lara. Mieke once ran a thriving accessory shop in Wirbel Province, where her designs were especially popular among young women. Captivated by Lara's magnanimity, she left this position and devoted herself entirely to Lara's service. She inherited a cheerful and vivacious personality from her entertainer father, but hates getting stuck on tiny details, always moving forward with bold confidence.

leader_skill.description: Grants Creator characters Initiative and boosts their skill damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Flash of Inspiration!

character.name: Mieke
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Mieke, the top wardrobe designer in the Kingdom of Lara! Leave anything fashion-related to me!

character.acquisition_text: These fierce flames that burn within me... I'll turn them into a melody for all to hear!
character.description: A trusted vassal of the Kingdom of Lara. Gifted with musical talent, Diona rose to fame as a young diva. She first met Mieke in Wirbel Province, their hometown, where the two became close friends who recognized each other's talents. Inspired by Lara's elegance and grace, Diona has sworn absolute loyalty to her. She has a strong sense of aesthetics and feels unsettled whenever she sees something that disturbs the beauty of the world.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' Paralysis resistance by 100% and boosts their skill damage by 50% when their attack target is paralyzed.
leader_skill.name: Captivated by the Queen

character.name: Diona
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Diona. Would you like to hear me sing? Very well, let me sing in praise of Lady Lara...

character.acquisition_text: Heh. Bring it on. No matter who my opponent is, I'll smash 'em to bits!
character.description: A renowned fighter, widely known as "Brawl Master Magda." Formerly a member of the Moonlight Society, she is acquainted with Valeria and others. Confident in her physical strength, she finds purpose in earning her keep through sheer skill. Magda has her own personal code when it comes to work, and will outright refuse jobs she doesn't feel are worth taking. Though her personality can be rough around the edges, she always cares for those close to her. She also has a quieter side that enjoys listening to music as a pastime.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Adventurer characters' P. ATK and M. ATK by 10% and skill damage and stun damage by 30%.
leader_skill.name: Smash, Smash, and Smash Some More!

character.name: Magda
character.profile_voice_text: The name's Magda, brawler for hire. Got a job? I'll take it—but my bat doesn't come cheap.

character.acquisition_text: I shall judge your efforts with my own eyes. After all, that is my duty.
character.description: A young man appointed as the Seneschal of Alchemy at an early age. He has been sent by the kingdom to Resna and her companions as an overseer to determine whether they can achieve the restoration of alchemy. Though he considers Roman a friend from their school days, he also sees him as a rival—albeit one-sidedly. While he maintains a calm and composed demeanor, he carries an intense passion deep within.

leader_skill.description: After Lantarna characters attack, boosts their target's Stab damage received by 20% for 1 attack.
leader_skill.name: Keen Eye for Weakness

character.name: Brad
character.profile_voice_text: I am Bradley Khan. I've recently been appointed the Seneschal of Alchemy. Pleased to make your acquaintance.

character.acquisition_text: I'm still not used to standing out here in the sunlight, but I want to stay close to those who matter most...
character.description: An alchemist cloaked in an aura of darkness. She admires Criselda, the leader of the Polar Night Alchemists, regarding her as a close friend and assisting her for some time now. She also loves playing with dolls, having given names to the four dolls that she always keeps by her side. Vindictive by nature, she never forgets a deed done to her—whether it be a gesture of kindness or an act of betrayal.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Bolt affinity characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Puppeteer's Devotion

character.name: Antje
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Antje, an alchemist... Nice to meet you. Come now, everyone, say hello.

character.acquisition_text:
I'm not particularly interested in the ocean...
But if you want to go, I'll come with you.
character.description:
A darkness-cloaked alchemist.
She previously belonged to the Polar Night Alchemists and assisted Criselda.
She wears a swimsuit prepared together with Resna to participate in Lara's "Lara Beach Grand Prix."
She possesses the strength to work devotedly for those important to her, including her friend Criselda.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Lantarna characters' P.ATK by 40%.
leader_skill.name: First Time at the Ocean with Everyone

character.name: Antje
character.profile_voice_text:
This is my first time playing at the ocean...
But this might be... fun, I suppose.

character.acquisition_text:
This bunny outfit... Do you think
it looks cute on me?
character.description:
An alchemist cloaked in a dark aura.
She was a member of the Polar Night Alchemists under Criselda's former leadership.
She now works alongside Criselda, who is on parole, as staff at a newly opened café, though her true purpose remains unclear.
Though she has an introverted and contemplative personality, she shows courage when playing card games with her stuffed animals cheering her on.

leader_skill.description: Bookworm characters become faster and gain critical damage +50%.
leader_skill.name: Passion Beyond Books

character.name: Antje
character.profile_voice_text:
I have no idea why I ended up wearing this outfit.
But since Criselda is with me, I should try to enjoy it.

character.acquisition_text: My wish is to know everything in this world. I'd be honored if you'd lend me your aid!
character.description: An alchemist with the mind of a researcher. Driven by an insatiable thirst for knowledge, he constantly seeks new discoveries. He despises being interrupted in his research, which often brings him into conflict with Resna and the others. Though his personal life suffers because he is always engrossed in research, his refined upbringing is evident in his everyday mannerisms.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Glasses characters' burst skill damage by 100%.
leader_skill.name: Seeker of Knowledge's Favorite Specs

character.name: Walther
character.profile_voice_text: I am Walther, an alchemist and seeker of knowledge. I possess more than enough common sense, so worry not.

character.acquisition_text:
Reviving alchemy is my wish as well.
—Now then, let us go together.
character.description:
Resna's alchemy mentor.
During his travels, he stopped by the village where Resna lived and taught her the basics of alchemy.
He has a cheerful and easygoing personality, but shows a strict side when it comes to alchemy.
His personal life is rather careless, and Resna often ends up taking care of him.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' critical damage by 5% for each Lantarna character in the party.
leader_skill.name: The Wandering Star Is with Us

character.name: Walther
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Saskia. Like Resna, I'm a dreaming alchemist. Set your sights on World's End.

character.acquisition_text:
I shall dedicate my all to you—
Hehe, let's make this thoroughly enjoyable.
character.description:
Leader of the Polar Night Alchemists.
She has repeatedly monopolized and seized materials across various regions to further her alchemical research in pursuit of her desires.
While ruthless toward her enemies, she provides generous support to those who cooperate with her. She is skilled at cooking and surprisingly caring beneath her exterior.

leader_skill.description: Bolt affinity characters deal 100% more Skill Damage to stunned targets.
leader_skill.name: For the Sake of Our Desires

character.name: Criselda
character.profile_voice_text:
I am Criselda. Though there have been some complications...
Hehe, I'd be happy if we could get along.

character.acquisition_text:
There's something I seek in this ocean.
Will you help me search for it?
character.description:
A talented alchemist.
She was formerly the leader of the Polar Night Alchemists, acting according to her own ambitions.
She was imprisoned for a time, but is currently on parole and has volunteered to help with the Lara Beach Grand Prix.
She maintains a calm demeanor and treats everyone kindly, though she sometimes likes to tease people she's taken a liking to.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' P.ATK and M.ATK by 10% for each Lantarna character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Forget Your Station and Have Fun

character.name: Criselda
character.profile_voice_text: Everyone looks wonderful in their swimsuits. I'll make sure to burn this sight into my memory, thoroughly.

character.acquisition_text: Sometimes going all out is part of my duty as the head of the Amelhauser family.
character.description:
A talented alchemist.
She once acted as she pleased as the leader of the Polar Night Alchemists.
Currently on parole, she works as a staff member at a newly opened cafe, though her true motives remain unclear.
With her teasing mannerisms and clever speech, she seems to enjoy toying with others.

leader_skill.description: Boosts P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 25% for characters with Fire affinity.
leader_skill.name: I'll Light a Fire in Your Heart

character.name: Criselda
character.profile_voice_text: As the head of the Amelhauser family, I can see ahead no matter the situation.

character.acquisition_text:
My feelings for my homeland and my sister—
I carry both close to my heart as I grow stronger.
character.description:
A young girl who serves as a Sacred Knight in the Nova.
Though not related by blood, she looks up to Alvina as an older sister.
While she maintains a cool and mysterious air, she has a natural side to her and sometimes surprises others with her unexpected actions.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Nova characters' P. ATK and M. ATK by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Young Warrior Who Swears Vengeance

character.name: Bepp
character.profile_voice_text: I am Bepp Zimlock, Sacred Knight of the Nova and the protector of Alvina.

character.acquisition_text:
Let me guide you on your unknown adventure!
...Just kidding!
character.description:
The Star Guide of Nova and a secret alchemist.
After meeting an alchemist who arrived on the island, she became deeply involved in alchemy herself. Since pursuing work outside one's divine calling is forbidden in the sacred lands of Nova, she keeps her activities as an alchemist hidden from others.
Quick-witted and sharp-tongued, she often finds herself getting into clever mischief.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Nova characters' P.ATK and stun damage by 30%
leader_skill.name: Star Guide

character.name: Alvina
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Alvina! Star Guide of Nova and... a fledgling alchemist!

character.acquisition_text: Someday I'll become a strong, beautiful, and cool swimsuit hero too...or something like that!
character.description: A Star Guide of the sacred lands of Nova, and an alchemist. Through a series of events, she ended up wandering into the Venus Isles and participating in the Venus Fest, a festival where goddesses compete in strength and beauty. Quick-witted and meticulous by nature, she's well aware of her own charm and actively appeals with her cuteness during the Venus Fest.

leader_skill.description: Boosts burst skill damage for Seasonal characters by 100%.
leader_skill.name: Talent Blooming on a Tropical Isle

character.name: Alvina
character.profile_voice_text: Come to think of it, I may have never worn a swimsuit before. Well? Take a look! Does it suit me?

character.acquisition_text: I will protect you with these hands—for that is the divine duty bestowed upon me.
character.description:
A Sacred Knight of Nova and mother of one.
Earnest and devout in her faith, she's dedicated to her duties. She's one of the country's most skilled fighters and has even won martial arts tournaments. She's also an excellent cook with a domestic side and dotes on her daughter.
She's been looking after Alvina since long ago and remains concerned for her well-being.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Slash affinity characters' P.ATK, M.ATK, P.DEF, and M.DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Nova's Strongest Sacred Knight

character.name: Janne
character.profile_voice_text: As a Sacred Knight of Nova, I'll show you how I protect everyone.

character.acquisition_text: Half-hearted help is completely meaningless. If you're going to do something, then fight with everything you've got!
character.description: A homunculus created by the Palme and the third member of the Miraculous Nine. She travels around various lands as an adventurer while carrying out management duties under orders from the Palme. She values chic styles and takes pride in having a complete, coordinated outfit. However, she doesn't mind getting completely disheveled when the situation calls for it, as long as it means staying true to her own way of life that she discovered during her travels.

leader_skill.description: Boosts P.ATK by 40% for characters with Strike affinity.
leader_skill.name: Carefree Wanderer

character.name: Jelka
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Jelka. We help each other out when we're in trouble. That's what style is all about, don't you think?

character.description: A homunculus created by the Palme and the third member of the Miraculous Nine. She travels around various lands as an adventurer while carrying out management duties under orders from the Palme. Due to her cheerful and caring personality, she plays a role that binds the Nine together. She values chic styles and has a compassionate side.

leader_skill.description: Boosts skill damage and burst skill damage by 50% for Nurturer characters.
leader_skill.name: Repay Kindness with Kindness

character.name: Jelka
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Jelka, the third of the Miraculous Nine. Humans always make fascinating discoveries, you know.

character.acquisition_text:
Reviving alchemy is my wish as well.
Now then, let's go together.
character.description:
Resna's alchemy mentor.
During her travels, she stopped at Resna's village and taught her the basics of alchemy.
Though she has a bright and straightforward personality, she shows a strict side when it comes to alchemy.
She's also quite carefree in her personal life, often causing Resna to worry about her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' critical damage by 5% for each Lantarna character.
leader_skill.name: The Comet Star Is with Us

character.name: August
character.profile_voice_text:
I am Saskia. Like Resna, I'm an alchemist with dreams.
Set your sights on World's End.

character.acquisition_text:
Leave it to me! I'll use my ninja techniques to
scatter these evildoers and show you what I can do!
character.description:
A ninja from southern Keiun.
She serves the Doumen family as a ninja and has been childhood friends with her master Kanariya since they were young.
Raised from childhood with traditional ninja education, she has been influenced by Kanariya to develop an appreciation for new things, often attempting new ninja techniques that perplex those around her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Keiun characters' M.ATK by 50% and burst skill damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Ninja of a New Era

character.name: Kimon
character.profile_voice_text: My name is Kimon. I am a ninja serving the Doumen family. Please treat me well.

character.acquisition_text:
A diviner is one who exorcises evil...
I'll exorcise your melancholy feelings as well.
character.description:
A well-known diviner within Keiun.
He is childhood friends with Kaburaya, the head of the Doumen family that governs southern Keiun, and Kimon, a ninja who serves her.
He takes great care of his appearance, sparing no effort in skincare and clothing selection. Though his flashy and arrogant behavior stands out, he claims to be a man who gets things done when it matters.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' battle item damage by 10% and P.DEF & M.DEF by 10% for each Keiun character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Beautiful Diviner of the Far East

character.name: Towa
character.profile_voice_text: Childhood friend of Lady Kaburaya, head of the Doumen family, and beautiful diviner, Towa Shigan. Pleased to make your acquaintance.

character.acquisition_text:
If there's the light of Venus in the heavens, then there's the brilliance of Kaburaya on earth!
Come now, follow me!
character.description:
The young lady of the Doumen family, who governs southern Keiun.
She has been childhood friends with the ninja Kimon and the diviner Towa since they were young.
She has been skilled with the sword since childhood and has won the Keiun martial arts tournament with her unique swordsmanship.
She prefers new and beneficial things over useless old traditions.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' P.ATK and M.ATK by 10% and skill damage and stun damage by 20% for each Keiun character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Lord Who Mastered the Martial Way

character.name: Kaburaya
character.profile_voice_text:
I am Kaburaya Doumen, lord of Keiun!
Let my strength serve you well.

character.acquisition_text:
I offer a prayer for the safety of this journey...
Please allow me to give you my blessing...
character.description:
A shrine maiden serving the Doumen family.
Originally serving at a shrine, she was immediately won over by Kaburaya's direct persuasion and became attached to the Doumen family.
Though she appears quiet and fragile due to her earnest nature, she possesses an inner strength.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Keiun characters' M.ATK and M.DEF by 40%.
leader_skill.name: Reverent Shrine Maiden

character.name: Chitose
character.profile_voice_text:
I am Chitose Hateruma... As a shrine maiden,
I would be honored to be of service to you all...

character.acquisition_text:
I'll repay the kindness I've received!
I'll take care of you humans too, all of you!
character.description:
A homunculus created by the Palme and the fifth member of the Miraculous Nine.
Along with the other members of the Nine, she carries out management duties under orders from the Palme.
She is loyal to orders and has a passionate, earnest personality. However, her excessive fervor can sometimes cause the other members of the Nine to keep their distance from her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts P. DEF and M. DEF by 35% for characters with Strike affinity.
leader_skill.name: Hot-Blooded Hero of Chivalry

character.name: Gou
character.profile_voice_text:
I'm Gou, the fifth of the Miraculous Nine.
I take pride in this name.

character.acquisition_text: Father, Mother, my dear siblings... Why do they not understand our mission...?
character.description:
A homunculus created by the Palme, and the fifth of the Miraculous Nine.
Along with the other Miraculous Nine, he carries out "management" under the Palme's orders.
He has a passionate and earnest personality. He cares deeply for his siblings, and respects Saskia and August as Mother and Father.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' P.ATK and M.ATK by 10% and skill damage and stun damage by 20% for each Dark Memories character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Mission Bestowed by Father and Mother

character.name: Gou
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Gou, fifth of the Miraculous Nine. My sisters often say I'm too overbearing, but...?

character.acquisition_text:
This outcome was part of my plan from the beginning—
Please make use of my strategic insight.
character.description: A homunculus created by the Palme, the sixth of the Miraculous Nine. Together with the other members, she carries out management duties under the Palme's orders. She excels at devising strategies and prefers things to proceed according to plan. She has a fondness for cleanliness and is often polishing her favorite glasses.

leader_skill.description: Characters with Stab affinity gain P.ATK +50%.
leader_skill.name: Talented Strategist
