character.name: Liebe
character.profile_voice_text:
I am Liebe. Leave strategic planning to me.
I shall devise the perfect plan.

character.acquisition_text:
I'll do my very best, so
make sure to give me lots of praise, okay?
character.description:
A homunculus created by the Palme, and the fourth of the Miraculous Nine.
Along with the other Miraculous Nine, he carries out management under the Palme's direction.
He act capricious, but is skilled at handling things efficiently and reading situations well.
An avid collector of beautiful items, especially gemstones.

leader_skill.description: Miraculous Nine characters gain Initiative and Critical Damage +50%.
leader_skill.name: Bewitching Gaze

character.name: Citrine
character.profile_voice_text:
I'm Citrine. Since we're together now,
make sure to entertain me lots, okay?

character.acquisition_text:
My alchemy will surely be of help.
So, won't you come along with me?
character.description: The only alchemist in the Aladiss Research Team. In her original world, alchemy was considered a forbidden art, so she joined the investigation team to discover the truth behind it. She cherishes her mother's words: "Learn how to judge what is right by yourself."

leader_skill.description: All allies gain 10% M.ATK and M.DEF for each Aladiss Research Team member.
leader_skill.name: Following Memories

character.name: Yumia
character.profile_voice_text:
I'm Yumia, an alchemist.
I hope to make new discoveries in this world.

character.acquisition_text:
I am Viktor of the Eustera Knights.
Let us swear to fight in the name of justice.
character.description: A knight belonging to the Aladiss Research Team. He's been assigned to monitor Yumia, who practices the forbidden art of alchemy. Though born into nobility, his family fell from grace due to a disaster in their territory. While he has a strong sense of justice and loyalty, he can be rather inflexible at times.

leader_skill.description: All allies gain 20% skill damage and stun damage for each Aladiss Research Team member.
leader_skill.name: Unwavering Justice

character.name: Viktor
character.profile_voice_text:
When the time comes, I will be everyone's shield.
So please, follow me with confidence.

character.acquisition_text:
I-I'm Lenja...!
I'll do my very best to be helpful...!
character.description: A young girl of the demihuman race known as Welleks. As a racial trait, she possesses high physical capabilities and mana affinity, serving as a member of the investigation team. Despite her abilities, she's timid and lacks self-confidence, often apologizing for various things.

leader_skill.description: Aladiss Research Team members gain 40% battle item damage and 50% skill damage & burst skill damage.
leader_skill.name: Journey of Atonement

character.name: Lenja
character.profile_voice_text:
I-I'm Lenja...!
I'll do my best to be helpful, so...

character.acquisition_text:
Leave the fashion coordination to me!
Let's have a stylish adventure together!
character.description: A member of the Research Team and Viktor's younger sister. She has a strong passion for clothing and accessories, maintaining her fashionable spirit even during investigations. Her bright and proactive personality, combined with her sharp intuition, helps her complement areas where her brother falls short.

leader_skill.description: Characters with Fire affinity deal 100% more skill damage when attacking stunned targets.
leader_skill.name: Fashion-Forward Mind

character.name: Isla
character.profile_voice_text: Fashion is important at all times! After all, don't people who dress well just shine brighter?

character.acquisition_text:
I'll do things my own way.
...Don't worry, I keep my promises.
character.description: A seasoned adventurer who loves valuable items. Having lived without relying on others, he survived in the slums while taking on shady jobs. Due to certain circumstances, he now works with the Aladiss Research Team. Living by his own aesthetic shaped by his extraordinary life experiences, he refuses to be bound by others.

leader_skill.description: Boosts P.ATK, M.ATK, P.DEF, and M.DEF by 25% for characters with Strike affinity.
leader_skill.name: Personal Aesthetic

character.name: Rutger
character.profile_voice_text:
Name's Rutger. I'll take on requests if the pay's right.
Just don't expect me to take on anything that's not worth my time.

character.acquisition_text:
I'm looking for something.
Won't you take me along on your journey?
character.description:
A mysterious woman who is a member of the research team.
Formerly active as a mercenary, she possesses such high capability that she can conduct investigations even on her own.
While she maintains a mysterious aura, she also has a cheerful and mischievous side.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Aladiss Research Team characters' P.ATK, M.ATK, P.DEF, and M.DEF by 30%.
leader_skill.name: Enigmatic Ex-Mercenary

character.name: Nina
character.profile_voice_text:
I'm Nina. Usually I work as a mercenary.
Hehe... I live each day freely.

character.acquisition_text:
What I want to do in this town, what I should do.
Let's move forward together, one step at a time!
character.description:
A friendly and cheerful adventurer.
She hails from the town of Hallfein, which was struck by a mysterious disaster and became a restricted area. She returned to her hometown after a reconstruction plan was launched, hoping to reopen her grandfather's shop, Mistletoe Miscellaneous, and investigate the cause of the disaster.
She has the drive to charge toward her goals and an unyielding spirit, though her bold recklessness often worries her adoptive older sister Camilla.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' P.ATK and M.ATK by 10% for each Promise & Teamwork character in the party.
leader_skill.name: For My Beloved Town Once More

character.name: Rias
character.profile_voice_text:
Rias Eidreise of the Mistletoe Miscellaneous!
Turns out I actually have a talent for alchemy!

character.acquisition_text:
As a descendant of the guardians,
I will continue to protect what has been passed down!
character.description:
A calm and composed young man.
He hails from the town of Hallfein, which was struck by a mysterious disaster and became a restricted area. He returned to his hometown after a reconstruction plan was launched in order to investigate the meaning of his father's last words.
He handles the management of Mistletoe Miscellaneous but is better suited to physical labor than desk work. He's skilled at all kinds of housework and often takes care of Rias, with whom he lives.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' base P.ATK and base M.ATK by 100 for each Hallfein Restoration Project character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Carrying On My Father's Will

character.name: Slade
character.profile_voice_text:
Slade Clauslyter. A descendant of the guardians.
Nice to meet you.

character.acquisition_text:
Ah! Found you! I was getting bored.
Would you like to play with Marie?
character.description: A wicked little servant working for the leader of the conglomerate DOATEC. She accompanied her master on vacation to the Venus Islands, but after being treated like a child, she's determined to win the Venus Festival and prove she's a grown-up. Though she has a somewhat aloof personality, her emotions show on her face when she's happy, revealing her age-appropriate side.

leader_skill.description: Seasonal characters gain Initiative and Skill Damage +50%.
leader_skill.name: Wicked Lil' Servant

character.name: Marie Rose
character.profile_voice_text:
My name is Marie Rose.
Call me Marie!

character.acquisition_text:
Wow, this looks like so much fun!
I'll show you all sorts of things!
character.description: A gentle and laid-back schoolgirl raised by her kind grandmother, with a top-secret side. She won a vacation ticket to the Venus Islands in a lucky draw at a shopping district and decided to visit. She happily accepted the invitation to the Venus Fest, treating it like a neighborhood festival. Despite her calm demeanor, she enjoys watching wrestling and studying martial arts techniques, and sometimes even imitates them.

leader_skill.description: Boosts skill damage by 100% for Strike affinity characters when attacking a stunned target.
leader_skill.name: Top-Secret Schoolgirl

character.name: Honoka
character.profile_voice_text:
Hello there! I'm Honoka.
Let's have a fun vacation together!

character.acquisition_text:
Come on, let's go swimming!
I'll take care of any enemies lurking in the water!
character.description:
A beautiful warrior with amnesia.
She didn't see the need for a swimsuit, but still captivated everyone with how great it looked on her.
Once she tried it on, she found it very light and easy to move in, which was perfect for her as she believes that striking first is the key to victory.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Lantarna characters' burst skill damage by 100%.
leader_skill.name: Unmatched in Mobility!

character.name: Valeria
character.profile_voice_text:
I'm a great swimmer! Leave any battles in the water to me!
I can adapt to almost any situation!

character.acquisition_text:
To the endless blue sea beyond—
Let the Kingdom of Lara's name be known!
character.description: An alchemist and queen of the Kingdom of Lara. She was formerly a member of the Polar Night Alchemists and worked for the sake of her own nation. Wearing a stunning swimsuit, she graces the Lara Beach Grand Prix that she herself sponsors. She strives to conduct herself with dignity befitting a queen, caring for others and earning the admiration of her vassals and citizens.

leader_skill.description: Reduces damage received by 25% for characters with Slash affinity.
leader_skill.name: Your Queen Supports You

character.name: Lara
character.profile_voice_text:
Ensuring the safety of the seas is also a queen's duty.
Now, let's head out on patrol!

character.acquisition_text:
I'm not particularly interested in the ocean...
But if you want to go, I'll come with you.
character.description:
A darkness-cloaked alchemist.
She previously belonged to the Polar Night Alchemists and assisted Criselda.
She wears a swimsuit prepared together with Resna to participate in Lara's "Lara Beach Grand Prix."
She possesses the strength to work devotedly for those important to her, including her friend Criselda.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Lantarna characters' P.ATK by 40%.
leader_skill.name: First Time at the Ocean with Everyone

character.name: Antje
character.profile_voice_text:
This is my first time playing at the ocean...
But this might be... fun, I suppose.

character.acquisition_text: Let's go see the unknown world beyond the sea together!
character.description: A free-spirited alchemist girl. Her curiosity overflowing, she wraps herself in a gorgeous swimsuit and dives into a new summer. The scarf that calls to mind her usual hat is one of her particular touches. The sandy beach that sparkles with reflected sunlight makes her presence shine even brighter.

leader_skill.description: Boosts skill damage by 75% when attack target is stunned for Kurken Island characters.
leader_skill.name: Grand Adventure by the Shore

character.name: Ryza
character.profile_voice_text:
I'm all set for swimming!
I'm gonna gather tons of materials sleeping on the ocean floor!

character.acquisition_text:
Even the deep ocean floor isn't scary when everyone's together.
Come on, let's go!
character.description:
A merchant's daughter.
She accompanies a caravan introduced by her best friend Ryza, honing her work skills day by day.
This time, she's stretching herself a bit by trying on a more mature swimsuit.
She's excited about this new summer she gets to spend with Ryza and the others.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Seasonal characters' M.ATK by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Beach Charm

character.name: Klaudia
character.profile_voice_text: This outfit might be a little too adventurous... But if I'm with Ryza, I'll be fine!

character.acquisition_text: I'll shine even brighter than the blazing sun!
character.description:
A fledgling alchemist passionate about reviving alchemy.
She dreams of bringing alchemy back to its former glory and works tirelessly toward that goal every day.
To enjoy the summer, she's wearing a precious swimsuit chosen by her best friend Izana.
Even in this fairy-like adorable outfit, she doesn't forget her straw hat for sun protection.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Seasonal characters' burst skill damage and stun damage by 75%.
leader_skill.name: Summer Calls for Bold Choices

character.name: Resna
character.profile_voice_text: I'm not great with strong sunlight, but... I'll power through with this swimsuit!

A Day in the Life of Songstress Diona
Flowers That Bloom in a Drought

dialog.description: The Atelier has been unlocked.
dialog.name: Atelier Unlocked

dialog.description: Recipes have been unlocked.
dialog.name: Recipes Unlocked

dialog.description: Quests have been unlocked.
dialog.name: Quests Unlocked

dialog.description: Growboards and Glowing Orb Quests have been unlocked.
dialog.name: Growboards Unlocked

dialog.description:
Dungeons have been unlocked. 
You can find synthesis materials in dungeons.
dialog.name: Dungeons Unlocked

dialog.description: Piece Quests have been unlocked. You can select these through the Training Quests at Quests.
dialog.name: Piece Quests Unlocked

dialog.description: Research has been unlocked. You can select it at the Atelier.
dialog.name: Unlocking Research

dialog.description: Secret Quests have been unlocked. You can select them at Quests.
dialog.name: Unlocking Secret Quests

dialog.description:
Training Research has been unlocked.
You can access it from the Atelier's Research section.
dialog.name: Training Research Unlocked

dialog.description: You can unlock new recipes when you meet certain conditions. You will also earn rewards when unlocking new recipes. Tap on the recipe icons to check the Idea Requirements for each recipe.
dialog.name: Recipes

dialog.description: There are also rewards based on the total number of recipes you have unlocked.
dialog.name: Total Recipe Rewards

dialog.description: There are rewards for obtaining recipes, as well as rewards based on the total number of recipes you have obtained.
dialog.name: Recipes Rewards

dialog.description: Here, you can change the characters in your party and the battle items that you take with you into battle. Tap on a selected character or the + button to change the characters in your party.
dialog.name: Editing Your Party

dialog.description: You can select one character as the leader of your party. The leader will activate their Leader Skill, increasing the strength of your party. You can change your leader at any time you can change your party lineup.
dialog.name: Leader

dialog.description: Tap the button on the top right of the screen to change your Characters' equipment. Any equipment changed here will not affect other parties.
dialog.name: Equipment

dialog.description: By using the "Saved Set" button on the far right of the equipment change dialog, you can load and equip a saved set of Memoria and equipment.
dialog.name: Saved Set

dialog.description: Tap the button on the lower left of the screen to select the battle items you will take into battle. Normal quests and dungeons will allow for different quantities.
dialog.name: Editing Your Items

dialog.description: By tapping the Auto Select button, you can automatically select characters, items, and equipment for your party.
dialog.name: Auto Select

dialog.description: You can swap between 10 different party setups for normal quests and dungeons. You can switch parties by tapping the tabs on the top right of the screen.
dialog.name: Swapping Parties

dialog.description: You can check the party compositions other users used to clear quests. Clear party information is not displayed for certain quests like the Roman Grand Battle Tournament and Legend Challenge.
dialog.name: Clear Party

dialog.description: Here, you can check character information, level them up through Training, as well as change their equipment.
dialog.name: Character List

dialog.description: Characters that own multiple skins can switch between them using the button in the top left corner.
dialog.name: Switching Skins

dialog.description: The Training tab allows you to check the stats of each character, as well as level them up or Awaken them.
dialog.name: Training Characters

dialog.description: To level up a character, you need Cole and Experience Candy. On the Level Up screen, you can select Experience Candies to level up the character of your choice.
dialog.name: Leveling Up Characters

dialog.description: You can Awaken a character by using a certain amount of that character's Pieces. Awakening has several benefits, such as raising character stats, unlocking abilities, and leveling up their burst skill.
dialog.name: How to Awaken Characters

dialog.description:
By using an Elixir of Return and partially resetting your character's training, you can gain items based on the progress made so far.
Note: Resetting will affect the progress of missions and recipes.
dialog.name: Character Training Reset

dialog.description: Selecting the Reset Level Only option allows you to reset level progression while keeping the board unlock status unchanged.
dialog.name: Reset Level Only

dialog.description: Use Shards of Hope or Fruit of Hope to unlock a character's level limit. This enhancement cannot be reset, even if you reset the character's training, and the items used for this purpose cannot be returned.
dialog.name: Unlock Character Level Limit

dialog.description: On the Equipment tab, you can check and swap your characters' equipment and Memoria.
dialog.name: Equipment

dialog.description: Equip All allows you to automatically select equipment and Memoria from those you currently possess. The Remove function will remove all the equipment and Memoria that you currently have equipped.
dialog.name: Equip All/Remove

dialog.description: Equipping a Memoria to a character will raise their stats. Different Memoria will raise different stats, and leveling a Memoria will alter the bonuses it gives.
dialog.name: Improving Stats with Memorias

dialog.description: Each Memoria has an associated ability. Keep each character's role and attribute affinities in mind when choosing which Memoria to equip.
dialog.name: Obtaining Abilities with Memorias

dialog.description: Characters can equip 1 of each of the 3 types of equipment: weapons, armor, and accessories.
dialog.name: Equipment

dialog.description: Equipping items increases a character's stats and gives them access to their traits and effects. Keep character roles and attribute affinities in mind when choosing the most appropriate items.
dialog.name: Equipped Item Effects

dialog.description: Tap the Recommended checkbox to display only the equipment and Memoria that are suitable for the currently selected character.
dialog.name: Display Recommended

dialog.description: The equipment you set here will be equipped when the character is added to the party lineup. Make sure to set equipment that suits the character.
dialog.name: Character Equipment and Party Equipment

dialog.description: On the Board tab, you can enhance characters by unlocking their panels.
dialog.name: Growboards

dialog.description: By unlocking panels, you can increase character stats, level up their skills, and increase their maximum level. Cole and Glowing Orbs are required to unlock panels.
dialog.name: Growboards - Unlocking Panels

dialog.description: Once you've unlocked all the panels on a board, you'll be able to move to the next board. Boards are added as you progress through the main story.
dialog.name: Growboards - Unlocking Boards

dialog.description: The Glowing Orbs needed to unlock panels can be acquired by going on the Glowing Orb Quests that you can find listed under Training Quests. You can also gain Glowing Orbs during synthesis.
dialog.name: Collecting Glowing Orbs

dialog.description: You can unlock a character's EX Board using Sacred Orbs. Once you unlock an EX Board, you can begin to unlock panels on the board. Sacred Orbs are rare materials, so use them with care.
dialog.name: About EX Boards

dialog.description:
NeoBoards are unlocked when Character Development research reaches level 40 or higher,
allowing you to further strengthen characters that meet the following conditions.
dialog.name: About NeoBoards

dialog.description:
• Level 90 or higher
• Growboard fully unlocked
• EX Board fully unlocked
dialog.name: Characters Eligible for NeoBoard

dialog.description:
Unlocking a NeoBoard requires "Grand Orbs".
After unlocking, the Growboard and EX Board are integrated into the NeoBoard,
and character development reset becomes unavailable.
dialog.name: Unlocking NeoBoards

dialog.description: Here you can check the Memoria that you currently own. Tap on a Memoria to see its details.
dialog.name: Memoria List

dialog.description: On the Details screen you can check the stats and abilities of a Memoria. You can also level up and unlock it.
dialog.name: Memoria Detail Screen

dialog.description: To level up a Memoria, you need Cole and power up materials. On the Level Up screen, you can select Power Up Dew and other Memoria to increase the level of the selected Memoria.
dialog.name: Leveling Up Memoria

dialog.description: You can obtain Power Up Dew by completing Power Up Dew Quests, which you can find under Training Quests.
dialog.name: Collecting Power Up Dew

dialog.description: You can unlock Memoria by consuming Memorias with the same name. Unlocking Memoria enhances their abilities.
dialog.name: Unlocking Memoria

dialog.description: The rewards you receive improve based on your score. Your score is calculated based on the actions you take during battles.
dialog.name: Score Battles

dialog.description: On the Results screen, you can see which items you were graded on and their score. You will be ranked based on your score, with higher rankings giving better rewards.
dialog.name: Ranks and Rewards

dialog.description: When you perform Swift Hunt in a Score Battle, you will automatically receive the highest rank you previously earned for that battle.
dialog.name: Ranks and Rewards

dialog.description: You will need to spend stamina to explore dungeons. In dungeons, you will fight different enemies in multiple battles, with your HP carrying over each battle. The strength of enemies and materials you can obtain will vary depending on the difficulty level.
dialog.name: Dungeons

dialog.description: Swipe Right: Move forward. Swipe Left: Go back. Tap the auto button on the top right of the screen to move automatically.
dialog.name: Dungeons: Basic Controls

dialog.description: Each dungeon has three Blessings. A Blessing will give you its indicated effect that can turn battles in your favor as you progress through dungeons.
dialog.name: Dungeons: Positive Effects

dialog.description: You will find Gathering Points in dungeons. Tap the Gathering Tool icon to gather synthesis materials.
dialog.name: Dungeons: Gathering

dialog.description: You will encounter enemies while moving through a dungeon. You will need to defeat them to progress further.
dialog.name: Dungeons: Battles

dialog.description: At the end of each dungeon, a boss guards the exit. You must defeat the boss to clear the dungeon.
dialog.name: Dungeons: Bosses

dialog.description: Clearing a dungeon will unlock the Swift Gather feature. This allows you to spend stamina to collect rewards from the dungeon without having to explore it manually.
dialog.name: Dungeon Swift Gather

dialog.description: Start on the 1st floor and work your way up by clearing battles. Higher floors have stronger enemies. You can take this challenge as many times as you want, without spending stamina.
dialog.name: The Elemental Tower

dialog.description: Each floor has various Floor Effects that will be active during battles on that floor. Each floor is different, and you can check the current effects during battle.
dialog.name: Floor Effects

dialog.description: You can obtain rare items such as Lodestar Gems and Sacred Orbs when you clear floors in the Elemental Tower. The higher you go, the better the rewards.
dialog.name: Clear Rewards

dialog.description: Training Quests reward you with various materials that will help strengthen your characters and Memoria.
dialog.name: Training Quests

dialog.description: Each Training Quest involves various battle missions. After clearing all of the missions one time, you will be able to skip them.
dialog.name: Battle Missions

dialog.description: All Training Quests other than Piece Quests give daily bonuses up to 3 times a day. Daily bonuses increase the rewards that you get from each quest.
dialog.name: Daily Bonuses

dialog.description: These quests give large amounts of Cole, which is used to enhance characters and conduct research.
dialog.name: Cole Quests

dialog.description: These quests give large amounts of experience to your characters when you clear them.
dialog.name: EXP Quests

dialog.description: These quests reward you with Power Up Dew, which is required to level up Memorias.
dialog.name: Power Up Dew Quests

dialog.description: These quests reward you with Glowing Orbs, which you will need to power up Growboards.
dialog.name: Glowing Orb Quests

dialog.description: There are 6 types of Glowing Orb Quests: Red, Yellow, Blue, Green, Purple, and All. You can challenge any of the quests at any time.
dialog.name: Selecting Glowing Orbs

dialog.description: These quests reward you with the Pieces that you need to Awaken characters. Normally, you can only do these quests 3 times per day, but spending Lodestar Gems will allow you to challenge them an additional 2 times.
dialog.name: Piece Quests

dialog.description: When you clear a quest, you will receive Pieces for the characters in your party. Use characters that you want to power up when you take on these quests!
dialog.name: Piece Quests

dialog.description: At the Star's Cocoon, you can accept quests offered by Ryza and the other cafe staff.
dialog.name: Quests

dialog.description: Most quests require you to spend stamina. Spent stamina restores over time.
dialog.name: Stamina

dialog.description: Obtain materials that will help enhance your characters and Memorias.
dialog.name: Training Quests

dialog.description: Gather materials used in synthesis. These quests are split into 2 types: Score Battles and Dungeons.
dialog.name: Material Quests

dialog.description: These quests will give you a special challenge. Start on the 1st floor of the Elemental Tower and work your way to the top. The higher the floor, the stronger the enemies you will face.
dialog.name: Secret Quests

dialog.description: You can recover stamina by receiving pies from Rorona. You can receive 2 pies per day.
dialog.name: Orders

dialog.description: You can order pies from Rorona. Each pie will recover 100 stamina.
dialog.name: Orders

dialog.description: Pies will finish baking at 11:00 and 17:00 (UTC+8) every day. You can store up to 2 pies, but any stored pies unclaimed by 10:59 (UTC+8) the following day will disappear.
dialog.name: Obtaining Pies

dialog.description: Here, you can take on battles and see the stories from various Events.
dialog.name: Event Stories

dialog.description: You will receive First-Time Rewards the first time you see an Event story or clear an Event battle.
dialog.name: First-Time Rewards

dialog.description: This is a limited-time event dungeon that requires a Challenge Ticket to enter. Check the details for each Event to see how to obtain Challenge Tickets.
dialog.name: Event Dungeons

dialog.description: There are some synthesis materials that can only be obtained during limited-time events. These materials are usually used for limited-time event recipes, so make sure to gather them whenever you can.
dialog.name: Gatherable Synthesis Materials

dialog.description: This content requires a Challenge Ticket to enter. Check the details for each Event to see how to obtain Challenge Tickets.
dialog.name: Event Score Battles

dialog.description:
Your rank is determined by the score that you get based on your battle performance. 
Enemies will drop rewards after battles that are based on your current rank. When you perform Swift Hunting, your highest past rank will be referenced.
dialog.name: Drop Rewards

dialog.description: The amount of synthesis materials and coins you obtain increases based on the Memoria you possess. The bonus amount increases with rank, and if you possess multiple copies of the same Memoria, the ranks are combined up to a maximum of V.
dialog.name: Memoria Bonus

dialog.description: This content requires a Challenge Ticket to enter, and will place you against powerful enemies. Check the details for each Event to see how to obtain Challenge Tickets.
dialog.name: Boss Challenges

dialog.description:
Your rank is determined by the score that you get based on your battle performance. 
Enemies will drop rewards after battles that are based on your current rank. When you perform Swift Hunting, your highest past rank will be referenced.
dialog.name: Drop Rewards

dialog.description: These quests have special rewards for reaching certain ranks. Each time you go up a rank, you will receive a Rank Clear Reward. Tap the treasure box icon to receive your rewards.
dialog.name: Rank Clear Rewards

dialog.description: You can challenge battles by renting characters and Memoria suitable for battle. Since the rewards don't change, try challenging with a rental party and synthesis items when you find it difficult.
dialog.name: Rental Party

dialog.description: EX Challenges are extremely difficult battles against super powerful foes.
dialog.name: EX Challenges

dialog.description: You will not receive reward drops after EX Challenge battles. Instead, you will be given Rank Rewards when your rank goes up.
dialog.name: Rewards

dialog.description: You can conduct Synthesis at the Atelier. Convert and Research are also available here.
dialog.name: About the Atelier

dialog.description: Synthesis allows you to use materials and mana to create battle items that can be used in combat and equipment that can be used by your characters.
dialog.name: Synthesis

dialog.description: You can see the items you can synthesize and their required materials on the left side of the screen. On the right side, you can use the tabs to find the type of item you want to synthesize. Then, tap the Recipe icon to select.
dialog.name: Selecting a Recipe

dialog.description:
Simple synthesis allows you to perform synthesis without needing to select a lineup. You can bulk synthesize up to 100 times depending on the amount of mana and materials you have.
The traits on items are randomly selected from a set of random traits.
dialog.name: Simple Synthesis

dialog.description: Filter by affinity or role to display recommended recipes. Simply select an attribute and/or role and press the Confirm button to show recipes suitable for the relevant character.
dialog.name: Search Recommended Recipes

dialog.description: Recipes marked with "Bonus" are featured recipes. During the feature period, there's a higher chance of creating high rarity synthesis items and getting high-level traits.
dialog.name: Recipe Pick-up

dialog.description: In "Popular Compositions," you can check popular recipes for each item. You can also rent unowned characters that appear in the top 3 positions up to 10 times per day for synthesis.
dialog.name: Popular Recipes & Rental Synthesis

dialog.description: By selecting which character performs the synthesis and which materials are used, you can add special traits to the synthesized items. Traits give items various effects.
dialog.name: Preparing to Synthesize

dialog.description: You can select the characters and materials for each synthesis by dragging and dropping their icons to the middle of the screen, or by tapping on them.
dialog.name: Selecting Characters and Materials

dialog.description: All recipes, characters, and synthesis materials have an associated Gift Color. By linking the same colors, you can reveal traits that will be applied to the item that you are creating.
dialog.name: Gift Colors and Revealing Traits

dialog.description: The traits applied to a synthesized item will be chosen randomly from the traits revealed during synthesis. Each trait will also have a random trait level. Battle items can have a total of 3 traits, while equipment can have 2.
dialog.name: Trait Application and Trait Levels

dialog.description: There are two types of traits: battle item traits, and equipment traits. Synthesis materials will all have traits of one type or the other. When synthesizing battle items, you can choose to use only materials with battle item traits.
dialog.name: Trait Types

dialog.description: Each item created through synthesis has a Quality assigned to it. The higher the compatibility of the traits are on the item, the higher the quality value will be.
dialog.name: Quality

dialog.description: When synthesizing, you have a chance to obtain Trait Catalysts for traits that are candidates for application. Using these Trait Catalysts increases the chance of the corresponding trait being applied to the synthesis item.
dialog.name: Trait Catalyst

dialog.description: You can convert synthesized items into Shiny Coins. The amount of Shiny Coins that you will receive changes according to the rarity and trait Levels of the synthesized item.
dialog.name: Item Conversion

dialog.description: Shiny Coins can be exchanged for other items in the Shop.
dialog.name: Using Shiny Coins

dialog.description:
Here you can use Cole or Shiny Coins to strengthen your characters and items.
There are three types of research: Battle Research, Alchemy Research, and Training Research.
dialog.name: Research

dialog.description: Combat Research allows you to power up the specialties of each role. Through research, you can obtain effects such as HP Up and Dealt Damage Up.
dialog.name: Combat Research

dialog.description: Alchemy Research allows you to power up the specialties of battle items and equipment. Through research, you can improve the effects of battle items and the stats on equipment, among other things.
dialog.name: Alchemy Research

dialog.description:
Training Research allows you to raise the minimum character level.
Example: If the minimum character level is 50,
a level 10 character can be fielded as if they are level 50.
dialog.name: Training Research

dialog.description:
Tap the Research Effects List button to
view a list of all the research effects you have obtained.
dialog.name: Check Obtained Effects

dialog.description: Ryza's Challenge is a cooperative mission experience in which players share progress and take on challenges together.
dialog.name: Ryza's Challenge

dialog.description:
As you complete each challenge level, you can earn a selection of rewards, including exclusive recipes.
Please refer to the announcements for more details.
dialog.name: Ryza's Challenge Rewards

dialog.description:
Each time you exchange, you will receive some of the contents from the Box,
and eventually you will be able to obtain all of the items inside.
You can check what's inside the Box from the Box List.
dialog.name: About Event Boon Boxes

dialog.description:
Once you have emptied the contents of the Box, you will move to the next Box,
and all items will be replaced.
dialog.name: Replacing Boxes

dialog.description:
Emblems can be earned by fulfilling specific conditions.
Each emblem has a unique effect that is activated simply by possessing the emblem.
dialog.name: What are Emblems?

dialog.description: The higher the rarity of an emblem, the stronger its effect. If you have multiple emblems of the same type, only the highest effect will be applied.
dialog.name: Emblem Effects

dialog.description:
By selecting a location and characters for exploration, you can automatically collect various items over time.
Collected items can be received using the "Obtain" button on the home screen.
dialog.name: Exploration

dialog.description: As you progress through the main story, more locations will become available.
dialog.name: Location Selection

dialog.description:
The items that drop and the chances of them dropping vary based on the following:
- Score Battle completion status
- Player Rank
dialog.name: Dropped Items

dialog.description: Each location has recommended Top Pick Characters. Always try to send them to these locations to get a higher lineup bonus.
dialog.name: Top Pick Characters

dialog.description: Each destination has recommended characters. They change periodically, but including them in your party grants high bonuses, so be sure to bring them along.
dialog.name: Recommended Characters

dialog.description:
The exploration lineup is made up of the characters you select to explore a location. 
Depending on the characters you select, you can improve the efficiency of acquiring items and earn bonus items.
dialog.name: Exploration Lineup

dialog.description:
In addition to using Top Pick Characters, 
the bonus also varies based on the awakening level of each character.
dialog.name: Lineup Bonus

dialog.description:
Revival Events are events that were playable in the past and have become available again. 
If you participated in the event in the past, you can continue from where you left off. 
It's also possible to obtain recipes and materials that were only available from the event.
dialog.name: What's a Revival Event?

dialog.description: You'll need a Key of Memories to unlock the event. One Key of Memories is needed to unlock one event. Keys of Memories can be obtained from many places, such as event rewards.
dialog.name: How to Play Revival Events

dialog.description: Challenging a Revival Event will consume stamina instead of challenge tickets.
dialog.name: Difference between Revival Events and Standard Events

dialog.description: Here, you can take on battles and see the stories from various events.
dialog.name: Event Stories (Revival)

dialog.description:
The first time you view a story or clear a battle, you can obtain First-Time Rewards.
Note: You will not receive First-Time Rewards if you already received them when the event was previously run.
dialog.name: First-Time Rewards

dialog.description: Revival Events require the use of Stamina to enter the event dungeon. You will still be able to obtain synthesis materials during Revival Events that were previously only available in limited-time events.
dialog.name: Event Dungeon (Revival)

dialog.description: You can challenge Score Battles in Revival Events by using stamina. If you participated in the event in the past, your Clear and Rank statuses will carry over when playing again.
dialog.name: Event Score Battles (Revival)

dialog.description:
Your rank is determined by the score that you get based on your battle performance. 
Enemies will drop rewards after battles that are based on your current rank. When you perform Swift Hunting, your highest past rank will be referenced.
dialog.name: Drop Rewards

dialog.description: Take on Boss Challenges in Revival Events by using stamina. If you participated in the event in the past, your Clear status, Rank status, and obtained Rank Clear Rewards will carry over when playing again.
dialog.name: Boss Challenges (Revival)

dialog.description:
Your rank is determined by the score that you get based on your battle performance. 
Enemies will drop rewards after battles that are based on your current rank. When you perform Swift Hunting, your highest past rank will be referenced.
dialog.name: Drop Rewards

dialog.description: These quests have special rewards for reaching certain ranks. Each time you go up a rank, you will receive a Rank Clear Reward. Tap the treasure box icon to receive your rewards.
dialog.name: Rank Clear Rewards

dialog.description: EX Challenges are extremely difficult battles against very powerful foes. If you participated in the event in the past, your Clear status, Rank status, and obtained Rank Clear Rewards will carry over when playing again.
dialog.name: EX Challenges (Revival)

dialog.description: You will not receive reward drops after EX Challenge battles. Instead, you will be given Rank Rewards when your rank goes up.
dialog.name: Rewards

dialog.description: These are special boss challenges that are unlocked over time. These battles feature enemies with unique changes from standard battles and offer specific conditions that can significantly increase your score.
dialog.name: SP Challenge

dialog.description: In this game mode, you use synthesis items to aim for higher scores. Depending on the scores you achieve, you can earn various rewards.
dialog.name: Item Challenge

dialog.description:
Changing the items used increases the performance parameters, which vary depending on the type and traits of the items.
Parameters that are considered more important will be highlighted.
dialog.name: Parameters

dialog.description: Each Item Challenge has designated items that can be used.These items can more effectively boost parameters, so use them wisely to aim for a high score.
dialog.name: Special Effects

dialog.description:
Each Item Challenge has designated items that can be used.
These items can more effectively boost parameters, so use them wisely to aim for a high score.
dialog.name: Special Effects

dialog.description: Roman's Grand Tournament is a regularly held battle event. Your ranking changes based on your total damage dealt, and you can earn various rewards depending on your ranking.
dialog.name: Roman's Grand Tournament

dialog.description:
Battles in this event have a turn limit. When the remaining turns reach 0, the battle ends and total damage is tallied.
Note: Total damage is recorded regardless of victory or defeat.
dialog.name: Special Battle Rules

dialog.description: The actual measure of damage is not the amount of damage dealt, but the amount of enemy HP reduced. Therefore, any damage that exceeds the enemy's maximum HP will not be counted.
dialog.name: Total Damage Measurement

dialog.description: The highest difficulty battles feature enemies with infinite HP. Here, you simply need to maximize your total damage within the specified number of turns.
dialog.name: High Difficulty Battles

dialog.description: After the event period ends, you will receive rewards based on your rank. Ranking rewards will be distributed via Mail after you log back in once the event has ended.
dialog.name: Ranking Rewards

dialog.description: At the Beach House, you can enjoy a selection of content including stories and battles. Over time you will also automatically collect items at the Beach House. You can use the items to take on certain challenges.
dialog.name: Beach House

dialog.description: You can upgrade the Beach House level from the button in the upper left corner. As the Beach House level increases, items will be collected at a more efficient rate. It might also unlock some new features, or even change the appearance of the Beach House!
dialog.name: LEVEL UP

dialog.description:
The Item Rental system allows you to rent out synthesis items to customers and receive Beach House Rental Coins as a reward at 11:00 (UTC+8) the next day.
Note: Rental Items will not be consumed, and can also still be used in battle.
dialog.name: Item Rental

dialog.description: Item Rental also has trends. Renting items that are trending will give you additional bonuses when you receive your rewards.
dialog.name: Trend Bonus

dialog.description:
Note that if you start rentals without filling all rental slots, you will not be able to add items to the empty slots until the rental period ends.
Note: Rentals cannot be canceled once started, so be careful when starting your rentals.
dialog.name: Cautions for Item Rental

dialog.description: Beach Flag Race is a turn-attack dungeon where your rank is determined by the total number of turns taken to clear the dungeon. There are no Gathering Points, and rewards are based on your rank.
dialog.name: Beach Flag Race

dialog.description: Beach Flag Races can be taken on by using challenge attempts. Even after completing the dungeon, if you're not satisfied with the results, you can exit and retry without consuming an attempt.
dialog.name: Attempts

dialog.description: In Beach Flag Race, you can battle with a team lineup of your choice, but the runner in the dungeon will be Resna in her swimsuit. However, if some of her friends are also in swimsuits, the runner might change!
dialog.name: Beach Flag Runners

dialog.description: You can now set different equipment for each party! Use the button in the top right to change the equipment of the characters in your current lineup.
dialog.name: Party Equipment Feature Added!

dialog.description:
On the Equip All screen, you can change the equipment for characters in your party lineup.
Note: Equipment changes made here won't affect other parties.
dialog.name: Equip All Screen

dialog.description: You can also now save your favorite combinations of Memoria and equipment to Saved Sets, allowing you to quickly load them when needed.
dialog.name: Saved Set

dialog.description: While editing a party lineup, you can open the Equip All screen by tapping the Equip button at the bottom of the screen.
dialog.name: Equipment in the Party Lineup Screen

dialog.description: When you add a character to a party lineup, their initial equipment will be the equipment set on their Character screen.
dialog.name: Character Equipment and Party Equipment

dialog.description: Enjoy stories with the Characters you have unlocked.
dialog.name: Bonds

dialog.description:
A Key of Friendship is required to unlock the stories of a Character whose stories are still locked.
Keys of Friendship are primarily obtained as a reward for Weekly Missions.
dialog.name: Unlocking Stories

dialog.description: Each story has specific conditions that must be met to unlock it. Once these conditions are met, you'll be able to view the story.
dialog.name: Story Unlock Conditions

dialog.description: In Chapter 3, you can turn Photo Mode on during the story by tapping the camera icon in the top left corner.
dialog.name: Chapter 3: Turn Photo Mode On

dialog.description:
While Photo Mode is turned on, you can move the camera and zoom in and out.
Note: Camera movement is only available while zoomed in.
dialog.name: Chapter 3: Photo Mode Features

dialog.description: In Chapter 4, you will be offered choices during the story that will change the ending and unlock Chapter 5. If the character has a poor reaction to your choice, try again with a different choice.
dialog.name: Chapter 4: Choices

dialog.description: In Chapter 5, you'll get to watch a special Memorial Scene to commemorate the character's story. These Memorial Scenes can be set as your home screen background after you view them.
dialog.name: Chapter 5: Memorial Scene

dialog.description: These event stories feature narrative changes depending on the choices you make along the way.
dialog.name: Event Stories with Choices

dialog.description: In some cases, your choices may affect the ending of the story. By selecting the appropriate options, the story will continue to unfold further, so be sure to explore different choices!
dialog.name: Story Branching

dialog.description: For certain stories and battles, you can earn First-Time Rewards upon viewing or clearing them for the first time.
dialog.name: First-Time Rewards

dialog.description: This is a ranking content where you compete in score battles. You can obtain various rewards based on your ranking position.
dialog.name: Legend Challenge

dialog.description: You can only challenge one battle per event, and the score evaluation criteria are the same as score battles. Keep challenging to aim for a higher score!
dialog.name: Score Calculation

dialog.description: After the event period ends, you can receive rewards based on your ranking. Ranking rewards will be distributed via mail after you log in again following the end of the period.
dialog.name: Ranking Rewards

dialog.description: By giving synthesis items as presents, you can increase your intimacy level. As intimacy increases, conversation scenes may occur and you may receive gifts from characters.
dialog.name: Present

dialog.description: You can check which synthesis items can be given as presents from the "Synthesize Presents" menu.
dialog.name: Presentable Synthesis Items

dialog.description: The friendship points required to increase intimacy are determined by the type and quality of the synthesis items given as presents.
dialog.name: Earning Friendship Points

dialog.description: Characters who have awakened to 6★ can evolve their skills. By evolving skills, their effects and power will increase, becoming more powerful.
dialog.name: Skill Evolution

dialog.description: By evolving all three skills - Skill 1, Skill 2, and Burst Skill - a third ability will be unlocked.
dialog.name: Skill Evolution

dialog.description:
The Yumia Festival Special Cup is a limited-time battle event during the Yumia Festival period.
Your ranking changes based on total damage dealt,
and you can obtain various rewards based on your ranking position.
dialog.name: Yumia Festival Special Cup

dialog.description:
Your "Total HP depleted from enemies" will be measured within a set number of turns.
In battles at the highest difficulty, enemies will appear with infinite HP.
dialog.name: Battle Format

dialog.description:
After the event period ends, you can receive rewards based on your final ranking.
Ranking rewards will be distributed via mail sequentially
after logging in again once the period has ended.
dialog.name: Ranking Rewards

dialog.description:
Investigation Bases offer various content including story and battle content.
Using the button in the top left, you can use coins collected from Score Battles
to level up facilities and obtain rewards.
dialog.name: Investigation Base

dialog.description:
At certain facility levels, events will occur where you choose
which facility to develop. Your developed facilities will be reflected in the Investigation Base,
and you can also obtain rewards based on the number of different facility types you've developed.
dialog.name: Facility Selection

dialog.description:
By meeting various event-related conditions, you can obtain
Investigation Records. Through Investigation Records, you can view
records written by various characters.
dialog.name: Investigation Records

dialog.description:
When you reach facility level 30, you can obtain a special Investigation Record.
The Investigation Record you receive will vary depending on the distribution
of facility types you've chosen up until reaching level 30.
dialog.name: Special Investigation Record

dialog.description:
After reaching facility level 30, you can perform a facility level reset.
This resets your level and facility status, allowing you to develop different facilities
and obtain different facility level rewards based on the number of times you've reset.
dialog.name: Facility Level Reset

dialog.description:
When you reset the facility level, all developed facilities will return to their initial state.
Spent coins will not be returned. After resetting, you can develop facilities again.
Aim to develop all facilities and obtain all Investigation Records!
dialog.name: Facility Level Reset

dialog.description: Total Force Battle is a special event battle where characters who have cleared a battle once cannot be deployed in other battles within the event.
dialog.name: What is Total Force Battle?

dialog.description: Characters who become unavailable for deployment can be used again by resetting the progress of the battles they have cleared, allowing them to be deployed in event battles once more.
dialog.name: Resetting Battles

dialog.description: The background color of each square indicates the difficulty of that battle. Use this as a reference when forming your party.
dialog.name: About Difficulty

dialog.description: Clear all battles in a row simultaneously to earn Achievement Line rewards. Clear all battles simultaneously to earn Complete rewards. Try different party compositions to aim for completion!
dialog.name: About Rewards

dialog.description:
Select a character from the candidates and vote for them.
Voting tickets can be synthesized. Check the recipe in "Synthesize Voting Tickets."
dialog.name: Voting

dialog.description: The collection contains all the Memoria and valuables you've obtained so far. You can earn rewards based on the total number of items collected in each category.
dialog.name: Collection

dialog.description:
This is a limited-time high-difficulty content.
You can challenge it as many times as you want without consuming Stamina or Challenge Tickets.
Starting from Floor 1, winning battles will unlock the next floor.
dialog.name: Tower Challenge

dialog.description:
Each floor may have "Floor Effects" active that provide various effects during battle.
Floor Effects differ by floor, and you can check the effects during battle.
dialog.name: Floor Effects

dialog.description: You can obtain rewards when clearing each floor for the first time.
dialog.name: Clear Rewards

dialog.description:
A battle content where the goal is to clear missions.
You can challenge battles as many times as you want without consuming Stamina or Challenge Tickets.
Change your party composition to match the missions and take on the battles.
dialog.name: Mission Battles

dialog.description:
Rewards can be obtained when you clear a mission for the first time, or when your total cleared missions reach a specified number.
Rewards can be checked in the Battle Results screen.
dialog.name: About Rewards

dialog.description: Some characters that can be obtained during events have their skills locked in their initial state. Locked skills cannot be used in battle, so use items obtainable within the event to unlock them!
dialog.name: Skill Lock and Skill Release

dialog.description:
On this screen, you can select activities.
As you progress through activities, you can raise the corresponding parameters, so let's actively engage with them!
dialog.name: Activities

dialog.description:
By giving synthesis items, parameters will increase.
When parameters increase, you may be able to view conversation scenes and obtain rewards.
dialog.name: Activities

dialog.description: Items that can be given to raise parameters can be checked from "Synthesize Items" in the bottom left.
dialog.name: Target Items

dialog.description: The EXP value required for parameter increases is determined by the type and quality of the synthesis items you give.
dialog.name: Gaining EXP

dialog.description:
Characters you've welcomed can now be displayed on the home screen.
Combine your favorite backgrounds, motions, camera angles, and BGM to create your own unique home scene.
dialog.name: Character Home

dialog.description:
Characters that can be set can be viewed on the "Change Character" screen.
Also, by registering favorites, you can find characters more easily, so use this feature as needed.
dialog.name: Creation and Editing

dialog.description:
Select a created scene and press "Confirm" to switch your home.
Even after creation, you can readjust scenes using the "Edit Home" and "Change Character" buttons.
dialog.name: Home Settings

dialog.description:
Beach Flag is a turn attack dungeon where your rank is determined by the total number of turns it takes to clear.
There are no gathering points, and rewards are determined by your rank.
dialog.name: Beach Flag

dialog.description:
You can challenge Beach Flag battles with any party composition, but the runner in the dungeon will be a character related to the event.
If you have certain other characters in your party, the runner may change...?
dialog.name: Beach Flag Runner

dialog.description:
Additionally, equipment drops as a reward in Beach Flag.
Equipment traits are randomly selected from a pool of candidates, and trait levels are also randomized.
dialog.name: Equipment Drops

dialog.description:
This is a special battle where you compete with boss Antje over chip levels.
At the start of battle, both the player and Antje are dealt two chips each.
You can also obtain chips by defeating cards that appear in battle.
dialog.name: Blackjack Battle

dialog.description:
Chips are dealt at random levels from 1 to 11.
Depending on the character, advantageous chips may be dealt more easily...?
dialog.name: About Chips

dialog.description:
When your chip level reaches 21, you can deal damage to Antje.
If your chip level goes over 21, you will burst and become unable to battle.

dialog.description: Burst skill restores the item gauge by 40% and converts all enemies' panels into weaken+ panels!
dialog.name: Saskia "Master of Alchemy" Ice | Supporter

dialog.description:
- How to Fight -
- Use Skill 2 to convert your allies' panels into boost+ panels!
- Use your ability and Burst Skill to protect your allies!
dialog.name: Saskia "Master of Alchemy" Ice | Supporter

dialog.description:
Skill 2 has 3 charge indicators, and if all indicators are charged, grants self Evasion (100% chance) and boosts P. ATK by 50% and SPD by 50%! (Note: All charge indicators will reset after activation.)
Note: Trial battles are played with a max level, fully awakened party with fully unlocked Growboards.
dialog.name: Johanna "Battle Phenom" Slash | Attacker

dialog.description:
- Has an ability that lights up 3 charge indicators on Skill 2 at the start of battle!
- If Skill 2 has less than 3 charge indicators lit, they can be lit by attacking with Skill 2 or using battle items!
dialog.name: Johanna "Battle Phenom" Slash | Attacker

dialog.description: Removes all negative effects on self before attacking with Burst Skill, and after attacking, converts the panel of the next ally in turn order at the time of skill use into a critical panel! (Excludes burst panels)
dialog.name: Johanna "Battle Phenom" Slash | Attacker

dialog.description:
- How to Fight -
- Charge the charge indicators on Skill 2 to boost your own P. ATK and SPD!
- Your increased SPD will further boost your damage through your ability, allowing you to really press the attack!
dialog.name: Johanna "Battle Phenom" Slash | Attacker

dialog.description:
After attacking with Skill 1, consumes 10% of own HP to reduce own damage received by 100% for 1 attack!
Note: Trial battles are played with a max level, fully awakened party with fully unlocked Growboards.
dialog.name: Geron "Beastly Fencer" Slash | Defender

dialog.description: After attacking with Skill 2, inflicts the target with Blindness! If own HP is 50% or higher, reduces all allies' damage received by 30%, and if own HP is lower than 50%, reduces all allies' damage received by 50% instead!
dialog.name: Geron "Beastly Fencer" Slash | Defender

dialog.description: Burst Skill deals more damage the lower own HP is! When HP is 20% or lower, boosts damage by 100%! Before attacking, also removes own negative effects, and after attacking, restores own HP by 100%!
dialog.name: Geron "Beastly Fencer" Slash | Defender

dialog.description:
- How to Fight -
- Use Skill 1 to reduce own damage received, and Skill 2 to reduce damage received by allies!
- Use the Burst Skill to restore HP to 100%!
dialog.name: Geron "Beastly Fencer" Slash | Defender

dialog.description:
After using a battle item, the next attack has a very high chance to inflict Paralysis! Defeating an enemy with a skill restores 15% HP to all allies!
Note: Trial battles are played with a max level, fully awakened party with fully unlocked Growboards.
dialog.name: Lara "Queen's Grace" Slash | Attacker

dialog.description:
When target has a status effect, boosts Skill 2's damage by 30%! After attacking, boosts own P. ATK by 5%!
Skill 2 also has a charge indicator, and if the indicator is not charged, it becomes charged when using Skill 2! When the indicator is charged, the attack also delays the target's turn by 1 turn! (Note: All charge indicators reset after activation.)
dialog.name: Lara "Queen's Grace" Slash | Attacker

dialog.description:
After attacking with Burst Skill, inflicts targets with Royal Authority for 1 turn and boosts their damage received by 50% for 2 attacks!
Note: Enemies inflicted with Royal Authority have a chance to become immobilized at the start of the turn.
dialog.name: Lara "Queen's Grace" Slash | Attacker

dialog.description:
- How to Fight -
- Make use of Skill 2 and Burst Skill to disrupt the enemy's turns!
- Use Burst Skill to boost damage received by enemies, then press the attack!
dialog.name: Lara "Queen's Grace" Slash | Attacker

dialog.description:
The ability "Kitty Cat Team" grants her immunity to negative panels, while also boosting the potency of the positive panels she uses by 10%!
Note: Trial battles are played with a max level, fully awakened party with fully unlocked Growboards.
dialog.name: Eren "Noble Wolf" Air | Attacker

dialog.description:
She boosts her own M. ATK by 10% whenever she uses a panel or heals! (MAX 100%) 
Plus, the wait time on her skills is short, letting her act more quickly! Skill 2 boosts the current attack's damage by 50% when attacking a weakness!
dialog.name: Eren "Noble Wolf" Air | Attacker

dialog.description: Her Burst Skill boosts her M. ATK by 30%! It also boosts her SPD by 50%!
dialog.name: Eren "Noble Wolf" Air | Attacker

dialog.description:
- How to Fight -
- Boost her M. ATK by using panels, recovering HP, and using her burst skill!
- Raise her SPD with her Burst Skill and lay on the attacks!
dialog.name: Eren "Noble Wolf" Air | Attacker

dialog.description:
When using panels or receiving HP recovery, boosts own P. ATK by 10% (MAX 100%) and boosts Stab damage by 30% for 1 turn! (MAX 5 turns)
Note: Trial battles are played with a max level, fully awakened party with fully unlocked Growboards.
dialog.name: Mieke "Fashionable Kitty" Stab | Attacker

dialog.description: Before attacking with Skill 2, reduces the target's Stab resistance by 25% and boosts the target's physical attack damage received by 15%! After attacking, boosts own P. ATK by 10%! (MAX 30%)
dialog.name: Mieke "Fashionable Kitty" Stab | Attacker

dialog.description: Burst Skill boosts the attack's penetration by 150. Before attacking, boosts the target's physical attack damage received by 50% (MAX 100%), and after attacking, converts next panel for self into a boost+ panel! (Excludes burst panels)
dialog.name: Mieke "Fashionable Kitty" Stab | Attacker

dialog.description:
- How to Fight -
- Use panels and HP recovery to boost own damage!
- Use Skill 2 and Burst Skill to weaken enemies while also going on the offensive!
dialog.name: Mieke "Fashionable Kitty" Stab | Attacker

dialog.description:
After attacking with Skill 1, boosts P. ATK of all allies with Slash affinity by 10% (MAX 20%) and boosts target's Slash damage received by 15%!
Note: Trial battles are played with a max level, fully awakened party with fully unlocked Growboards.
dialog.name: Diona "Fervorous Diva" Slash | Supporter

dialog.description: After attacking with Skill 2, boosts the skill power of all Attacker allies with Slash affinity by 30% (MAX 60%), and reduces the target's Slash resistance by 25%!
dialog.name: Diona "Fervorous Diva" Slash | Supporter

dialog.description:
Using Skill 2 also grants the following additional effects to all allies for 1 turn!
- Before attacking, reduces target's status effect resistance by 50% for 1 turn. (MAX 50%)
- After attacking, there is a very high chance to inflict the target with Paralysis for 1 turn.
dialog.name: Diona "Fervorous Diva" Slash | Supporter

dialog.description: After attacking with Burst Skill, boosts the skill power and P. ATK of the ally with the highest P. ATK! If the target is inflicted with Paralysis, Sleep, Daze, or Royal Authority, converts or creates one burst panel each for all allies.
dialog.name: Diona "Fervorous Diva" Slash | Supporter

dialog.description:
- How to Fight -
- Use Skill 2 and Burst Skill to enhance allied Attackers!
- Inflict debuffs on enemies with Skill 1 and Skill 2 to support the attacks of your allies with Slash affinity!
dialog.name: Diona "Fervorous Diva" Slash | Supporter

dialog.description:
When attack target is stunned, boosts own skill damage by 100% for 2 turns and boosts all allies' Skill 2 penetration by 20! (MAX 100)
Note: Trial battles are played with a max level, fully awakened party with fully unlocked Growboards.
dialog.name: Magda "Pinkish Destroyer" Stab | Breaker

dialog.description: Before attacking with Skill 2, reduces target's Stab resistance by 25% for 2 attacks. After attacking, boosts Stab damage of the ally with the highest P. ATK by 30% for 2 turns! When the attack target is stunned, delays the target's turn by 2 turns.
dialog.name: Magda "Pinkish Destroyer" Stab | Breaker

dialog.description:
Before attacking with Burst Skill, reduces the target's Stab resistance by 30% for 3 attacks. After attacking, boosts P. ATK of the ally with the highest P. ATK by 35% for 1 turn! When the target is stunned, inflicts the target with "Brawl Master's Blow" for 1 turn!
Note: Enemies inflicted with Brawl Master's Blow become immobilized at the start of their turn.
dialog.name: Magda "Pinkish Destroyer" Stab | Breaker

dialog.description:
- How to Fight -
Use Skill 2 and Burst Skill to weaken enemies while also enhancing allies! Stun enemies to disrupt their actions while also boosting the penetration of all allies' Skill 2.
dialog.name: Magda "Pinkish Destroyer" Stab | Breaker

dialog.description:
Has one ability that boosts potency of all allies' negative effects inflicted by 15%, and another that boosts skill damage and stun damage of all allies with Stab affinity by 40%!
Note: Trial battles are played with a max level, fully awakened party with fully unlocked Growboards.
dialog.name: Brad "Passionate Blood" Stab | Supporter

dialog.description:
Skill 2 reduces all enemies' damage by 10%, and boosts their Stab damage received by 75% for 2 attacks! (MAX 4)
Note: These numbers reflect the effects at skill level 5.
dialog.name: Brad "Passionate Blood" Stab | Supporter

dialog.description: After attacking with Burst Skill, boosts target's physical attack damage received by 50% for 2 attacks and boosts potency of effects received from boost-type panels for all allies by 50%! (Cannot be stacked)
dialog.name: Brad "Passionate Blood" Stab | Supporter

dialog.description:
- How to Fight -
Support allies with Stab affinity by using Skill 2 to boost Stab damage received by enemies, as well as Burst Skill to boost the physical attack damage received by enemies!
dialog.name: Brad "Passionate Blood" Stab | Supporter

dialog.description:
Has an ability that grants the following additional effect to all allies with Bolt affinity:
- After attacking, boosts target's damage received by 15% for 1 attack. (MAX 4)
Note: Trial battles are played with a max level, fully awakened party with fully unlocked Growboards.
dialog.name: Antje "Magical Puppeteer" Bolt | Supporter

dialog.description: Skill 2 boosts all enemies' critical damage received by 50% (MAX 150%), reduces all enemies' damage dealt, and reduces their Bolt resistance by 25% for 2 attacks! (MAX 4)
dialog.name: Antje "Magical Puppeteer" Bolt | Supporter

dialog.description: After attacking with Burst Skill, boosts M. ATK of the ally with the highest M. ATK by 30% (MAX 50%) and boosts all allies' skill damage by 50% when attacking a weakness for 1 turn! (MAX 100%)
dialog.name: Antje "Magical Puppeteer" Bolt | Supporter

dialog.description:
- How to Fight -
- Use Skill 2 to reduce Bolt resistance of all enemies while also boosting the critical damage they receive!
- Use Burst Skill to boost all allies' skill damage when attacking a weakness and quickly take out enemies!
dialog.name: Antje "Magical Puppeteer" Bolt | Supporter

dialog.description:
Has an ability that, before using a skill, if the target is inflicted with 5 or more negative effects, boosts that attack's critical rate by 100%!
Note: Trial battles are played with a max level, fully awakened party with fully unlocked Growboards.
dialog.name: Walther "Wisdom Inquirer" Bolt | Attacker

dialog.description:
After attacking with Skill 1, boosts own skill damage by 35% for 1 turn and boosts target's Bolt damage received by 30%! (MAX 60%)
In addition, converts all enemies' panels other than burst panels into chem panels. (Creates chem panels if the panel is empty)
dialog.name: Walther "Wisdom Inquirer" Bolt | Attacker

dialog.description:
If a chem panel is used by an enemy, it reduces that enemy's SPD by 3%!
If used by an ally, it boosts damage received by 3% and skill damage by 50%!
dialog.name: Walther "Wisdom Inquirer" Bolt | Attacker

dialog.description:
Has an ability that activates Burst Skill when using a chem panel!
Burst Skill boosts own damage with higher HP, up to 120%! After attacking, boosts the target's magic attack damage received by 50%! (MAX 100%)
dialog.name: Walther "Wisdom Inquirer" Bolt | Attacker

dialog.description:
- How to Fight -
Use chem panels to activate Burst Skill! Inflict negative effects on enemies using allies' skills and battle items in order to consistently use critical attacks!
dialog.name: Walther "Wisdom Inquirer" Bolt | Attacker

dialog.description:
With this ability, when using a battle item, grants self Force Stun until end of action! (Maximum 3 activations)
Note: Trial battles are at max level, max awakening stage, and full Grow Board release
dialog.name: Klicessa "Ambitious Alchemist" Bolt | Breaker

dialog.description: Additionally, when an attack target becomes stunned by using Skill 1 or Skill 2, converts or creates all panels except burst panels for all allies into Wisdom Release panels!
dialog.name: Klicessa "Ambitious Alchemist" Bolt | Breaker

dialog.description: Wisdom Release panels: When self obtains one, allows Burst Skill activation! When an ally obtains one, boosts their skill power and all allies' M.ATK! When an enemy obtains one, increases their magic attack damage received!
dialog.name: Klicessa "Ambitious Alchemist" Bolt | Breaker

dialog.description: Before attacking with Burst Skill, reduces target's Bolt resistance by 35%! After attacking, boosts target's Bolt damage received by 75%! (MAX 150%) When the target is stunned, increases the effect from boost panels for all allies!
dialog.name: Grisella "Ambitious Alchemist" Bolt | Breaker

dialog.description:
- How to Fight -
Use battle items to stun powerful enemies with large stun gauges!
Collect burst panels to activate the Burst Skill and support your allies' attacks!
dialog.name: Grisella "Ambitious Alchemist" Bolt | Breaker

dialog.description:
- The ability "This Is What I'm Made Of!" increases skill damage by 5% each time HP is recovered, up to 120%!
Note: Trial battles are played with a max level, fully awakened party with
fully unlocked Growboards.
dialog.name: Roman "Romance Hearts" Air | Attacker

dialog.description:
- Skill 1 grants Regen to self, recovering HP at the start of every turn!
- Attacking with Skill 2 with 70% HP or more remaining increases damage by up to 50%!
dialog.name: Roman "Romance Hearts" Air | Attacker

dialog.description:
- Burst Skill applies an additional "This Is What I'm Made Of!" on self,
which can be combined with the ability to increase skill damage by up to 240%!
It also grants Regen on self for 5 turns!
dialog.name: Roman "Romance Hearts" Air | Attacker

dialog.description:
- How to Fight -
- Use Burst Skill early to increase skill damage even more each time Roman recovers HP!
- Maintain high HP and attack with Skill 2 for massive damage!
dialog.name: Roman "Romance Hearts" Air | Attacker
