event.name: Swimsuit Dummy Event
event.sort_name: Swimsuit Dummy Event

event_album.description:
Valeria, Ryza, Klaudia and I have decided to visit the sea in Haine to enjoy a vacation by the beach. However, due to the appearance of monsters on the shore, tourists are staying away, and the fireworks festival is in danger of being canceled. We've decided to work together and use alchemy to build a beach house to bring the tourists back!
First, we held a swimsuit fashion show. Ryza wore a cute swimsuit that suited her perfectly, while Valeria and Klaudia both wore more stylish swimsuits that matched their unique styles. I also showed off the swimsuit Izana picked out for me.
We decided to start by making a large beach umbrella! Now let's work at making the Beach House bigger and better! (Resna)

key_tasks.name: 「常夏の保養地」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Let's Build a Beach House!

event_album.description:
While playing on the beach with Valeria, we caught a fish with a face that looked almost human! After we caught it, we heard a voice say, "Let me see!"
We turned around and saw Resna and Klaudia resting under the beach umbrella.
They joined us at first, but Resna kept wanting to take breaks under the umbrella. She said she wished she could handle the sun better, but she shouldn't worry!
If you play in the sun every day, you get used to it in no time! That's coming from someone who grew up on an island, so you can trust me on this! (Ryza)

key_tasks.name: 「似合う場所」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Conquer the Sun!

event_album.description:
I made some sunscreen using alchemy, and Klaudia asked me to put some on her back!
At first I was nervous, but seeing her twitch every time my hand touched her back was quite funny, so I ended up tickling her a little. Turns out Klaudia is very ticklish!
I feel like we really bonded over it, but she said, "I'll return the favor tomorrow."
Oh no, she's going to get back at me! (Resna)

key_tasks.name: 「似合う場所」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Teasing Touch

event_album.description:
I spent some time relaxing on a deck chair with Klaudia.
Resna and Ryza kept looking over and saying things like, "You two look so mature," and, "It's like a scene from a painting."
I never realized that we looked anything like that. Our conversations certainly weren't mature at all...
I guess just sitting in that chair made us look more mature or something. If that's all it takes, I guess it's easier than I thought! (Valeria)

key_tasks.name: 「大人の魅力」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Magical Chair?

event_album.description:
Imitating Klaudia, Resna tried reading one of her books on a deck chair to appear more mature.
At first, she looked quite elegant as she read, but then the book gave her an idea for a new alchemy recipe, and she got so excited that she put down her book and ran out to gather materials.
I tried reading on a deck chair too, but I ended up falling asleep.
I guess the road to adulthood is still pretty long for us... (Ryza)

key_tasks.name: 「大人の魅力」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: The Road to Adulthood

event_album.description:
I helped make drinks to sell at the Beach House today. I'm clumsy, so I struggled a lot, but eventually I managed to make some drinks that were good enough to serve, and Resna praised me!
Resna's way of giving compliments is so kind and encouraging that I couldn't help but try my best.
Resna also said, "Valeria, you're probably older than me, but sometimes you have this childlike cuteness about you!"
If I had a mother, I wonder if she'd be like this... (Valeria)

key_tasks.name: Level the Beach House to Lv. 4

event_album.name: Childlike Charm

event_album.description:
While eating shaved ice, I got a brain freeze, which made Ryza make an offer I never expected. She said, "If it hurts, you should lie down. I'll lend you my lap." Borrowing Ryza's lap seemed unthinkable—so inappropriate, yet so gratifying—how was I supposed to react?!
While I was worrying about what to do, my brain freeze fixed itself, and I never got to experience Ryza's lap...
Valeria later teased, "If you're that hesitant, maybe I should borrow it instead."
No! That's no allowed! Only people with sore heads are allowed! (Resna)

key_tasks.name: 「冷たさ対暑さ」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: A Captivating Headrest

event_album.description:
During a break from serving customers, Ryza fed me some shaved ice. Although I tried not to show my fatigue in front of the customers, Ryza had definitely noticed.
She played it off by saying she just happened to have my favorite flavor, but I know she was worried.
Later, we were all talking about our favorite shaved ice flavors, and Valeria said, "I like the blue one! Puni flavor, I think?" We were all startled for a moment, wondering if she really knew what Puni taste like, or if she was just associating the color with them. Sorry, Valeria, we just never know with you... (Klaudia)

key_tasks.name: 「冷たさ対暑さ」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Sweet Relief

event_album.description:
Ryza made great use of her experience from the Star's Cocoon to handle customers expertly, even under the scorching sun. When I praised her as the best poster girl, she blushed a little.
Seeing this, Resna got really excited and said, "Ryza is always so confident and composed, so to see her blush is such a rare treat! She looks so cute when she's embarrassed!" I then suggested to Resna, "You should compliment her more. She has a lot of cute expressions, you know."
As I expected, Ryza retorted, "Klaudia, stop putting ideas into Resna's head!" I guess my mischievous side won this time! (Klaudia)

key_tasks.name: 「看板娘の形」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: The Best Poster Girl

event_album.description:
Resna brought a watermelon. When I asked where she got it, she said, "I made it!" I then asked her what it was made of, and none of the ingredients seemed edible, but somehow it turned out to be delicious anyway. How strange...
Valeria didn't seem to mind at all, and even said, "Resna, make another one. I want to practice spitting the seeds from one end of the beach to the other!"
At that point, aren't they more like bullets than seeds? (Ryza)

key_tasks.name: 「錬金術の奥深さ」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Homemade Watermelon

event_album.description:
Valeria wanted to try her hand at splitting a watermelon while blindfolded. Amazingly, she walked right up to the watermelon and hit it with perfect accuracy, almost as if she could see it!
She said she just followed the scent of the watermelon, but do watermelons really have such a strong smell?
Ryza got curious and suggested, "We should experiment to see how far she can smell it from." (Klaudia)

key_tasks.name: 「錬金術の奥深さ」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Guided by Scent

event_album.description:
I tried to attach a propulsion device to a swim tube, but it broke and I couldn't get it working again. Just as I was about to give up on exploring the deeper waters, Valeria offered to be my propulsion and pulled me far out to sea!
The view from the rocks was absolutely beautiful...
My propulsion system still needs some work, but in the meantime Valeria has said, "Ask me anytime! Next time we'll go to an island even farther away." I'm looking forward to going out swimming with her again. (Resna)

key_tasks.name: 「憧れの景色」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Perfect Propulsion

event_album.description:
Today, I gathered materials underwater! I swam and searched for underwater materials like this in my own world too, but using goggles makes it so much easier! Just look at how much I found!
Resna praised me, saying, "That's incredible, Ryza! I can't believe that you could swim with your eyes open underwater before."
But you know, I was once afraid of water too. When I was a child, I almost drowned with Lent and some friends, but thanks to everyone helping me learn, I was able to grow into the swimmer I am today. I'm sure Resna will learn quickly with some practice. (Ryza)

key_tasks.name: Level the Beach House to Lv. 9

event_album.name: Underwater Foraging

event_album.description:
While exploring the beach for materials, we came across a pack of monsters. Ryza had the amazing idea to scare them off by throwing beach balls at them!
Who knew beach balls could be used as weapons?
Ryza then suggested, "Let's also build a cannon to fire them out quickly." Klaudia was worried that they might burst, but reconsidered when she realized how sturdy they are. I mean, if they survived my full force throws, I'm sure they'll be fine in a cannon. (Valeria)

key_tasks.name: 「どんなときも」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: A New Weapon

event_album.description:
We were playing with a beach ball on the shore when Valeria, still fired up from battle, threw the ball so hard it made a hole in the beach. There was no way we could hit the ball, so we had to stop the game and have her practice gentler shots. For a while I thought we'd never be able to play again, but eventually she got used to throwing with a normal amount of force.
Valeria said, "I never thought it was dangerous; I just thought no one would dare hit it back, so I was guaranteed to score!" I can't help but feel that approach defeats the point of the game... (Klaudia)

key_tasks.name: 「どんなときも」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Reversed Logic

event_album.description:
With the food stand completed and more customers coming in, Resna began to help serve them. She was nervous until Ryza advised her, "Just think of the customers as your friends."
I was a bit startled when I overheard her muttering, "Everyone is Izana. Everyone is Izana..." That's probably not exactly what Ryza had in mind!
If everyone was Izana, that would mean we'd have an army of Izanas at the Beach House! Yikes, that's a scary thought! (Valeria)

key_tasks.name: 「溢れ出る情熱」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: First-Time Server

event_album.description:
I asked Valeria to run the Beach House for a while, but as I should have expected, she kept sampling the shaved ice syrup until it was all gone and got scolded by Klaudia.
I had a feeling this might happen, though I do feel for her a bit.
Valeria also got questioned about the decrease in drinks, to which she sheepishly admitted, "I-I just had a little." But judging by the amount that was missing, it was definitely more than a little. I'd say at least ten cups worth. (Ryza)

key_tasks.name: 「溢れ出る情熱」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Momentary Paradise

event_album.description:
Our friends came to visit the Beach House. At first, Izana and Heidi were very wary of the island fish. Even after I pointed out their cute faces, they were hesitant to agree with me.
But I kept telling them that these little guys were fine, and after some persistence on my part, they pet them a little bit. Their expressions were still a bit tense, but I'm glad they warmed up to the island fish! (Resna)

key_tasks.name: Clear "New Attraction"

event_album.name: Friends of Friends

event_album.description:
To add to the fun at the beach, I suggested a game that uses beach flags to Roman. He came up with a race where the first one to reach a flag placed deep in a cave would win a fabulous prize.
When we heard about this, we all decided to participate, too.
Valeria asked, "A fabulous prize prepared by Roman? Maybe it'll be a big fish, or a huge piece of meat, or..."
Roman never said that it would be anything to do with food, though... (Klaudia)

key_tasks.name: Clear "Not Just a Beach Flag Race"

event_album.name: Predicting the Fabulous Prize

event_album.description:
I made some surfboards to have more things to play with at the Beach House, so Valeria and I tried to surf. Thanks to her natural ability, Valeria was able to surf in no time at all, but I kept falling over.
Valeria suggested that we try to surf together on the same board. After a few tries, I managed to stay on the board in a crouched position all by myself!
This is a huge leap forward for me! So exciting! (Resna)

key_tasks.name: Level the Beach House to Lv. 12

event_album.name: A Small Leap Forward

event_album.description:
To attract more customers, we set up a beach volleyball net and decided to play some matches to strengthen our legs for the beach flag race. But Valeria was just too strong for us. Even in a 1-on-3 match, we didn't stand a chance against her. It was a bit frustrating, but in the end it was really good exercise.
Next time I'll bring someone who can compete with her. Valeria confidently said, "Bring whoever you want! I won't lose!" Hahaha, we'll see about that! (Ryza)

key_tasks.name: 「圧倒的エース」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: One-Man Team?

event_album.description:
We were all practicing for the beach flag race together.
After many tries, Resna was able to grab the flag at almost exactly the same time as Ryza.
Ryza boasted, "Nice try, but I was faster," but Resna insisted, "No, I was first! You know I respect you Ryza, but you have to give me this one!" Seeing Resna so determined was incredible. She's come so far! (Valeria)

key_tasks.name: Level the Beach House to Lv. 14

event_album.name: A Matter of Pride

event_album.description:
Lately, we've been making a lot of things to play with, so after some discussion we decided to make some decorations for the Beach House instead: wind chimes!
Upon feeling the cool breeze blow through them, Klaudia decided she had to change her outfit.
She said, "When I saw the wind chimes, I just got the sudden urge to wear this..."
It did match the scene really well.
Maybe next year we should all dress like that on the beach. (Ryza)

key_tasks.name: Level the Beach House to Lv. 15

event_album.name: Mysterious Urge

event_album.description:
We built a little hut at the Beach House, and it's getting quite busy again. Even so, there have been no problems at all. And why is that? Because of the watchful eye of a certain knight. With someone like that watching over us, no one dares to cause trouble.
Ryza, feeling competitive, said, "If I can sneak past the fearsome guardian of my hometown, I'm sure I can handle this..." Not that she actually intended to do anything, though.
But I do remember that island guardian. Now that I think about it, she was quite similar to Juna. (Klaudia)

key_tasks.name: 「適材適所？」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Echoes of the Past

event_album.description:
The beach flag race is finally here! Besides the four of us, Juna, Linca, Shallotte, Shallistera, Wilbell, Nio, and Regina will also be participating. It's going to be so exciting!
When Resna heard that Wilbell was going to use her broom, she declared, "We have to fight back with alchemy."
The rules say you can bring whatever you want to help, but how far can we go? I guess we can't just bring some kind of vehicle to ride in, right? Isn't a broom kind of like a vehicle anyway? But I think I'll just go with my own strength! It's more exciting that way! (Valeria)

key_tasks.name: Clear "Battle of the Strong"

event_album.name: Within the Rules

event_album.description:
The beach flag race has come to an end. Just like when she was practicing with me, Resna clung to the flag till the end, using both her own strength and alchemy.
She often says she's not very good at sports, but her determination really is unmatched. That's a valuable trait for an alchemist. She should be proud!
Everyone else did their best too, and I won't forget the smiles throughout the race any time soon. As Resna said, participating together was the real fabulous prize in the end.
By the way, I'm still wondering what Roman and Juna were discussing so seriously... (Ryza)

key_tasks.name: Clear "Another Fabulous Prize"

event_album.name: An Alchemist's Pride

event_album.description:
To help people like me who struggle with direct sunlight enjoy the beach more, we decided to rent out various sun-blocking items. To promote the items, the four of us wore matching straw hats, but maybe we got a little too carried away...
Ryza said, "Why not? Next time, let's all wear matching sunglasses."
It sounds fun, but we might look a bit like a suspicious group if we all wear the same sunglasses... (Resna)

key_tasks.name: Level the Beach House to Lv. 17

event_album.name: Matching Hats

event_album.description:
As I sat by the fire with Ryza, I remembered some of our adventures in our original world.
"Say, Ryza. During our travels, you kept me company by the fire until I fell asleep, right? You must have been tired yourself, but thanks to you, I was able to sleep soundly even outside. Thank you."
While we were talking, I noticed someone watching us. It was Resna from a distance, whispering, "Ah, what a precious moment..." I invited her to join us, but she just watched, not moving an inch. It would have been nice if she had just joined in... (Klaudia)

key_tasks.name: Level the Beach House to Lv. 18

event_album.name: I'd Rather Watch from Here

event_album.description:
While we were setting up the fireworks, Marlone came by and got a little too excited, saying, "Fireworks? You mean bombs? Let me help!" She tried to load her homemade bombs into the launchers, so Resna and I quickly stopped her.
I appreciate the enthusiasm, but that alone is enough! We can't risk the fireworks festival getting canceled because of this!
That said, if there were ever a battle with a big monster, those bombs would definitely come in handy. (Ryza)

key_tasks.name: Level the Beach House to Lv. 19

event_album.name: The Bomber's Nature

event_album.description:
Heidi came to pick me up, so I washed off at the showers before heading back to the inn. I said, "It's great to have this, you can get freshen up anytime! Rain is just as good though," and Heidi replied, "Not everyone is wild enough to jump in the rain like you."
I answered, "True. I guess you can't always get rain when you need it," and she replied, "That's not the point!" Later, when I told Resna about this, she agreed with Heidi.
I still think it's pretty relevant, though... (Valeria)

key_tasks.name: Level the Beach House to Lv. 20

event_album.name: Refreshing Shower

event_album.description:
The Beach House is finally complete! Klaudia provided food and drink to celebrate everyone's hard work.
She said, "Thank you all for your help," but we should be thanking her too! This was so much fun!
Valeria, stuffing her mouth, replied, "All I really did was eat."
Her appetite actually helped attract customers though, so I think she can hold her head up high.
I hope the beach continues to flourish and that the fireworks festival will go ahead without any trouble! (Resna)

key_tasks.name: Level the Beach House to Lv. 20

event_album.name: Wishing for Continued Success

event_album.description:
Roman asked me to make fireworks with alchemy. I quickly started discussing it with Resna and was about to look for some paper to draw diagrams on when I realized I could just draw in the sand. We ended up drawing diagrams with our fingers in the sand while we talked.
Isn't it exciting to think of the whole beach as one giant chalkboard?
Too bad we can't keep the notes there forever, but it's more than enough for a brief discussion. (Ryza)

key_tasks.name: Clear "A New Problem"

event_album.name: Boundless Fun

event_album.description:
While we were gathering materials for the fireworks, we decided to take on a test of courage in a nearby cave. It was really creepy inside, as if something was going to jump out at any moment. On top of that, Ryza started telling ghost stories! But thanks to Valeria saying, "Don't worry, if a ghost shows up, I'll just punch it away," I was able to keep going without getting too scared.
Later, Ryza said, "Your scared face was just too cute to resist," but I still think she went a bit too far this time! I guess that mischievous side of her is part of her charm, though... (Resna)

key_tasks.name: Clear "A Nerve-Racking Test of Courage"

event_album.name: Adventurous Spirit, Mischievous Spirit

event_album.description:
After gathering some materials for the fireworks, I met back up with Resna and Ryza, only to find them shivering as if they were freezing to death.
I asked them why, since it was so hot, and they explained, "We were so hot and sweaty in this heat, so we applied some ointment that cools you down and made a tool that blows wind, and ended up super cold instead!" It seems they went a bit overboard.
An ointment that can cool you down... I bet it would be really popular if we sold it, although we would have to warn everyone about how to use it properly.
But honestly, only Ryza and Resna would go so far as to make a wind-generating tool to use with it... (Klaudia)

key_tasks.name: Clear "How an Alchemist Cools Down"

event_album.name: Don't Overdo It!

event_album.description:
We heard that a certain bug might be useful as a material for the fireworks, so we decided to try to lure it out by spreading some honey on a tree. But after a while, it wasn't the bug that showed up—it was Valeria! She was so hungry that the sweet smell attracted her instead. We ended up giving her some watermelon in place of the honey, but even after that, she kept asking, "Hey, can't I eat that honey too? I bet it'd be delicious on shaved ice." That's so like Valeria.
Klaudia even empathized a bit, saying, "Eating things you're not supposed to eat always seems more tempting, like licking the cake batter before you bake a cake." (Resna)

key_tasks.name: Clear "Lured by a Sweet Scent"

event_album.name: Forbidden Delights

event_album.description:
After finishing our fireworks prototypes, we decided to do some stargazing because the stars were so beautiful. Resna excitedly explained all about the stars of this world, and Valeria listened with keen interest. As I watched them with a smile on my face, I noticed that Ryza had fallen asleep next to me while still sitting up. Later, she apologized to Resna, saying, "Sorry, I was interested, but..."
We had been playing all day and working hard on the fireworks, so it's no wonder she was tired. Don't worry, Ryza, we understand. (Klaudia)

key_tasks.name: Clear "Dreaming in the Night Breeze"

event_album.name: Watched Over by Moonlight

event_album.description:
On the day of the fireworks festival, while we were doing a test launch, the noise woke up a Swimsuit Golem that had been sleeping in the nearby ruins. It started wreaking havoc on the beach, so we had to chase it away.
Golems are curious creatures, and they have a habit of picking up things they find lying around and wearing them, which is why it was wearing a swimsuit.
Still, who in the world could have left behind such a huge swimsuit? Resna mused, "Maybe the swimsuit is a relic of an ancient civilization that's long gone now?" I wonder if swimsuits have always been that shape, even in ancient times... (Valeria)

key_tasks.name: Clear "The Giant Alarm Clock"

event_album.name: Unchanging Trends?

event_album.description:
The fireworks festival has finally begun! As I watched from the beach with Resna, we could hear the voices of guests who enjoyed the show, saying things like, "So beautiful," and, "I'll never forget this." It made me so happy. All of our hard work paid off!
It seems that Klaudia and the others feel the same, as Klaudia said, "I can't help but feel a little proud."
We all worked really hard to liven up the Beach House and pull off this fireworks festival, so I think we can all be as proud as we like! (Ryza)

key_tasks.name: Clear "Fireworks and Smiles"

event_album.name: A Reward for Everyone

event_album.description:
It was getting late, and it looks like the two of them fell asleep, exhausted from all the fun. We built the Beach House, enjoyed the beach flag race, set off some beautiful fireworks... It has been quite the adventure.
As Klaudia watched over the two of them sleeping, she whispered, "Even after I'm back in Haine and working, I'm sure I'll never forget this." I'm sure I'll be the same.
I imagine the two of them are also reliving the fun we had in their dreams.
I hope we can all come back here again next year!
As Resna said, you can never have too many good memories! (Valeria)

key_tasks.name: Clear all Event Stories

event_album.name: Even in Their Dreams

event_album.description:
Today, as always, the stars shine beautifully, watching over us from the distant heavens. But today was different. A single small star fell to an island on the outskirts of the sacred lands. Everyone said it was "a blessing from the heavens" and celebrated. Soon after, an investigation team headed to the uninhabited island where the falling star landed. I wish I could go too. I wonder what a falling star looks like. Is it like mana? What could I make with it using alchemy? Since learning alchemy, my view of the world seems to have changed.
I can't wait to hear the investigation team's findings! (Alvina)
event_album.name: Blessing from the Heavens

event_album.description:
□About This World's Alchemy
Location: Atelier   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Viktor

Yumia and I observed this world's alchemy. Materials are placed in a jar that emits light, and when stirred with a rod, the synthesis completes along with the light. It seems this world's alchemy is completely different from the alchemy we know, and Yumia found it fresh and interesting. I never thought that I, who am not an alchemist, would end up helping with synthesis... but with everyone's cooperation, we completed the Blaureschen, a tool for investigating the blue zone. After establishing our base, let's head out to investigate.

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "Different Kinds of Alchemy"

event_album.name: This World's Alchemy

event_album.description:
□We established a temporary base
Location: Uninhabited Island Shore   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Alvina

After arriving at the island for investigation, we set up a temporary base to conduct our investigation safely. Yumia and Viktor seem used to this kind of thing - they really feel like professional investigators! I wanted to have a base completion party with everyone inside, but... it was a bit too cramped. Still, it was fun just huddling inside with Bepp and Yumia. We invited Janne too, but he said he'd pass because it would be embarrassing. Too bad!

key_tasks.name: ストーリー「それぞれの錬金術」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Temporary Base Complete!

event_album.description:
□We held a strategy meeting
Location: In front of the base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Yumia

After setting up our temporary base, we also made a desk. Having a desk is very convenient both for sharing information and having light meals. We quickly gathered around the desk for a strategy meeting about investigating the blue zone.
During our discussion, Janne brought us some drinks from somewhere. It was quite cramped with everyone gathered around the desk drinking together, with all our faces so close, illuminated by Flammy's light. It felt a bit funny somehow.

key_tasks.name: ストーリー「調査の基本」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Let's Have a Strategy Meeting

event_album.description:
□Lost in an Unknown Forest
Location: Probably a forest   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Aira

I suddenly got separated from everyone, and while I don't really know what's going on, I'll leave a record just in case.
My head hurts from the high mana concentration, there's weird blue fog everywhere, and I'm really anxious being in this unknown place, but I'm sure we'll regroup soon. Rutger even said "We'll meet up eventually."
They all worry about each other in their own way. Even about me - he said he'd "leave me behind if I fell," but when I actually stumbled, he seemed concerned. ...I guess I should be grateful.

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "Searching Together"

event_album.name: In the Forest

event_album.description:
□Building a House-Like Base
Location: In front of the uninhabited island base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Viktor

To make our temporary base more comfortable and improve investigation efficiency, we all worked together to start building a house-like base. The logs used in construction were heavy, so I was planning to handle the transportation... but surprisingly, Janne lifted them with ease. When I expressed my surprise, Alvina and Bepp explained that Janne is Nova's strongest Holy Warrior.
Just like her, the Holy Warriors must train daily and build their strength to protect the people. I should learn from their example.

key_tasks.name: ストーリー「二人で探しに」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: The Holy Warriors of Nova

event_album.description:
□I gave Reina some food
Location: Somewhere   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Nina

When I realized I was lost with Reina, I tried to find my way to the investigation team's base, but... it seems we wandered into a different investigation team's base instead. Before I knew it, I ended up having to help out there.
I used the small reward I got to buy some food for Reina. When I got praised and received fruit earlier, I thought... I wonder if Reina's wariness is okay? She just eats things given to her by others right away. I worry about her because she's so cute.

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "The Leader's Situation"

event_album.name: Reina's Wariness

event_album.description:
□Base Complete!
Location: Our base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Alvina

Finally! Our base is super complete~! As expected of Albi-chan! With this size, there's plenty of room for everyone, so we'll be fine whether it's sudden rain, guns, or sea urchins!
I thought about keeping a Puni as a gatekeeper to guard the base while we're away on watch duty, but I was told no. When I asked why, they said it would be too pitiful to make one Puni do guard duty alone, and we don't have the resources to keep more than two. Janne is so kind in these situations...

key_tasks.name: ストーリー「団長の様子」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: We Need a Base Guard!

event_album.description:
□We investigated this world's aquatic life
Location: River   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Yumia

To gather food supplies, we took a break from investigating to go fishing with everyone. But for Viktor and me, even fishing was part of our investigation. There were so many discoveries - it was really fun!
Bepp told Viktor he wanted to catch lots of delicious fish for Alvina to eat, and apprenticed himself to Viktor, who's good at fishing. Once they both got focused, they created a mountain of fish in no time... Viktor seemed happy to have found a friend to fish with.

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "Food Gathering"

event_album.name: Mountain of Fish

event_album.description:
□Thank you so much Zornfluch!
Location: Near the base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Alvina

Just because Albi-chan is cute doesn't mean we can allow just anything! If Yumia and the others hadn't been there, I...
Right after being helped, I was just focused on staying alive and didn't really feel it, but after calming down and seeing Bepp and Janne's relieved faces, I felt like crying. Bepp tried to help me first, and Janne still worries about me now just like he did back then. I was so happy! Of course, I'm really really thankful to Yumia and Viktor too!

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "A Close Call"

event_album.name: Warm Relief

event_album.description:
□To reunite with our companions
Location: Near the base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Viktor

The wall we must overcome has become clear.
For Alvina and the others to investigate the blue zone, and for us to reunite with our companions... we must defeat that monster, Zornfluch.
I've heard it's difficult to defeat, but that doesn't mean there's no way. Right now, gathering information is crucial. And with this world's alchemy that created the Blau Rechen, we might be able to find a solution.
We will definitely reunite with everyone. Please wait for us.

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "Source of the Zone"

event_album.name: Praying for Everyone's Safety

event_album.description:
□We ate the fish we caught
Location: Base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Yumia

Back at the base, we all ate the fish we caught after grilling them. Viktor and I talked about how the fish don't seem much different from the ones we eat in Aladiss. Bepp gave the biggest fish to Alvina. You could really feel the love there.
Bepp tried to feed some to Flammy too. While the sentiment was nice, Flammy doesn't need to eat. When I told Janne, who cooked the fish, that it was "delicious," he told me his specialty is actually desserts. I'd like to try those sometime.

key_tasks.name: ストーリー「領域の発生源」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Fish Party

event_album.description: ED Investigation Record 1  *Text update needed

key_tasks.name: Complete a base containing at least 3 "Beautiful" and 2 "Cute"

event_album.name: ED Investigation Record 1  *Text update needed

event_album.description: ED Investigation Record 2  *Text update needed

key_tasks.name: Complete a base containing at least 3 "Practical" and 2 "Beautiful"

event_album.name: ED Investigation Record 2  *Text update needed

event_album.description: ED Investigation Record 3  *Text update needed

key_tasks.name: Complete a base containing at least 3 "Cute" and 2 "Practical"

event_album.name: ED Investigation Record 3  *Text update needed

event_album.description: ED Investigation Record 4  *Text update needed

key_tasks.name: Collect all 3 special investigation records

event_album.name: ED Investigation Record 4  *Text update needed

event_album.description:
□We talked about alchemists from different worlds
Location: Atelier   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Yumia

I met Plachta again, and also met Valeria and Totori. Valeria is an alchemist of this world, and Totori seems to be an alchemist from yet another world, different from Plachta's. Though they're from different worlds, the three of them practice similar alchemy, and they were very interested in how my alchemy works differently from theirs, asking me lots of questions. So I asked them many questions too. There are many forms of alchemy, and I learned a lot. I'd love to meet the owner of this atelier too, to learn about how things work around here.

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "Reliable Helpers"

event_album.name: Different Worlds

event_album.description:
□I talked with Bepp
Location: Base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Lenja

Today, I talked with Bepp. Bepp really cares about her sister Alvina, and works hard every day with training and duties to protect her. Bepp has lots of muscles and is much stronger than Lenja. Also, Bepp gave Lenja some fish. Lenja was very happy because Lenja loves fish. Lenja wants to become a proper warrior like Bepp, who is kind and cool.

key_tasks.name: ストーリー「心強い助っ人たち」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Bepp is So Nice!

event_album.description:
□We installed lighting
Location: Deserted Island Base Front   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Viktor

At Nina's suggestion, we installed lighting at the base. This has increased what we can do after dark. A welcome improvement.
By the way, I've always wondered - can Rutger actually see with those tinted glasses? It's already hard enough to see at night, and covering your field of vision with colored lenses seems counterproductive. But perhaps it would be tactless of me to point this out. He must have his own reasons. I'd like to hear about his particular aesthetic choices someday.

key_tasks.name: ストーリー「ルトガーの様子」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Rutger's Values

event_album.description:
□I met some alchemists
Location: Atelier   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Nina

It seems we've wandered into a place where even common sense is different. Not only is their approach to alchemy different, but their understanding of magic seems different too. Resna and the others we just met don't seem dangerous... but it might be too early to let our guard down. Let's observe a bit longer.
Lenja seems curious about this place and the people here. Since Lenja is honest and cute, I need to stay by her side to make sure she doesn't accidentally say something she shouldn't.

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "This World's Atelier"

event_album.name: A World of Different Common Sense

event_album.description:
□
Location:      Weather:      Recorded by: Rutger

Ate something sweet. I'll eat anything, but Isla really enjoyed it and ate a lot. Says it's good for her head's rotation. Can't say I see much difference though.

key_tasks.name: ストーリー「「宝石」」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Brain Food

event_album.description:
□We gathered Minze flowers
Location: Flower field   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Alvina

We went to gather Minze flowers to synthesize some scent pouches to ward off Zornfluch!
I'd never properly smelled Minze flowers before, so I was wondering what they'd be like~ They weren't exactly unpleasant, but they weren't exactly nice either. Yumia said the same thing. It's a kind of mature, subtle scent. If this scent repels them, maybe Zornfluch have childish noses~? Just you wait, Zornfluch!

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "A New Weapon"

event_album.name: Mature Fragrance

event_album.description:
□
Location:      Weather:      Recorded by: Rutger

Just because they're Yumia's acquaintances, Isla's trusting Valeria and the others too much when we've only just met them. They're just as bad, readily believing what we say. Don't they have any sense of caution? Even if there are others in similar situations, there should be limits.

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "The Ties That Bandanas Bind"

event_album.name: Worried Gaze

event_album.description:
□We set up storage
Location: Base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Yumia

We prepared some storage furniture for the base. We agreed everyone would use it together without any particular divisions, but I noticed it's become full of sewing supplies. That must be Isla. Thank you for always fixing our torn clothes.
Also, deep in the storage, hidden away, I found some of Rutger's jewels... Seems he keeps the ones he particularly likes instead of selling them. You don't need to hide them away like some secret stash, you know.

key_tasks.name: ストーリー「バンダナが結んだ縁」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Secret Stash...?

event_album.description:
□We found a strange jewel
Location: Investigation Team HQ   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Lenja

Lenja went to this world's Investigation Team headquarters with Nina and Resna. Everyone here doesn't seem to know much about the bracelets or the jewels that go in them. Nina thinks it's strange too. Even though we don't know what kind of jewel it is, Nina just casually touches it with her hands, which made Lenja's heart pound with worry... And then she even tried to take a piece of the jewel home with her... Is Nina's heart made of steel? Nina is amazing...

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "Bold Investigation"

event_album.name: Heart of Steel

event_album.description:
□Valeria
Location: Seems to be a deserted island   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Isla

Finally met some people! And they even knew about Yumia and the others - what luck! So we went with Valeria and the others to where Rutger's voice was coming from... but Rutger suddenly started attacking like he was being controlled. But thanks to Valeria beating him up, we were okay! While I was surprised by Valeria's strength, anything can happen during an investigation, and you need to be prepared to fight even your companions if necessary! If it comes down to it, I'll... !

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "The Echoing Voice"

event_album.name: Sometimes Necessary Resolve

event_album.description:
□Sleeping Arrangements
Location: Base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Nina

Thanks to Rutger's selfishness, a comfortable bed has been prepared. However, due to limited space at the base, there's only one. While we investigators are used to sleeping outdoors and don't mind sleeping on the floor, I do worry about how Alvina and the others are managing.

P.S.: When I saw Alvina lying on the floor, she looked so uncomfortable that I couldn't help but find it a little amusing.

key_tasks.name: ストーリー「声の原因」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Sleeping Comfort

event_album.description:
□Safe and Sound Reunion
Location: Atelier   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Viktor

Finally, we've all been reunited. As if by some miracle, we're all here together in this unfamiliar world, without any serious injuries and with no one missing. This is all thanks to the alchemists of this world. I won't forget this debt of gratitude.
And by what coincidence, it seems we're all somehow involved in incidents related to the falling star. If that's the case, we have only one path forward: to investigate and work toward a solution as a proper investigation team, even in this different world.

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "Aladiss Investigation Team, Reunion"

event_album.name: Gathered Miracle

event_album.description:
□Forest Investigation
Location: Forest   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Isla

Big Brother and I went investigating where we first were, thinking we might find some clues... but ugh, THE WORST! My feet got stuck in some mud and my shoes got all dirty. Big Brother just said "Deal with it" - how cold! I wonder if I could ask Yumia or Alvina to make me some kind of alchemical soap that could instantly remove stains anytime, anywhere? ...Probably too much to ask~ By the way, we didn't find anything in the forest.

key_tasks.name: ストーリー「情報を整理しよう」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: A Maiden's Wish

event_album.description:
□
Location:      Weather:      Recorded by: Rutger

Lenja's really enjoying that hammock. She asked if we could ride it together, but that'd obviously be too dangerous for two people.

key_tasks.name: ストーリー「調査団本部に突撃！」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Swaying

event_album.description:
□Strange Stone Investigation
Location: Nova   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Viktor

To prevent the distribution of bracelets made with strange stones throughout the country, we split up to handle both the collection of the stones and the search for this world's investigation team leader, who's likely at the command tower.
Yumia's ability to jump and survey the surroundings from high places is truly remarkable. While she credits it to "her boots," using those boots effectively must require excellent physical coordination, balance, muscle strength, and experience. I believe Yumia's strength goes well beyond just alchemy.

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "People Gathering at the Temple"

event_album.name: Yumia's Skill

event_album.description:
□This World's Fruit
Location: Forest   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Lenja

Nina rubbed a strongly scented fruit on the team leader, so we all followed Lenja to track her scent and find her.
I thought this fruit was something commonly eaten here since we got it from this world's investigation team before, but Alvina told me that "not many people eat this." Apparently, it's even banned in some areas because of its strong smell. But since it tastes good, I wish there was a way to get rid of the smell.

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "Chasing the Leader"

event_album.name: Strong Scent

event_album.description:
□Shooting Practice
Location: Base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Nina

I set up shooting targets in front of the base. Since we had the chance, Yumia and I taught Alvina how to use a gun.
She seems interested in guns and apparently had borrowed Yumia's before for some target practice. According to Yumia, "Alvina has good form." I thought the same thing watching her today. Once Alvina gets a bit better at shooting, it might be fun to have some shooting competitions.

key_tasks.name: ストーリー「止めないと！」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Hidden Talent?

event_album.description:
□I Ate Fish Pie
Location: Base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Lenja

Janne baked a delicious pie because he said we can't be satisfied if we're hungry! And since Lenja likes fish, he made it a fish pie. The fish was caught by Bepp, I heard. It was a big, fatty fish that was really delicious. Janne and Bepp are such kind people to be so nice to someone like Lenja. Lenja wants to do something to repay them somehow with what Lenja can do.

key_tasks.name: ストーリー「操るモノ」をクリアしよう

event_album.name: Favorite Things

event_album.description:
□
Location:      Weather:      Recorded by: Rutger

So I got beaten up by that brute strength, all for keeping up morale? She said "You can handle this much, right?" but what's her basis for saying that? Really gets on my nerves... but I guess I can't complain this time.

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "Strategy Meeting Together"

event_album.name: Brute Strength

event_album.description:
□Encirclement Operation!
Location: Forest   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Isla

We all scattered bags with scents that Zornfluch hates throughout the forest! We spread them around the perimeter to drive Zornfluch toward the center of the forest! The operation went great with everyone's cooperation!
I worked together with Yumia, and our coordination was perfect! I've started to understand instinctively how Yumia wants to move. That must be because we've been working together all this time!
...Really, I'm so glad we could meet again.

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "Operation Start!"

event_album.name: Perfect Coordination!

event_album.description:
□We Cornered Zornfluch
Location: Ruins   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Lenja

When we cornered Zornfluch in the ruins in the forest, it used the people of Nova as shields. Everyone was being controlled by Zornfluch's stone power... this is horrible! Unforgivable!
Lenja might not have been able to do anything alone because Lenja is no good. But now Lenja has Yumia and everyone else! Lenja will help everyone with everything Lenja can do!

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "To Save the Hostages"

event_album.name: Unforgivable!

event_album.description:
□Got Zornfluch, We Really Did!
Location: Ruins   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Alvina

When the blue mist cleared with Yumia's dance, I thought "Now's the time! This is it!" It was the result of shooting practice with Yumia and Nina. In that moment, all my senses were focused, and I strongly felt I absolutely wouldn't miss. I was totally the hero of that scene, right!? I'm so glad I didn't miss! Well, Yumia and Nina say I have good form! But since it's really tiring to concentrate that hard, I think I'll stick to using guns only occasionally.

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "Blue Finale"

event_album.name: Hero's Shot

event_album.description:
□After That
Location: Cafe   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Yumia

After defeating Zornfluch, we decided to dispose of all the recovered stones and bracelets.
Alvina said something that stuck with me: "A world without words would be so bland." I thought that was a very Alvina-like way of thinking. It's through words that we understand each other, through communication that things get across. Even if we're from different worlds, we can become friends by learning about each other through words. That's really something wonderful, isn't it?

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "Alvina's Decision"

event_album.name: A World with Words

event_album.description:
□Investigation Complete!
Location: Base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Alvina

With this, the deserted island investigation is complete! I think we achieved some wonderful results! As both a Star Guide and an alchemist, I believe I successfully fulfilled my role in guiding Nova to safety! All of this was thanks to Bepp, Janne, Yumia, and everyone else.
While my investigation records end here for now, it seems Yumia and the others will continue investigating this world, so maybe I'll write more entries someday? Until then, farewell!

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "Let's Keep Working Together!"

event_album.name: Thanks for the Hard Work!

memoria.description:
Her name is Marlone. She is careless and quick to complain, not to mention an academic disaster. This has earned her a reputation as a scholastic failure.
However, there is talent hidden deep within. Perhaps enough to see her someday become a legendary alchemist.
If she ever feels like it, that is.
memoria.name: Marlone the Alchemist

memoria.description:
"Hmm. Hey, Eisel, which of these medicines should I use?"
"What? You seriously don't know, Elfir? For this recipe you've got to use―"
She may complain, but she is always kind as she explains. And that's how she wound up so spoiled.
memoria.name: You're Hopeless Without Me

memoria.description:
As though out of the blue, the two students suddenly decide to compete to see which of them can draw the best portrait of their beloved teacher, Lilie.
"I don't plan on losing, Hermina!"
"That's my line, Ingrid!"
"I'm the best artist here!"
How will this battle of raw talent play out in the world of art?!
memoria.name: A Contest for Teacher!

memoria.description:
"Whoa whoa whoa!"
A girl flies through some ruins, straddling her broom.
The roars of monsters follow close behind.
"Where was that exit?!"
Run, Judith!
You've got to get home safely with those materials!
memoria.name: Run, Judith!

memoria.description:
Karotte Village. A desolate place with very little aside from endless carrot fields. One girl seeks to save her village from decline.
"Mmm, just look at that gloss! Get a whiff of that fragrance! Karotte really does have the best carrots around!"
She will no doubt need to focus her energies if she's to save her poor hometown.
memoria.name: The Land of Carrots

memoria.description:
Norn awakens in a comfortable patch of sunlight.
"Yaaaawn, that was a great nap, meow!"
"Meow? Oh, you were taking a nap here too, meow?"
"Don't go using people's legs as a pillow without permission, meow!"
"Meow well, I guess I can't blame you on a sunny day like this."
memoria.name: The Meowst Sunny Spot

memoria.description:
"Ahaha! Hurry up!"
A small figure runs down steps still damp with rain. Her innocent footfalls make droplets of water splash and dance.
"Iris! Slow down, it's dangerous!"
Viese follows behind. Despite her concern, a smile adorns her face. A rainbow hangs overhead, as though watching over them.
memoria.name: Innocent Sound of Water

memoria.description:
"*Cough* *Cough* Vayne, Nikki... Sorry you had to stop for me."
"Come on, Jess, you need your rest."
"That's right! We'll whip you up some great medicine that'll have you right as rain!"
This much is hardly a bother when it's for the sake of a dear friend.
memoria.name: Classmates

memoria.description:
"Ah, Puni are so soft."
For Lily, nuzzling Puni is the best way to heal her heart and soul.
"Here, Lily, you can have these too!"
"Ahhh! Quit it, Et! Oh, actually..."
Even Et's pranks add some joyful spice to things.
memoria.name: Puni for You!

memoria.description:
"What are these ears for, Teacher?"
"Heehee, they look great on you, Rorona."
"They're embarrassing! I can't greet guests with these on!"
She complains, but Rorona admirably gets back to work. Even in this world, she can't seem to go against Astrid.
"Heh... Truly a beautiful sight."
memoria.name: Teacher's Cure for Boredom

memoria.description: Eva works at the orphanage, where she serves as a reliable older sister to some and a nurturing mother figure to others. Lulua is the only person with whom Eva feels comfortable revealing her more vulnerable side. Regardless of what lies ahead, both of them firmly believe that their bond is unbreakable, no matter what challenges they may face in the future.
memoria.name: A Real Family

memoria.description:
A teacher passes knowledge on to a student. Such knowledge is power, enough to bring change to the kingdom.
Though perhaps not quite enough to change its fate.
However, the people of this kingdom will continue to live their lives with alchemy all around them.
memoria.name: The Scion of Arland

memoria.description:
Ayesha, Wilbell, and Regina take a little break from their travels.
They rest their legs, as stiff as staves, in the cooling river and let it wash away the fatigue.
A little splashing around is fine, as long as they remember to hydrate as well.
memoria.name: An Inviting Stream

memoria.description:
On a break from her busy work schedule, the sweetness of the apple pie seems to help melt the tension in her mind and body away.
She polishes off her plate. But it's somehow not enough. She reaches for a second.
"It's a reward for working so hard," she tells herself. And yet...
memoria.name: Time for Sweets

memoria.description:
Shallistera and Shallotte. Their upbringings, personalities, and lives could not be any more different.
Though they've had their share of disagreements, they've overcome many trials and have become an unstoppable team.
"With you by my side, I can handle anything."
memoria.name: The Two Shallies

memoria.description:
"Here's today's deal. This was crafted by a master craftsman. Just take a look at this!"
"Wow! Corneria, you're really good at balancing that!"
"The first rule of sales is to draw the customer's eye."
"I see! Thanks for the advice!"
memoria.name: Deal of the Day

memoria.description:
Three figures gather in the archives to search for a certain document.
They have passed their difficult exams and their proficiency has earned them official recognition as alchemists.
Though each has their own temperament, there is no problem the three of them cannot solve when they come together...probably.
memoria.name: The Power of Three

memoria.description:
Suelle is transfixed as she enjoys a delicious cake during tea time.
Something about seeing this normally mischievous girl acting so cute and docile brings a smile to the faces of Sophie and Mathias.
memoria.name: Delicious Tea Time

memoria.description:
The gentle melody of a flute echoes across the expansive grasslands. Klaudia has snuck away from her father and her friends to have some alone time. She thinks, "One day I'll share my hobby with everyone..."
But she feels relieved knowing that today is not that day.
memoria.name: A Melody on the Wind

memoria.description:
Ryza follows Patricia's directions to a popular crepe stand in the capital. An astonished gasp escapes her as she takes her first bite of the capital's cuisine.
This is only the first of many new discoveries that await her in her new home.
memoria.name: The Taste of Civilization

memoria.description:
Many people come to visit this atelier.
Some are old friends, some are travelers, scholars, or even knights.
All this despite the fact that she's merely borrowed this atelier to study for her exams.
However, at this moment, this place is more important to her than anything.
memoria.name: My Atelier

memoria.description:
The heavenly city of Avenberry. Some say this city built on a mountain's peak is home to a great treasure.
A young alchemist named Klein travels in search of the city accompanied by Lita, a girl he met during his travels.
But what fate awaits them at their destination?
memoria.name: Searching for the Heavenly City

memoria.description:
A thought for the friends I made at school.
Though we may sometimes bicker or find ourselves at odds, you will always be my dear and reliable comrades.
Together, we can face any trials that await us.
That's how I've always felt, anyway.
memoria.name: School Friends

memoria.description:
Atelier Rorona lies tucked away in a corner of the Artisan's Way in Arland. Despite her inexperience, Rorona has tried her best to keep the atelier going ever since her teacher entrusted it to her.
Everything she does is to protect the place most precious to her heart.
memoria.name: The Place I Want to Protect

memoria.description:
Her mother set out on a journey and has yet to return.
Where could she be? The question gradually occupies more of Totori's attention until, one day, she sets off from her home to pursue in her mother's footsteps.
Even when the trail goes cold, she presses on, believing her mother is waiting for her somewhere beyond the sea...
memoria.name: Following in Your Footsteps

memoria.description:
The country is so small, one might be able to look over its entirety simply by climbing a tree.
Meruru has made up her mind. She will use the power of alchemy she learned from her teacher to expand her country.
As a princess, as an alchemist, she stands, ready to change her world.
memoria.name: The Power to Change the World

memoria.description:
An alchemist searches for materials in a field of flowers on the edge of town.
She hears her beloved mother's gentle voice calling her from far away. But, for now, she pays it no mind.
In order to step out of that person's shadow, she has to work harder.
memoria.name: What I'm Striving For

memoria.description:
A world quietly awaiting its end. This once-great civilization has fallen into decay, leaving only ruins engulfed in vegetation.
Such is the nature of the world Ayesha traverses alone.
She wanders through the lands of Dusk in search of her beloved sister.
memoria.name: Walking the Lands of Dusk

memoria.description:
Balloons fly back and forth, carrying materials through the frontier town.
Two alchemists, Escha and Logy, have agreed to help the town's development efforts.
Hand-in-hand they chase their dreams into the Dusk skies.
memoria.name: Looking up At the Dusk Skies

memoria.description:
The Dusk Sea—a sandy expanse that stretches out to the horizon. Its sands threaten to slowly swallow the last remaining oasis.
Two girls, Shallistera and Shallotte, live their lives in such a place, each with her own hopes and desires.
When these two "Shallies" meet, the Dusk Sea's wheel of fate begins to turn.
memoria.name: Embraced by the Dusk Sea

memoria.description:
Sophie suddenly peeks out from behind a tree. A smile spreads across her face as her friend looks up at her.
This tale began when Sophie met a book that had lost its memories.
What started as a fateful encounter became the new normal, as fate wove their stories together.
memoria.name: The Tales We Weave

memoria.description:
Since she was a young child, she has dreamed of the wide outside world. Led by a mysterious power, Firis finally sets foot out there. The expansive skies, the dancing winds, and the endless lands all seem to envelop her.
Everything she lays her eyes on is brand new and makes her heart pound with excitement as she takes the first steps of her journey.
memoria.name: The Infinite Horizon

memoria.description:
To become the number one atelier in the country.
That is the dream of these twin alchemists.
Lydie, the quiet and laid-back older sister.
Suelle, the upbeat and tomboyish little sister.
Though the two of them don't always see eye to eye, the goal they've set their eyes on is the same.
memoria.name: The Twins' Dream

memoria.description:
Ryza and her friends set off on a secret adventure to escape their boring lives.
The fluffy summer clouds hang over them, as though watching over their travels.
Their journey may very well reveal to them what is most important of all.
memoria.name: A Summer Adventure

memoria.description:
It's been three years since her summer of adventure. Ryza has traveled from her little island and settled in the royal capital.
New sights and encounters await her, as well as reunions with old friends. A premonition of her next adventure fills her heart with excitement.
memoria.name: An Adventurous Premonition

memoria.description:
It's been a few years since she began learning alchemy at this atelier.
Somewhere along the way, she's become used to the scenery here.
"It's so pretty. It's like I'm floating in a dream."
"Hey, Resna! Let's go check out what's over there!"
"Okay, let's go!"
The everyday sights around her haven't yet lost their vivid color.
memoria.name: The Changing Scenery

memoria.description:
"So, in other words, one of the most important theories in alchemy is—"
Hmm, she was supposed to be helping me study for the knight exams, though...
"Next, listen to how the stars are tied to alchemy! It's really important, so make sure to memorize this, Izana!"
Ah well, as long as Resna is having fun, I guess it's okay!
memoria.name: It's Time to Study!

memoria.description:
"Who would have thought there'd be so much mana sleeping beneath the earth?"
Roman stands alone in a cave glistening with crystals.
"Could this mean...? Heh, this seems worth looking into."
A blessing from the stars glistens in a small bottle in his hands. He stares past the bottle, to some as-yet-undetermined future.
memoria.name: The Future in His Eyes

memoria.description:
Alchemy is an art that utilizes the blessing of the stars as fuel to create something new. Alchemists wield this art to make their dreams a reality and change the course of history.
One such alchemist, Saskia, stands poised to use that power to weave history anew.
memoria.name: Those Who Weave History

memoria.description:
"These flowers are so pretty. I'd love to pick a whole bouquet!"
"Yeah. And the most beautiful flower of all is...!"
"Wh-What are you doing, Valeria?"
"I'm taking the two loveliest lovely flowers home!"
"W-We're not flowers."
memoria.name: Snuggling With Flowers

memoria.description:
Inside the dimly lit ruins, faint starlight illuminates her long hair. This warrior with cold, empty eyes is the one who saved me from my predicament.
That was the fateful meeting between my partner and me.
memoria.name: My Partner

memoria.description:
"Oh, I found some treasure! Whoa, what?!"
The flapping of monstrous wings draws closer as Heidi runs over.
"Leave this to me! Yaaah!"
"Thanks, Mu! Now, while you've got them distracted, let's open this!"
Her experienced hands make quick work of the locked treasure chest. But just what awaits them inside...?
memoria.name: Striking it Rich!

memoria.description:
"Lanze, wake up."
"Uh? Guess I fell asleep. Urp."
His head pounds and a wave of nausea washes over him. He's had too much to drink again.
"Here's some water. You'll catch a cold if you sleep here. You need to take better care of yourself."
She's gentle as an angel, as always.
memoria.name: An Angel's Kindness

memoria.description:
The two of them are alone in the atelier.
The only sounds they can hear are the gentle clinking of tools and their excited chatting voices.
An ordinary moment just like any other.
But to these two childhood friends, this moment is special.
memoria.name: A Time Just for Two

memoria.description:
They face a world crumbling towards its end.
Some search for beloved family members.
Others chase their dreams into the sky.
Others still seek to have their wishes granted.
As their desires cross paths, they come ever closer to the truth of this world of Dusk.
memoria.name: The Alchemists of Dusk

memoria.description:
Escha and Logy head home after a hard day of work.
Accomplishment is its own reward.
Their faces beam with the satisfaction of a job well done.
Their spirits are high as a balloon quietly lifts them into the Dusk sky.
memoria.name: Shoot for the Sky

memoria.description:
Plachta has stood by Sophie's side and watched her grow, sometimes as a teacher, sometimes as a friend.
But what does she see when she closes her eyes? A student who can stand on her own? Precious memories the friends have shared?
Or, perhaps...
memoria.name: When Dolls Dream

memoria.description:
Firis straddles her latest creation, a broomstick that carries her through open skies.
She says her goodbyes to the townscape below and heads toward her next destination.
What new encounters await her just beyond the horizon?
memoria.name: Further Still!

memoria.description:
Ryza is bored by the unchanging mundanities of her daily life.
But that is all about to change. Today, she and her friends take their first steps toward freedom.
They leave the ordinary behind and turn their gaze beyond the confines of their island home!
memoria.name: What Lies Beyond

memoria.description:
Ryza smiles as she gazes at Fi's sleeping face during an afternoon nap.
The longer she watches that cute face, the more sleepy it seems to make her.
Their gentle snores reverberate through the air as the sun sets.
memoria.name: Lazy Afternoon

memoria.description:
The group of friends has separated, each pursuing their own path, though they will cherish the memories they shared forever.
However, they are destined to meet again. When their paths finally cross once more, they will continue the story that began that summer, so long ago.
memoria.name: A Continuation of That Summer

memoria.description:
During her travels, Sophie found herself in a dreamlike world full of mysterious encounters and strange adventures.
With the memories of the companions she encountered in her heart, the alchemist Sophie sets out on a new journey.
memoria.name: In a Phantom World

memoria.description:
"Hey, where did you all come from?"
Valeria asks, gazing up at the stars in the sky. Her voice is full of hope, sorrow, and resignation as her words fade into the void.
"I guess even you don't know, huh?"
She murmurs, as though speaking to herself.
memoria.name: Under the Starry Sky

memoria.description:
Spring water flows down from the mountains and into the ponds in Resna's hometown of Friegen. People of all ages gather together to take advantage of these bountiful brooks and cool off.
Listen closely, and you might hear the sound of the townsfolk biting into crisp, red fruits as they relax under a clear blue sky that seems to stretch on forever.
memoria.name: By the Cool Riverside

memoria.description: With her staff raised, Sophie declares, "Okay! I'm really going for it!" The alchemical knowledge that she has acquired from books converges into one massive strike. "Once I put my mind to it, I can do anything!" The skills she has honed and the wisdom she has gained blossom on the battlefield.
memoria.name: Profuse Blows

memoria.description: The air is thick with the looming presence of monsters, but two master explorers slice straight through it. After delivering a fatal blow, Valeria lands lightly on the ground beside Ryza. Breathing as one, they already know their next moves without exchanging so much as a word.
memoria.name: Intersecting Moments

memoria.description: "Um, I need this book, and this one..." Marie is hard at work synthesizing in the atelier again today. Though it seems she's made a bit of a mess. "Whoa! ...Phew, that was a close one. Maybe I should tidy up after all..."
memoria.name: Hard at Work!

memoria.description: Meruru and Keina are on hand to greet the guests. "Thanks for coming! We hope you have a ton of fun today!" "Go ahead and help yourself to the refreshments." Their warm hospitality brings smiles to everyone's faces.
memoria.name: Welcome to the Party!

memoria.description: Resna and Esty are sailing toward a big party as fireworks bloom overhead. "Wow, they're so beautiful!" exclaims Resna. "Hehe! This sure is setting expectations high for today. We're definitely going to have a great time!" They might be focusing on different things, but their excitement is the same.
memoria.name: Watching Fireworks

memoria.description:
Sophie and Plachta head to a festival full of tricks and treats.
"All right, I'm going to create some tricks of my own!"
"S-Sophie?!"
Plachta—Sophie's family, mentor, and friend—would never miss the chance to frolic like this!
memoria.name: Dress-Up Outing!

memoria.description:
"Trick or treat?
No need to choose, I've already made my decision."
"Wait! What are you doing?!"
Plachta had been acting strange since she put on the costume. Valeria's eyes dart around in confusion as she loses her chance to escape.
memoria.name: Time for Mischief

memoria.description:
"Ayesha! Can you be my big sister for today?"
"Haha, of course. What would you like me to do?"
There are so many things Izana would like to try if she had an older sister. She took the opportunity to indulge to her heart's content.
memoria.name: Sisters for a Day

memoria.description:
"All done! Lydie, look!"
Happiness gained at long last, after all sorts of hardships, mistakes, and sorrows.
"Wow! That's a beautiful painting, Sue."
The twins will continue to paint a bright future together.
memoria.name: Our Masterpiece

memoria.description: Even if she awakens in an unknown world—even if there are two moons floating in the sky—Ryza's curiosity always outweighs her anxiety. Each day is filled with excitement for Ryza as she finds new materials she has never seen before and meets new faces in her adventures. Even if the world seems entirely different, the air, filled with the promise of adventure, is just like that summer.
memoria.name: Adventure to New Horizons

memoria.description:
"Klaudia, look at that!"
"Wow, Ryza! That's really interesting."
Lila and Empel look on with confused expressions as the two best friends talk.
Empel then asks them, "What exactly are you two looking at?"
"That's our secret!"
memoria.name: Endless Discoveries

memoria.description:
"Let's go give presents to those people next!"
Spreading joy by handing out presents to everyone in town on the sacred night is what Resna considers to define the ideal Starbirth Envoy. With that dream driving her actions, she's committed to doing what she can, one step at a time.
memoria.name: Starbirth Festival Night

memoria.description: Bathed in the moonlight are an alchemist who harbors endless dreams and a warrior in search of her lost memories. Is the path they tread one guided by the stars? Or perhaps...
memoria.name: Destined by the Stars

memoria.description: Bathed in the moonlight are alchemists entranced by a hunger, and a watcher given the name of Crow. Are they the dark foes lurking in the world's shadows? Or perhaps...
memoria.name: Ebony Shadows of a Moonlit Night

memoria.description:
A brightly colored bird alights on Ryza's shoulder as she stops for a moment's respite.
"Hm? Are you taking a break too?"
There are adventurers who walk the earth, and there are adventurers who soar through the skies, but sometimes, in the midst of nature, their adventures can come together for just a moment.
Just as Ryza feels ready to set off again, the bird also gently takes off into the air.
memoria.name: Adventurer's Feathered Respite

memoria.description:
Valeria dances gracefully to the melody of the flutes and the gong played by Judie.
"Is this the right way to dance?"
"Not sure... but as long as it's fun!"
This delightful start to the year promises a lively and joyful year ahead.
memoria.name: Dance into the New Year

memoria.description:
"Step right up! Everything's on sale!"
The beginning of the year is a great time to do business. Wearing white and scarlet hakama, Resna and Shallistera energetically promote their wares, hoping their heartfelt creations will bring good health and happiness to many.
memoria.name: New Year Sale!

memoria.description:
"Oh well. If they won't talk, I guess we have no choice..."
Just as Roman reaches for his sword, Marion draws her weapon right behind him. In the face of danger, they show resolve you would never expect from their usual demeanor.
memoria.name: Don't Underestimate Me!

memoria.description:
Sophie and Monika enjoy a game of badminton, bringing out their inner child. Whoever drops the ball has to mark their face with ink.
"Careful, Monika, or I'll smudge the ink!"
"Back at you, Sophie!"
Their game, filled with cheerful banter and laughter, seems to go on forever.
memoria.name: Feathers Fly on a Festive Day

memoria.description:
"We're gonna be late!"
Sharlotte zooms off on her broom, best friend in tow, managing to hold on to some freshly made toast.
"Careful, Lotte. More haste, less speed."
"I know they say that, Stera, but..."
Even in rushed moments like this, their time together is always cherished.
memoria.name: Riding with a Best Friend

memoria.description:
"It's not often that we get to visit a snow-covered field. Let's make the most of it and have some fun!"
"As you wish, Your Highness..."
Following Roman's suggestion, Juna tries her hand at making a snowman for the first time. She becomes quite attached to the snowman she poured her heart into, which makes it all the more difficult to think that they will soon have to part.
memoria.name: Silver Snow Delight

memoria.description:
"It's really thriving in here, Escha."
"Logy! You made it!"
Escha's face lights up with a warm smile upon seeing a familiar face.
"Just give me a sec to bring your order, okay?"
Escha was busy, bustling about, but that brief moment with Logy was oh-so rich and sweet.
memoria.name: Chocolate Time

memoria.description:
"Should be around here. Your turn, Shallotte!"
"Got it, Master Wilbell!"
On Wilbell's cue, Shallotte scatters chocolates and flyers across the capital's skies. Dressed in bewitching outfits, the two help promote the Linde Festival with a touch of gentle magic.
memoria.name: Sprinkling Magic from the Sky

memoria.description:
"Ahh, the snow is so beautiful, isn't it, Totori?"
Rorona and Totori walk side by side as snowflakes drift over the capital, both dressed in warm and stylish clothes.
"Careful, Teacher! If you keep looking around, you'll fall again!"
"I know, I know!"
 They may be an odd student-teacher pair, but their steps are perfectly in sync.
memoria.name: Together in the Snow

memoria.description: Out of nowhere, the Apexi Weltex emerges off the shores of Kur. Impervious to cannon fire, it wields a devastating power that no knights can stand against. Even so, Valeria, Lydie, and Suelle are all willing to put their lives on the line to face against the beast. Anything to protect their families and friends.
memoria.name: Stand Against the Apexi!

memoria.description:
Heidi, Firis, and Flocke show they are ready to confront the Apexi, all dressed in armor that matches Valeria's. They know the threat they are facing all too well, but running has never even crossed their minds.
"Time for a counterattack! Flocke, Firis, let's go!"
memoria.name: Overcoming Despair

memoria.description:
"Now this is a celebration!"
"I'm going to eat as much as I want today!"
"You always eat as much as you want anyway..."
As they gather to celebrate a victory, Resna and friends are reminded of the future they're striving to achieve—the future they're fighting for.
memoria.name: A Future Worth Fighting For

memoria.description:
Rumor has it that valuable treasures are hidden in these ruins. Eager to stock up, Flocke heads into the ruins with Heidi in tow.
"Um... are you sure it's safe to go this deep?"
"Don't worry! My research says it's safe here, I think. Maybe. Probably."
memoria.name: Nothing to Fear with Friends

memoria.description: Resna and Valeria met each other as if guided by the stars. Though their interests were far apart at first, they quickly became irreplaceable to each other. No matter what challenges await them, they'll surely overcome them together.
memoria.name: Cherished Aspirations

memoria.description:
"Aww! She's so cute! I just have to cuddle her!"
Sophie scoops up a kitten that wandered into the academy. As a cat lover, she can't help but show her affection for the adorable kitty in her arms.
"Just look at this cutie! Where did you all come from?"
"Wah! Miss Marlone! When did you get here?!"
memoria.name: Kitty Cuteness Overload!

memoria.description: Resna excitedly receives her enrollment information to join the alchemy department at Lantarna Academy. Arriving in town, she races towards the academy, ready to embrace whatever challenges her dream education may bring—
memoria.name: To the Academy of Dreams!

memoria.description: With classes for the day over, the classroom is buzzing with excitement as Puni-Mi invites everyone to play together after school. As I turn around to see if Puni-Ko will join us, I see she is fast asleep, happily dreaming. Seeing the joy on Puni-Ko's face, Puni-Mi and I share a laugh together, cherishing these simple, everyday moments that will continue until the day we graduate.
memoria.name: A Gloriously Ordinary Day

memoria.description:
"Do we have to be so close, Ryza?"
"We won't fit if we're not close!"
"Miss Marion, can you crouch down a little more?"
"Who, me?"
With everyone in place, Ryza captures the dazzling moments of their youth on camera. Moments too precious to simply let pass by.
memoria.name: Snapshot of Youth

memoria.description:
Not heeding Rorona's warnings, Eren escapes the school as though fleeing it. But when Rorona finds herself in trouble, it's none other than Eren who saves her.
"Th-Thank you, Eren."
"It's nothing... But I'd rather that you butt out."
memoria.name: The True Feelings You Can't See

memoria.description:
Klaudia is enraptured with the gentle twinkling of the night, while Izana lends her ear to a chorus of summer bugs.
"I never thought a foot bath could come with such lovely scenery. It's like all my stress is melting away."
"Yeah. Today's been a good break for both my legs and my hammer."
The two feel no need to say more, instead giving in to the comfort of the outdoors.
memoria.name: Serenity of a Summer Eve

memoria.description:
"I'm liking these hot springs. Let's go, Ayesha!"
"Sure, Valeria... Wait, slow down!"
Valeria dashes toward the hot springs despite her light attire. It looks like she'll just barely reach her goal before her yukata comes undone.
memoria.name: A Yukata-Clad Sprint through the Steam

memoria.description:
"Pull to starboard! Turn, Shippy!"
Totori steers the boat in the highest of spirits.
"Wow, this is amazing, Totori!"
Having been relieved of his duties as helmsman in no time at all, Lanze sighs behind the cheering Flocke.
"Well, as long as they're happy, I guess..."
memoria.name: Shippy, Set Sail!

memoria.description: She called herself an alchemist. In a world where alchemy had faded, she earnestly believed in the power of alchemy. Guided by the tail of a white comet, she set forth toward the World's End. Whether her efforts would blossom into something more was unknown, but it is said that smiling flowers bloomed along her path.
memoria.name: Budding Girl without a Name

memoria.description: Marlone was once a mischievous and troubled student, but she grew through her interactions with the people of Salburg. Her one and only best friend, the helpful fairies, the dependable adventurers, and the caring teachers—each and every one of them was a precious part of her life.
memoria.name: Origin of Alchemists

memoria.description:
Marie decided to participate in the Lantarna Founding Anniversary Cup. The waiting room was filled with seasoned alchemists and fast-growing newcomers, all fierce rivals for the cup.
"I can't afford to look bad today!"
Marie's battle begins with her wardrobe preparations.
memoria.name: Dressed for Success

memoria.description:
Juna and Linca, both dressed in different outfits than usual, are in top form even in the lush expedition areas.
"Linca, can you handle those three ahead?"
"Leave it to me, Juna!"
Despite being from different worlds, the two martial artists seem to be in perfect sync.
memoria.name: Crossing Martial Paths

memoria.description:
Izana was given a bridal outfit for the dragon-hunting mission. With an extra dress in hand, she decided to practice with Resna for a potential future wedding.
"I vow to stay by your side, till death do us part."
"I vow to stay by your side, too... Hehe."
"Hey, you laughed! We have to start over!"
memoria.name: Wedding Rehearsal Antics

memoria.description:
When Heidi sprained her ankle while wearing her unfamiliar bridal outfit, Valeria was quick to sweep her off her feet.
"Hey, put me down, partner! I can walk by myself!"
"Oh? I thought you'd be happy to take the easy way out, Heidi."
"What do you think I am? A little kid?!"
memoria.name: Gentle with the Bride

memoria.description: I'm so glad I love apples. It means that I can use the excuse of wanting some apples to go shopping in town with you! Freshly picked apples from Colseit are the most delicious, but it's just a shame that we can get them so close by, and our time together is over so soon!
memoria.name: Core of Companionship

memoria.description:
On a clear, moonlit night, two shadows glide through the darkness.
"The brighter the light, the deeper the shadows. Tonight is perfect for moving around unseen."
"Right? Looks like even the heavens are on our side."
Shrouded in the veil of night, the city is now in their hands.
memoria.name: Shadows in the Moonlight

memoria.description:
