Totori and Mimi cool off in the clear blue sea. Mimi enjoys the summer moments they share, but she has trouble accepting Totori's honest compliment about how cute she looks in her swimsuit.
"You're even cuter," she mumbles, as the cool sea soothes her flushed cheeks.
memoria.name: Seaside Splendor

memoria.description:
"Izana! Gotcha!"
"Hey, Rorona! That's freezing cold!"
Rorona and Izana splash around in the sea. The blazing midsummer sun adds to the vibrant scene, making their vacation smiles shine as brightly as the sun reflecting off the water.
memoria.name: Smiles Brighter than the Sun

memoria.description: Waiting to meet Klaudia, Ryza bites into an apple, savoring its sweetness. A true adventurer knows that you can't explore on an empty stomach, and Ryza intends to enjoy every moment of her time together with Klaudia. When she hears a familiar rhythm of footsteps approaching, she doesn't even have to look up to know that her best friend has arrived.
memoria.name: A Bite before Adventure

memoria.description: Under the blazing sun, the cheerful voices of Firis and Ilmeria fill the air. Usually rivals pushing each other to be better, they forget their competition at the beach, simply enjoying the summer as friends.
memoria.name: Seaside Truce!

memoria.description:
Under the vast blue sky, Resna and Valeria spend their first summer together.
"Valeria, want to join me for a swim?"
"Of course! And don't worry, if you faint from the heat, I'll carry you to safety!"
"I-I won't faint! I think..."
memoria.name: Under the Summer Sky, with You

memoria.description:
Roman and Juna visited the beach and brainstormed ways to make the resort more lively.
"How about we host a diving competition?"
"That's a great idea! Let's first scope things out for ourselves by having our own diving showdown!"
"As you wish, Your Highness! I won't lose!"
memoria.name: Dive into Competition!

memoria.description:
Resna and Valeria really enjoyed their time at the beach. As Resna looked around, she saw many people still enjoying the beach with smiles on their faces.
"Valeria, the Beach House was a huge success!"
"Yes, it was! I had a great time, and one I won't forget any time soon. I'd love to come back again."
"Yeah! Let's make sure we come back again, together!"
memoria.name: Promise of a Return

memoria.description:
I wanted to read the book that Resna loves. She said I could ask her if there's anything I don't understand.
"Why do you look so happy?"
"Because my friend is reading my favorite book!"
—Seeing Resna's beaming smile, I somehow began to feel happy too.
memoria.name: A Page in Friendship

memoria.description:
Ayesha and Sophie gather medicinal herbs, united in their wish to help those who are suffering.
"Ayesha, we've collected so many herbs!"
"Yeah. Let's take a little break."
As they catch their breaths, the beautiful blue sky shines brightly, and white birds soar gracefully above them, as if to light their way forward.
memoria.name: Wishes of Healing

memoria.description:
Today is Resna's birthday. She looks so happy with the delicious food and cake in front of her!
"Ehehe, thanks so much, everyone!"
I've seen that smile while standing by her side so many times, and I'll continue to protect it forever!
"Happy birthday, Resna!"
memoria.name: Happy Birthday!

memoria.description:
Just as they once said they would, Izana and Lara battled with a game of cards. The result? A crushing defeat for Izana. The whole game felt like Izana was playing right into Lara's hand.
"Didn't I tell you? Nobody defeats me."
"Nobody told me you were this good!"
memoria.name: Playing into Her Hand

memoria.description:
The stage is set for the final battle, with alchemists facing off against each other.
On one side, those who will stop at nothing to fulfill their own desires. On the other, those who seek to revive alchemy and stop those selfish desires with newfound strength.
Is this a meeting guided by the stars, or is it something else? The time for the final showdown draws near.
memoria.name: The Final Battle

memoria.description:
"Hey, partner! We're in luck!"
"You seem strangely cheerful today."
"That's because I found some amazing meat at the shop earlier! You want some too, right, Valeria? Come on, your weapon's maintenance can wait! Let's go before I change my mind!"
memoria.name: A Whimsical Invitation

memoria.description:
Valeria and Geron ready their weapons.
In a flash, steel slices through the air as their eyes meet.
The two warriors, both skilled in the art of combat, are exhilarated by the chance to face someone of equal strength.
Neither of them want to lose—there's not even time to blink.
memoria.name: Dancing with Swords

memoria.description:
In this land, alchemy is taboo and known only to be a dangerous power that incites destruction — but is it truly evil? 
After losing her mother in an accident, Yumia learns that she descends from a line of alchemists. In pursuit of the truths which have been lost, she sets out together with her friends on a journey of discovery.
memoria.name: The Envisioned Land beyond the Memories

memoria.description: In preparation for the upcoming battle, Marie and Rorona are hard at work synthesizing bombs. Marie is known as the Bomberwoman in her own world, and she hasn't lost her touch. Rorona has also synthesized countless bombs, but she still finds she has much to learn from Marie. Together, the Bomberwoman and the Pie Meister are looking to create a brand new bomb through their alchemical chemistry...
memoria.name: Bomberwomen Duo

memoria.description: The final battle with the Polar Night Alchemists approaches. Faced with an unprecedented threat, Izana and Roman are tense with anticipation. One fights for her precious alchemist, while the other fights for the love of his homeland. Though their reasons may differ, their gaze is fixed on the same bright future.
memoria.name: Why We Fight

memoria.description:
The free-spirited Ryza and the clumsy Judith: two alchemists whose paths were never meant to cross. No matter the challenge, they both act first and think later! Their shared positivity keeps them in perfect sync.
"As long as we stick together, there's nothing we can't overcome. Right?"
memoria.name: The Power of Positivity!

memoria.description:
On a lively night with jack-o'-lanterns lighting up the town, Il and I dressed up in matching outfits!
"Il, this festival is so much fun!"
"Come on, Firis! You need to calm down a little!"
Maybe it's because we're in matching outfits, but I somehow feel closer to Il, both inside and out. It makes me kinda happy!
memoria.name: Matching with Ilmeria

memoria.description:
In the midst of a festival bustling with costumes and candy, two friends meet.
"Good evening, Liane! Would you like some of my candy?"
"Thank you! They're so cute, and they look so scrumptious! I'd love to give some to Firis, too."
"Hehe, you two really are such close sisters!"
memoria.name: Growing Circle of Sweets

memoria.description:
As monsters emerge from the darkness, Valeria sweeps through them with elegant precision, while Heidi provides cover from behind.
"Heidi, one's coming your way!"
"I got it, partner! After everything I've been through, I'm not as timid as I used to be!"
"Haha, I know I can always count on you now!"
memoria.name: A Trusty Partner

memoria.description:
Two travelers, adorned in splendid attire, embark on a journey to find their queen.
"Dio! I think I see Queen Lara over there! Wait, huh? Was I seeing things?"
"Oh Mieke. Patience is a virtue. One must always be as poised as Queen Lara herself."
The radiant light of their queen shines ever brightly in their eyes.
memoria.name: Toward the Queen's Radiance

memoria.description: The land of Lantarna — this is where the blessings of the white comet once overflowed, where alchemists and guardians thrived alongside a host of countless sparkling lights, weaving together the beginnings of a whole new story…
memoria.name: A Story Woven in Red and White

memoria.description: The warrior did not know who she was. Lost in the darkness, she wandered until she came upon a shining star that guided her steps, allowing her to move forward. She vowed never to lose sight of its light, wishing that the star would shine on forever.
memoria.name: Warrior Guided by Starlight

memoria.description:
When walking down the road, if you hear the clang of an iron club striking cobblestones, DO NOT approach. That is the signal of Brawl Master Magda at work. If you value your life, pack your things and leave immediately.
(Excerpt from "A Traveler's Guide to Lantarna: Capital Edition")
memoria.name: The Sound of Trouble

memoria.description:
Brad, the Seneschal of Alchemy, receives a wide array of reports regarding alchemy. His duty is to assess each situation fairly and with a neutral stance.
"Resna Sternenlicht, you say?"
For the umpteenth time, the name catches his eye.
"Hmm. Perhaps I should pay this Resna a visit soon."
memoria.name: Alchemical Arbiter

memoria.description: The Polar Night Alchemists—a group who turned to alchemy to fulfill their own desires. To them, the constraints of the law are trivial. They pursue the path they seek and believe in, and nothing more. Those who stand in the way of their progress are removed by force—even if they are fellow alchemists.
memoria.name: The Polar Night Alchemists

memoria.description: Hielo is always calm and helps me when I'm feeling lost. Violet is timid, but understands my struggles better than anyone else. Azure is kind, always cheering me up when I feel down. Scarlet is rough, but gives me the courage to stand up for myself. All of them, in their own way, are my precious friends.
memoria.name: My Fuzzy Friends

memoria.description: I've hurt so many people—my companions, my friends, my family. They suffered because of me. But even so, I can't just give up. The only thing I can do now is keep on fighting for everyone I've hurt. I'll use everything at my disposal to win—no matter what it takes.
memoria.name: Strength to Overcome the Darkness

memoria.description:
At a banquet, guests playfully present Yuna with a ribbon-adorned chicken plushie after seeing her carrying platters.
"Being cute doesn't excuse everything!"
Yuna's face turns bright red. A special day when her relationship with everyone changed just a little bit.
memoria.name: Red-Faced Knight

memoria.description:
Established order and granted peace. Such things are merely a cage to imprison me.
That's precisely why I'll destroy it all, with the alchemical power I've learned and accumulated. I wield this power only to satisfy my own desires.
Now, let us begin—the battle for "liberation."
memoria.name: Thirst for Liberation

memoria.description:
Resna's staff emits a dazzling light.
"Behold! The magnificent power of alchemy!"
She thrusts her staff toward the enemies blocking her path.
Having grown as an alchemist through her journey, she faces the future of alchemy with unwavering determination in her eyes.
memoria.name: Light of Alchemy

memoria.description:
"Ugh! You guys are so persistent!"
Marlone finds herself surrounded by monsters with no escape route.
But she doesn't panic. After all—
"Time to bring out the big guns! Marlone's Special Mega Flame! Take this!"
She is, after all, the explosive girl who will make her name known throughout the world.
memoria.name: The Explosive Girl Marie Arrives!

memoria.description:
"Judith! Enemies coming from this way!"
"I know! Hyaaaaaah!!"
Judith travels with Fink the parrot.
"I won't lose here!"
Her adventure, spanning over 200 years, has only just begun.
memoria.name: Beyond Distant Time

memoria.description:
Happy New Year.
Lately, there have been many unsettling events occurring one after another. I must do my best to ensure everyone can live without worry or anxiety.
May this year bring happiness and wonder to this star.
memoria.name: Happiness to This Star

memoria.description:
"Done! Look, look, Plachta!"
"Sophie... what are you doing?"
"I found an old recipe in the back of the shelf, so I thought I'd try it..."
"We're in the middle of spring cleaning! Why are you making such a mess!"
memoria.name: An Endless Journey

memoria.description:
Marlone's alchemical skills have earned her a teaching position at the academy. While she enjoys her fulfilling life as a teacher, her busy days sometimes make her long for a break...
"Maybe I should invite her out to eat sometime..."
The face of her kind friend floats into her mind.
memoria.name: Unchanging Friendship

memoria.description:
Empel is appointed as Lara's secretary on a trial basis.
"Are you prepared to serve tea at the meeting?"
"Yes, flawlessly. The tea snacks are also ready."
"Excellent, you pass! Now, about signing a contract as an official secretary of the Lara Kingdom..."
"Lady Lara, thank you for having me, brief though it was."
memoria.name: Your Excellency, It's Meeting Time

memoria.description:
"Firis~"
"Waaah! What is it, Il-chan?"
"Nothing~? Your arm just looked so pinchable right in front of me!"
"Hehe, what's that about? You're weird."
"Ah, no fair! Big sis, let me pinch you too~!"
memoria.name: Me Too, Me Too~!

memoria.description: New sights, new encounters, thrilling adventures... While such stimulating days are fun, sometimes it's nice to take a break and catch your breath. Reflecting on past events while chatting with companions—that too is part of the journey's flavor.
memoria.name: Days Like These Sometimes

memoria.description:
—A world of light and darkness, order and chaos, where swords and magic intertwine.
In a corner of such a world lived an alchemist. She knew nothing of the world's rise and fall. Yet, the footsteps she had walked were surely etched in that place.
memoria.name: Where She Once Stood

memoria.description:
Taking a break in a quiet shade, a cool breeze blows through as flower petals dance in the air. A slightly special moment in an otherwise ordinary day.
It's small but precious happiness. Surely from this will come a magical recipe to make tomorrow even more enjoyable.
memoria.name: Magical Recipe

memoria.description:
The world is made of various colors. Taking each color in hand, letting the brush run freely across the canvas as the heart desires. Colors overlap and blend, vividly painting stories.
Now then, what shall we create today?
memoria.name: A Colored World

memoria.description:
Walking through this barren land where dry winds blow, searching for someone precious. Using blooming and scattered flowers as guides, watching the waxing and waning moon, all the way to the distant horizon.
Believing that surely, we'll meet you there.
memoria.name: To the Distant Horizon

memoria.description: Let's gather a friend or two and set out. Tomorrow surely awaits beyond that door. Let's join hands and sing together. Under the sparkling sky, let's go meet the hopeful morning sun. Forward, forward, down this endless road. We'll surely reach our dreamed future.
memoria.name: Toward the Dreamed Future

memoria.description:
Closing my eyes, I remember those irreplaceable days. Though I can't see them now, that child, she, he, everyone is by my side, pushing me toward the next world.
I feel like I heard a voice saying "Let's go."
Well then, let me lace up my boots. A new adventure begins—
memoria.name: Anytime, Anywhere.

memoria.description:
Books are collections of knowledge woven for someone's happiness. My role is to mix this knowledge together to discover recipes for happiness.
Come, tell me your dreams. No matter how impossible they seem, it's okay. I know that if we take it one step at a time, they'll definitely come true.
memoria.name: Where Knowledge Gathers

memoria.description:
"Hehe. That looks delicious."
"Would you like some, Sophie? In that case..."
Plachta takes a piece of candy and offers it.
"Really? Then without hesitation... say 'aah'"
"Ah! Geez, that tickles..."
A warm sweetness melts in their mouths.
memoria.name: In Sweet Cloudiness

memoria.description:
"Well then, let's head out today too!"
Ryza always takes my hand and leads me on adventures. Our relationship hasn't changed since we first met. But now, I want to be even closer.
"W-wait, Klaudia?! If you stick so close, it'll be hard to walk..."
memoria.name: Closer Than Back Then

memoria.description:
When one adventure ends, another awaits. After all, this world is still filled with countless mysteries.
As long as curiosity remains, the adventures will never end.
Now then, onto the next stage—
memoria.name: A New Journey Begins

memoria.description:
How long has it been since we first met?
Joy, sorrow, happiness, hardship—we've shared it all together.
The time I've spent with you is precious to me.
And I dream of a wonderful future where these moments continue forever—
memoria.name: Dreams of Something Special

memoria.description:
Adding a secret ingredient to the usual recipe.
Thinking of that person's smiling face, I can't help but smile myself.
Now, let's stir in the finishing touch,
with plenty of love mixed in.
memoria.name: A Pinch of Love

memoria.description:
Just the two of us beneath the starlit sky.
Adventuring with everyone is fun, but today is different—a special adventure just for us.
It's as if we're the only two people in the world.
May this quiet, warm moment last until dawn—
memoria.name: A Special Adventure

memoria.description:
A small reward after finishing work.
The sweetness of cake melts away the day's fatigue.
But really, I don't even need the cake.
Just having you beside me makes me so happy that I forget all about being tired.
memoria.name: After Work Moments

memoria.description:
"Oh? Are you lost? Let Alvie be your guide! Don't worry about payment—it's off the clock! Though if you insist on showing your gratitude—"
"Alvina? Should I report this to the High Priest?"
"J-just kidding, Janne! It was just a joke..."
memoria.name: Leave It to Alvie!

memoria.description:
Sacred Knight Bepp Zimlock.
Beneath her cold gaze,
her blade moves with bestial ferocity,
hunting, catching, and slaying her prey.
And within each swing lies her conviction—
memoria.name: Blade of Conviction

memoria.description:
During a break between duties, Janne sits down to rest her weary body. Even the one called the strongest warrior shows a gentler, motherly side when away from the battlefield.
"Oh? Hehe, did you come to see me?"
Her face brightens even more at the sight of someone rushing over.
(That gave me an energy boost♪ I can keep going now!)
memoria.name: Holy Knight's Respite

memoria.description:
Steadfastly, I've pressed forward to master this path.
It began with inspiration in my youth. And the more I learned, the deeper I delved into this profound and mysterious world.
Even when doubts arise, this power guides me forward. It has until now, and surely will continue to do so.
memoria.name: Single-Minded Devotion

memoria.description:
I don't know what the right answer is. After all, I don't even know anything about myself.
But I refuse to just accept that and give up. Even if it's just a little at a time, I want to find the answers with my own hands.
Well, thinking isn't really my style... For now, I'll carve my path forward with this sword!
memoria.name: With My Own Hands

memoria.description:
The curtain rises on a new adventure.
Filled with both anticipation and anxiety, we look toward the endless sea beyond. What could be waiting for us beyond that horizon?
memoria.name: What Awaits Beyond the Sea

memoria.description:
Alchemy. It was a forbidden art passed down from her mother. What exactly was this power? What were her mother's true intentions?
To learn the truth, Yumia ventures into forbidden territory.
"I want to move forward. After all, I believe every memory is tied to alchemy."
memoria.name: To Learn the Truth

memoria.description:
He had a difficult and painful past.
Then he encountered the "justice" that saved them.
Viktor moves forward, carrying an unwavering resolve.
"That's why I won't hesitate. On that day, I decided I would follow through with the justice I saw in the chief's back."
memoria.name: For the Sake of Justice

memoria.description:
From a young age, she believed she couldn't do anything.
That belief became a curse, weighing down her heart and mind.
Lenja's greatest enemy was herself.
"I wanted to prove it. To prove that even I could be useful to someone."
memoria.name: The Greatest Enemy

memoria.description:
No matter how harsh the investigation gets, never forgetting to stay stylish. It's a principle she refuses to compromise on.
Isla continues to fight, holding her strong convictions close to her heart.
"I've lost enough friends already."
memoria.name: Uncompromising Resolve

memoria.description:
"That covers the basic tour guide stuff, but...
Now it's time for something special just for Yumia! I'll show you my personal favorite spots!"
"Oh? Well, I guess that would be nice."
"Come on, this way!"
"H-hey... don't pull so hard~"
memoria.name: Something Special!

memoria.description:
He's overcome every adversity on his own.
Living freely, bound to no one.
That is Rutger's philosophy.
"It's easier to move alone. I get plenty done that way. What's the problem with that?"
memoria.name: Walking My Own Path

memoria.description:
Sometimes a capable investigator.
Other times, a cheerful and mischievous older sister figure.
She's always composed, yet impossible to pin down.
No one knows Nina's true intentions.
"Fufu, fufufu.... Well then, let's not hold back..."
memoria.name: Reliable Skills and...

memoria.description:
At the culture festival's live stage, Ryza calls out to the packed crowd while jumping around.
(Wow... Ryza's really popular!)
Suddenly, their eyes meet as Ryza turns around.
With a wink and a nod that says "Let's do this!"
(Alright, I've got to have fun too!)
memoria.name: Getting Pumped Up!

memoria.description:
After finishing up their work, Heidi and Flocke unwind with a game.
"Heheh, watch my controller skills!"
"Waah, gotta dodge!"
"Look out, I'm gonna pass you, Flocke!"
"W-wait for meee!"
memoria.name: The Hot Race Begins!

memoria.description:
"This game requires spatial awareness and precise trajectory calculations... in other words, my specialty."
"Amazing! Hey, grab that one next to you too!"
"No. I think we should stop at this machine."
"Eh, why?"
"That too is a calculation."
memoria.name: After School Idol

memoria.description:
A mechanic's morning doesn't start early.
It seems I dozed off while poring over research papers late into the night. I try to get up slowly... but give up.
"Mmmh... maybe just a little more sleep..."
My mornings start late, end quickly, and are sweet.
memoria.name: A Mechanic's Daily Life

memoria.description:
Month × Day, Sunny with Occasional Rain
Caught in a sudden downpour on my way home from school, I took shelter under a storefront. A kind person lent me their umbrella. They seemed to be from the militia, but I could have sworn I saw a Lantarna Academy emblem...? Next time I meet them, I must properly thank them!
memoria.name: After the Rain

memoria.description:
"There's only one Student Council President seat. For everyone who believed in me and entrusted me with their hopes... Roman, I won't lose to you!"
"As someone carrying everyone's dreams, I can't just hand over this honor to you. Let's settle this fair and square!"
memoria.name: A Single Honor

memoria.description:
I won't run away from any threat. Because there's someone precious I want to protect, no matter what.
"Let's go, Izana."
"Yeah! Knight Izana will show you how well I can protect Resna!"
memoria.name: As a Knight

memoria.description:
A sweet taste lingers on my tongue. In our private atelier, the sweetness of the candy and the warmth of her shoulder against mine slowly melt together.
We're eating the same thing, so why does hers look so much more appealing?
As my body temperature rises, the sweetness in my mouth seems to intensify.
memoria.name: Candy and Body Heat

memoria.description:
Resna is a young alchemist who set out on a journey. With a dream of reviving the lost art of alchemy to enrich people's lives, she travels with her companions toward the World's End.
"Alchemy is a magical power that can create something new by combining different things together!"
memoria.name: With the Power of Dreams

memoria.description:
Valeria, an enigmatic warrior. Having lost her memories of the past, she travels with Resna and the others to discover who she truly is.
"I want to stay by Resna's side, creating things and going on adventures together. That's what I want to do right now."
memoria.name: What I Want to Do

memoria.description:
Izana, a beast-girl aspiring to become a knight. Carrying her treasured hammer and the promise she made with her best friend Resna in her heart, she continues her journey with her companions today.
"I swear upon the shooting stars! I will become the strongest knight in the future!"
memoria.name: Promise with a Friend

memoria.description:
Ryza, an adventure-loving alchemist. Free-spirited as ever, she continues her adventures today, following her sense of justice and curiosity.
"Life only happens once, you know? Somehow, I don't like the idea of never realizing what's really important."
memoria.name: Adventure and Growth

memoria.description:
Sophie, a whimsical alchemist. She can hear the voices of materials and uses alchemy to grant their wishes. Today too, she helps others with her alchemy.
"My dream is the same as Resna's. Let's work together to make people happy with alchemy!"
memoria.name: Alchemy of Happiness

memoria.description:
Totori, an alchemist raised by the sea. As both an adventurer and experienced sailor, she continues working hard today toward her goal of venturing beyond the Lantarna continent.
"That's why I came to meet you. I want to see what lies beyond the sea too."
memoria.name: Beyond the Sea

memoria.description:
Rorona, a bright and energetic alchemist. Though she can be a bit clumsy at times, she works hard every day to charm people with her beloved pies.
"Yes! I'll use my pies to cheer everyone up!"
memoria.name: Bringing Cheer

memoria.description:
Ayesha, a kindhearted alchemist. Gentle and calm by nature, she synthesizes medicine to help those who are suffering. Her remedies not only heal injuries and illnesses but also contain a kindness that soothes troubled hearts.
"I think only we can find what we truly want to do."
memoria.name: A Prayer of Comfort

memoria.description:
Marie, an energetic and spirited alchemist. Having studied alchemy at an academy, she travels in search of alchemical truth. During her journey, she discovered the various possibilities that alchemy holds.
"I think granting small moments of happiness is also an important role of alchemy."
memoria.name: The Role of Alchemy

memoria.description:
The girl once called a sparrow has found her wings of freedom. Her gaze is fixed on new lands.
"So this is beyond the continent... Time to let them know about my genius!"
She spreads her wings wide, ready to descend to where her dear friend awaits.
memoria.name: Wings to the World

memoria.description:
Lila visits an island steeped in Keiun culture. The many trees that have taken root here are said to burst into beautiful pink blossoms when their season comes. But that time hasn't yet arrived.
"I'm sure it must be beautiful. I hope these traditions continue into the future, never to be lost..."
memoria.name: A View Yet Unseen

memoria.description:
As she gazes at the freshly blooming flowers, Mimi's thoughts are occupied by the girl whose warmth she can feel beside her.
—If the blue flower represents Totori, then perhaps the purple one next to it represents me...
A smile crosses her lips as their hands overlap in response.
memoria.name: Your Color

memoria.description:
"Miss Rorona! What kind of pie are you making today?"
"Today it's meat pie! Would Totori and Meruru like some?"
"Yay! I love your pies, Rorona!"
"Heheh, I'm so glad. Well then, let's eat while it's still warm!"
memoria.name: Rorona's Pie

memoria.description:
Tantjn soars high into the sky with Rorona on its back. Perhaps sensing her hunger-induced weakness, the flying Tantjn carries Rorona off somewhere.
"Aaah! Th-This is so high! What if we can't get back down...!"
Only Tantjn knows where they're headed.
memoria.name: Higher and Higher

memoria.description:
Today is perfect weather for gathering! Totori has brought along her apprentice Meruru for a gathering expedition. The gathering goes smoothly, and before they know it, their baskets are full. Totori calls out to Meruru as she runs across the meadow.
"We'll be gathering all the way back to the atelier, Meruru! Let's synthesize together when we get back!"
memoria.name: Perfect Gathering Weather!

memoria.description:
"Eek! S-Sterk! What on earth is happening?!"
Sterk scoops up the startled Rorona with one arm as explosions ring out. The sight of the two of them together is like a princess and her knight.
"There's nothing to worry about. Stay close to me. Allow me to protect you as your knight."
memoria.name: Princess and Knight

memoria.description:
Rorona inherited the atelier by chance. Though she didn't understand anything at first, she ran around frantically every day to continue her daily life with the people important to her. And then—
"I have a place I want to protect."
Her talent as an alchemist bloomed.
memoria.name: Blooming Talent

memoria.description:
"I have something I must do."
Shallistera gives form to her prayers through alchemy. Her prayer is to save her hometown from the phenomenon known as "Dusk."
"So please, let my wish reach you—!"
Does the light of alchemy illuminate the future she hopes for?
memoria.name: Her Mission

memoria.description:
Ryza runs across the sandy beach in her swimsuit, ball in hand. Neither the blazing sun overhead nor the glare reflecting off the sand matters to her as she enjoys the moment. If anything, they make her presence shine even brighter.
Her smile as she enjoys her vacation more than anyone else was more dazzling than the sun shining overhead.
memoria.name: Dazzling Smile

memoria.description: Resna basks in the blazing sunlight. The intense sun that she'd normally struggle with is nothing when she's by the ocean! Wearing a cute ribbon-adorned swimsuit and straw hat, she energetically runs around the beach. What touches her skin—sweat or ocean spray? Resna feels her throat getting dry.
memoria.name: Basking in Sunlight

memoria.description:
Valeria finishes her swim in the ocean. Her swimming was so powerful and graceful that it didn't seem like she was in water at all, captivating everyone watching.
As she emerges onto land, her wet shirt clings to her body, and droplets trace along her skin. Valeria adjusts the flower ornament in her hair before diving back into the ocean.
memoria.name: Soaked by the Waves

memoria.description:
Klaudia enjoys her vacation wearing a mature, grown-up swimsuit. The cool ocean temperature against her bare skin feels wonderful on her sun-warmed body.
In her line of sight is her best friend running across the beach with a ball. Klaudia brushes back her wave-dampened hair to respond to her friend's call.
memoria.name: Sun-Kissed Body

memoria.description:
Antje bites into the watermelon that Janne cut for her. The sweetness and juiciness cause her cheeks to relax with pleasure.
"Hehe, you eat it so deliciously. Hey, why don't you try cutting the watermelon next, Antje?"
"Eh... I-I'll give it a try..."
"Yes! I'll teach you the secret to cutting watermelon perfectly."
memoria.name: The Secret to Cutting Watermelon

memoria.description:
"Let's go! Criselda!"
"Yes! Full speed ahead!"
Antje's boat races across the course at incredible speed. Antje didn't want to lose. She wanted to make this time with her precious friend into the best memory possible.
"I absolutely won't lose...! Full speed ahead!"
memoria.name: Full Speed Ahead!

memoria.description:
Shallotte, Miruca, and Shallistera race across the water on flying boards.
"Amazing...! This is the ocean!"
"It's so vast! Super huge! All right, let's go as far as we can!"
The ocean stretches endlessly in all directions.
memoria.name: Heading for the Horizon

memoria.description:
"Wow, it looks great on you! So cute! Valeria, try this one on next!"
"It's cute, but... I feel a bit self-conscious. Can't I just wear my usual outfit?"
"Oh, come on! We went shopping specially for this, so let's dress up and have fun!"
memoria.name: Let's Get Fashionable!

memoria.description:
Lara bursts energetically from the water's surface. Though soaked and her usual curls disheveled, her charming smile undoubtedly belongs to the queen of the "Lara Kingdom."
"Come now, don't just stand there. Join me, your queen, in enjoying this moment."
memoria.name: The Charming Queen

memoria.description:
Sophie splashes around in the crystal-clear ocean with her friends. Joyful voices echo all around.
Sudenly, when their eyes meet, the sun peeks out from behind the large cloud towering behind her.
The sun, or her smile? The brightness dazzles the eyes.
memoria.name: Thanks to the Sun

memoria.description:
Yumia comes to the beach with her fellow Aladiss Research Team members. Her teammates compliment how well her swimsuit suits her, and she shows a proud smile.
Even in her swimsuit, she doesn't remove the red bandana that serves as proof of her membership in the research team. Now then, let's call it a beachside investigation.
memoria.name: Beachside Investigator

memoria.description: Marie came to play in the water with her best friend Shia. Diving into the water on impulse, she sees a blue world sparkling with streaming sunlight. She wants to share the beautiful scenery she witnessed with her precious friend. Marie surfaces and takes Shia's hand, diving back into the blue world once more.
memoria.name: The Blue World I Want to Show You

memoria.description:
In Shallotte's hometown of Stellard, there's a traditional event called the "Water Festival."
Even during times of water shortage, people bathe in water to express their gratitude. For Shallotte and Shallistera, the day they participated together is a precious memory.
With gratitude for precious water, they'll continue living into the future.
memoria.name: A Water Festival from Long Ago

memoria.description:
"Oh no, that's not Alvina... Eek!"
Due to an unfortunate mishap, part of Criselda's swimsuit came undone. Even she, who always maintains her composure, can't hide her fluster at this moment, her cheeks flushed red.
"So Criselda is human after all!"
"Hehe, you caught me at an embarrassing moment."
memoria.name: When Composure Crumbles

memoria.description:
"The race I'm hosting is officially beginning!"
"I'm going to fly! Don't fall behind!"
Carried by momentum, Johanna's boat soars across the water. Johanna didn't want to lose. Before proving her genius, she wanted to enjoy this moment to the fullest.
"I absolutely won't lose! Just watch me!"
memoria.name: I Won't Lose!

memoria.description:
Under the blue sky, Johanna and Bepp are engaged in a fierce battle. The two are having a water gun fight.
"To think you can dodge this genius's attacks...!"
"You're pretty skilled yourself. But I won't lose."
"Grrrr...! One more round!"
The water gun barrels glint in the light.
memoria.name: Lakeside Showdown

memoria.description:
Kimon conceals her presence while gathering information in the streets. No one would notice the covert actions of such a skilled ninja—or so she thought.
"Huh? I sense something... Could it be Kimon?"
"Lord Izana!? To sense a ninja's presence... Knights of the continent are truly impressive!"
memoria.name: Covert Operations!

memoria.description:
Facing an approaching threat, Towa chants his onmyoudou techniques.
"Towa, I've got your back!"
"Yeah. With my onmyoudou techniques honed through training, I'll sweep away these yokai in one go!"
"You're really reliable in times like this."
"Well, when I get serious, I really get serious."
memoria.name: Shall We Exorcise Some Yokai?

memoria.description:
Long ago in Keiun, many boasted of their martial prowess and competed for supremacy. Time has passed, and in this now peaceful land, there are those who would once again ignite the flames of war.
——Watching over this are the eyes of a shrine maiden. What she gazes upon—glory or destruction? They shine with the light of devotion.
memoria.name: What the Shrine Maiden's Eyes Behold

memoria.description:
Vivid. And powerful. Kaburaya swings his sword again today. To remain strong as one who stands above others.
—If there is the light of a golden star in the heavens, then there is Kaburaya's radiance on earth.
At some point, he came to be praised in such a way. It truly captured who he was.
memoria.name: Radiance on Earth

memoria.description:
"Congratulations, Captain Sophie! I'll continue to follow you!"
"Huh?! I'm not a captain! But thank you! I'm so happy! I'll work hard to live up to the expectations of everyone who chose me!"
memoria.name: Accepting Their Feelings

memoria.description:
"Good morning, Student Council President Juna!"
"Oh, it's you. Good morning. It's another beautiful day... Ah, I'm making my rounds. I'm checking to see if the students are having any trouble with school life. If you have any concerns, feel free to come to me for advice. I'll definitely be able to help."
memoria.name: Our Student Council President

memoria.description:
Chitose looked up at the sky. She drew a breath at the sight of the golden star shining so brightly it seemed ready to fall, and the night cherry blossoms illuminated by its radiance weaving together a luminous scene.
"If I could see this beautiful scenery again next year, and the year after that, together with Kaburaya..."
Her wish danced up to the sky along with the flower petals.
memoria.name: Cherry Blossoms Filling the Sky

memoria.description:
Jelka leans against the bridge railing, gazing up at the sky. She hums a tune, talking to herself.
"A clear night sky with cherry blossoms in full bloom... this is nice. It'd be fun to bring Citrine and the others here before they scatter, so we can all enjoy it together."
Her tail sways cheerfully behind her.
memoria.name: Savoring Elegance

memoria.description:
After crossing swords in training, Gou vigorously ruffles Valeria's hair as they finish up.
"Well done, Nana! Your big brother is impressed!"
"Hey, stop it! You're too strong!"
"Hahaha, sorry! As your big brother, I'm just so happy to see how much you've grown! Keep getting stronger and stronger, Nana!"
memoria.name: A Brother's Joy

memoria.description:
Jelka's body soars through the air, ablaze with determination. The impact from Gou's great sword shakes the very atmosphere.
Jelka and Gou clash with full force against Citrine and Leah, fighting for what they believe in.
"Neither Gou nor I have any intention of backing down from our convictions! If you want to stop us, you'd better come at us with everything you've got!"
memoria.name: For What We Believe In

memoria.description:
Citrine's body moves playfully like a dance. Leah nocks an arrow and takes calm aim.
Citrine and Leah clash with full force against Jelka and Gou to fulfill their assigned mission.
"I can't understand what you two are thinking at all. If you're going to get in our way, then Citrine and I will be your opponents."
memoria.name: For Our Assigned Mission

memoria.description:
Once, Lias and Slay were driven from their homeland by a mysterious disaster. Time has passed, and the two return home as part of the town's reconstruction plan.
Reunited in their homeland, the two begin walking alongside trusted companions to reclaim what is precious to them. What truth will they discover along the way—
memoria.name: To Reclaim What's Precious

memoria.description:
The "Subspace Path"—a road connecting distant lands, created through alchemy that once flourished in prosperity.
Leaping into the vortex leads to an unknown world. They don't know where it connects or what awaits them. Still, they press forward, believing that what they seek lies ahead.
memoria.name: Those Who Walk the Subspace Path

memoria.description:
A certain place in the Venus Islands, fragrant with sea breeze. The gentle moonlight illuminates Marie Rose, making her presence stand out.
A single red rose hidden behind her back. She points forward and smiles.
"I'll make you Marie's captive."
memoria.name: Marie Rose's Secret

memoria.description:
Resna was having her picture taken under Izana's direction.
"Resna, are you nervous?"
"Y-yeah... but since you're the one taking the picture, Izana, maybe I can act natural after all."
"Ah, that smile! Now's the moment! I'm taking it!"
"Ehehe. How is it, Izana?"
memoria.name: The Presence Behind the Lens

memoria.description:
The coastline of the Vīnās Islands as the sun sets. The sea surface glimmers, reflecting the glow of the setting sun, gently illuminating her and coloring her cheeks with a soft tint.
She brings her finger to her lips and smiles.
"It's our little secret."
memoria.name: A Secret Warmth

memoria.description:
Alvina was taking photos together with Bepp.
"Bepp~! How was it? Did you get a good shot?"
"Perfect, Sister! I got the best shot!"
"Show me~! Ooh! What a perfect smile! And the outfit is amazing! This is definitely going to win!"
"Yes! Leave it to me, your personal photographer!"
memoria.name: Victory Is Guaranteed!

memoria.description:
It all began with one girl's adventurous spirit.
She was just an ordinary farmer's daughter, but through her encounters with an alchemy mentor and countless adventures with her companions, she grew into a full-fledged alchemist.
The bonds she forged with others became a warm light that continues to shine brightly in her heart to this day.
memoria.name: The Light She Wove

memoria.description:
"Location, time, weather... all as scheduled. Target acquired within range. Commencing operation."
Riebe nocks an arrow. Her operational plan is flawless, and even at this very moment, everything is proceeding according to plan.
"—Mission complete. Before reporting to Master... I'll take a short break. This is also part of the schedule."
memoria.name: Nocking an Arrow, Against the Clock

memoria.description:
Citrine snatches Alvina's staff and dashes off.
"Hey! Give it back, Citrine!"
"If you want it back, you'll have to catch me first! Oh, but you won't be able to catch up to me anyway!"
"You're making me mad! I'm gonna catch you and teach you a lesson!"
"Ahaha! If you can, that is!"
memoria.name: I'll Play with You

memoria.description:
Humming a cheerful tune, Criselda makes sweets for the cafe with practiced hands. She imagines the people who will eat these sweets.
"I hope everyone enjoys them and finds them delicious."
Warm feelings settle in her heart. They are like snow, yet contain a sweetness like sugar.
memoria.name: A Heart Like Sugar Snow

memoria.description:
"How can you act so confident in that outfit, Alvina...? Aren't you embarrassed...?"
"But Alvie, it looks good on you and you're adorable! Antje looks great too, so be confident... Actually, maybe your embarrassment makes it even better..."
"D-don't say weird things... Ugh...",
memoria.name: Bashful Bunny

memoria.description:
Ryza left her ordinary island and ordinary village, and from a chance encounter, embarked on a grand adventure.
It was a summer filled with many encounters and farewells.
"I'm sure we'll meet again."
Beneath the high sky, she welcomed the end of summer, holding the bonds with her precious companions close to her heart.
memoria.name: The End of Summer

memoria.description:
"I don't have time to stand around!"
With swords in both hands, Valeria dances through her slashing strikes. Even having lost her memory, her body still remembers how to fight.
"I'll show you everything I've got!"
Her combat techniques continue to evolve relentlessly throughout her journey.
memoria.name: Dancing Through Slashes

memoria.description:
"This is gonna hurt, so brace yourself!"
Sophie swings her staff. The kindhearted girl wields the power of alchemy to make many people happy and to protect what's precious to her.
Someday, she hopes to be just like her beloved grandmother.
"I'll protect everyone! Leave it to me!"
memoria.name: Someone to Look Up To

memoria.description:
Riding through the night sky of the Starlight Festival on a sleigh, Izana and Resna. Izana was overjoyed to celebrate this year's Starlight Festival together with Resna once again.
—So that I can continue supporting Resna from beside her... I'll work even harder!
"Happy Starlight Festival, Resna!"
memoria.name: Together for the Festival

memoria.description:
Resna here, extending New Year's greetings.
I am truly delighted to welcome another new year together with all of you. This year as well, I intend to devote myself daily to my duties as an alchemist. Though I am still immature, I humbly ask for your continued support.
May your year be filled with abundant happiness.
memoria.name: Wishing You Happiness

memoria.description:
Checking my appearance in the mirror... Since I'm wearing different clothes than usual, I feel a bit self-conscious, but...
"You look great, Yumia! It really suits you!"
If Isla says so, maybe it does suit me?
"Ehehe, you look cute! Come on, Yumia, let's go show everyone!"
memoria.name: Nervous and Cute

memoria.description:
During breaks in their investigation, Yumia and friends spend peaceful time at camp, combining meals with rest.
Though they're running around day and night as the Aladiss Research Team, seeking the truth that sleeps within the continent—
For now, they enjoy this heartwarming moment together, illuminated by the warm flames.
memoria.name: A Heartwarming Moment

memoria.description:
Rias and Slade explore a Dimensional Path.
"My adventurer's intuition is telling me there's something over there! Slade, let's go!"
"Yeah. Your intuition is usually spot-on. We met each other thanks to that intuition of yours too—"
"Uh-huh, our meeting was definitely fate!"
memoria.name: An Adventurer's Intuition

memoria.description:
The time they've spent together hasn't been long, but they are precious to each other—supporting one another more than anyone else.
No matter what threats await them ahead, they'll surely be fine. After all, they have this bond.
They draw courage from the warmth conveyed through their palms.
Now, let's go! Together, into the future!
memoria.name: Together, into the Future!

memoria.description:
Rias and Slade ready their weapons before a powerful enemy.
—No matter how terrifying the foe, they will absolutely overcome it. Because they want to keep spending their days together, always.
"Let's go. If it's the two of us, we can't lose!"
"Yeah! Let's show them what we're made of!"
memoria.name: If We're Together

memoria.description:
"Magnificent! I can feel the power surging through me!"
Walther raises his voice triumphantly. Whether due to the Apexi's power imbued in these garments or his thoughts growing sharper than ever, his entire body trembles with joyous exhilaration.
"Now I feel I can grasp all truths. Come, let us begin our research at once."
memoria.name: A Voice Echoing Through the Laboratory

memoria.description:
The words we exchanged, the scenery we saw together.
I remember every moment we spent together.
But it's still not enough.
There are words I still want to tell you.
There are sights I still want to see with you.
So please—
memoria.name: Stone of Creation

ability.description:
被暴击率下降100%，
所受战斗道具伤害下降90%。
死亡演出
ウェーブ開始時、自身にカウンター(確率50％)を付与
攻撃を受けた時、100%の確率でカウンター攻撃を行う
・攻撃時、攻撃対象に受けるダメージ+30%を付与する

wave開始時、下記の効果を発動
・自身に被ダメージDOWN20％2回を付与
・自身に与ダメージDOWN20％2回を付与

非ブレイク時、被ダメージ軽減
被クリティカルダメージが上昇

ブレイク復帰時、以下の効果を得る
・与えるマイナス効果量UP
・再生(2回)付与
麻痺＋パネル効果「被ダメージUP」無効
スキル発動後、自身に与ダメージUP(10%/3回)を付与する
ブレイク後、自身の与ダメージUP(30%/3回)付与

・火傷状態の時、Weak被弾時のHP・ブレイクダメージUP(50%)
・全体攻撃被弾時のHPダメージ+100%
・自分が状態異常を持たない時、攻撃被弾時に与ダメージUP(5%/10回)を付与
・ブレイク時に自身のバフ全解除

・ウェーブ開始時、自身に「ブレイク状態以外での被ダメージ-100%」を付与
・ウェーブ開始時、自身に「ブレイク状態以外でのクリティカルダメージ-100%」を付与
・ブレイク時、自身に「属性耐性DOWN」(15%/99回)を付与(最大3回発動)

・HP85%以下の時、攻撃被弾時に自身のHPを20%回復（「ブレイク状態以外での被ダメージ-100%」効果を持っている時のみ発動）
・HP85%以下の時、攻撃被弾時に自身のBGを25%回復（「ブレイク状態以外での被ダメージ-100%」効果を持っている時のみ発動）
・HP85%以下の時、攻撃被弾時に「ブレイク状態以外での被ダメージ-100%」効果を解除

・HP75%以下の時、攻撃被弾時に自身のHPを50%回復
（「ブレイク状態以外での被ダメージ-100%」を持っておらず、「ブレイク状態以外でのクリティカルダメージ-100%」効果を持っている時のみ発動）
・HP75%以下の時、攻撃被弾時に自身の「ブレイク状態以外でのクリティカルダメージ-100%」効果を解除
（「ブレイク状態以外での被ダメージ-100%」を持っておらず、「ブレイク状態以外でのクリティカルダメージ-100%」効果を持っている時のみ発動）

・HP75%以下の時、攻撃被弾時に自身のHPを100%回復
（「ブレイク状態以外での被ダメージ-100%」と「ブレイク状態以外でのクリティカルダメージ-100%」効果を持っていない時のみ１回だけ発動）
・HP75%以下の時、攻撃被弾時に自身に毒状態(2%ダメージ/99回)を付与
